66446.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一群大小一致、核質比高的小圓藍細胞，核圓、染色質細緻點狀、核仁不明顯，細胞質稀少淡藍並有小泡狀突起（bleb），部分細胞彼此緊貼成小團，形態符合 Ewing 肉瘤轉移至骨髓。
features: Small to medium-sized round cells, roughly 1.5-2 times red cell diameter, relatively monotonous
High N:C ratio with round to slightly molded nuclei
Finely dispersed stippled chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with small cytoplasmic blebs and occasional faint vacuoles
Tendency to form small loose aggregates with nuclear molding; no granules or maturation
Background of red cells and platelets; pale staining limits fine chromatin assessment
66446.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a population of small round blue cells occurring singly and in small loose aggregates. The cells are relatively uniform with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly molded nuclei, finely stippled chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The scant pale basophilic cytoplasm shows small blebs and occasional faint vacuoles, and no granules are identified. In an appropriate clinical setting and with CD99/NKX2.2 positivity and EWSR1 rearrangement, findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by Ewing sarcoma.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts lie singly rather than in cohesive clusters and are CD45+/TdT+ on flow, whereas Ewing cells are CD45−, CD99+ and NKX2.2+ (CD99 alone does not separate them).
Neuroblastoma forms rosettes with fibrillary neuropil and occurs in younger children, with PHOX2B positivity and elevated catecholamines.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells are often larger and more pleomorphic, sometimes multinucleated, and are desmin/myogenin positive.
Myeloblasts show azurophilic granules or Auer rods and express MPO/CD33/CD13, which are absent in Ewing sarcoma.

66318.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見大型單核母細胞（monoblast）：核圓而居中或略偏、染色質細緻如花邊、具一至數個明顯核仁，細胞質豐富灰藍色、含少數小空泡且無 Auer 小體，符合伴單核球分化的急性骨髓性白血病（KMT2A::MLLT3）。
features: Large blasts, roughly 2-3 times red cell diameter, with low to moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed lacy chromatin
One or more distinct nucleoli
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with a few small discrete vacuoles; no Auer rods or coarse granules
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis; no maturing granulocytes in field
66318.describe_en: Peripheral blood (or aspirate) smear at high power shows large blasts with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and one or more prominent nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant, moderately basophilic to grey-blue and contains occasional small vacuoles, without Auer rods or conspicuous granules. The morphology is that of monoblasts. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation; in this case, KMT2A::MLLT3 was identified.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have less abundant cytoplasm, may contain azurophilic granules or Auer rods, and are NSE negative and CD14/CD64 dim or negative.
Megakaryoblasts show cytoplasmic blebs, often cluster, and are CD41/CD61 positive.
These have deeply basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are CD138 or B/T-lineage positive rather than monocytic.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with multiple sharply punched-out vacuoles and a higher N:C ratio, and carry MYC rearrangement.

exam.answer_en: Acute monoblastic leukemia (AML with KMT2A::MLLT3) — large monoblasts with round nuclei, lacy chromatin, prominent nucleoli and abundant grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍指一顆大芽細胞問名稱；答 monoblast（圓核、細緻染色質、明顯核仁、豐富灰藍胞質），與 promonocyte（摺疊核）區分。
t(9;11)(p21.3;q23.3) KMT2A::MLLT3 在 WHO 5th 屬 AML with defining genetic abnormality，不需 blast ≥20% 門檻（僅在確認此融合時）；ICC 2022 則為 ≥10%。
KMT2A::MLLT3 在 ELN 2022 屬 intermediate risk；其他 KMT2A 重組多為 adverse。
Menin inhibitor（如 revumenib）已獲 FDA 核准用於復發/難治 KMT2A-rearranged acute leukemia。
細胞化學 NSE+（NaF 抑制）、MPO 多陰性；flow CD64、CD14、CD11b、CD4 dim。
exam.pitfall_zh: Monoblast 易與 myeloblast 混淆；myeloblast 胞質較少、可有 azurophilic 顆粒或 Auer rod 且 NSE 陰性，monoblast 胞質豐富灰藍、無 Auer rod。

quiz.q: 圖中大型芽細胞的名稱為何？此病例偵測到的融合基因是什麼？
quiz.a: Monoblast；KMT2A::MLLT3（t(9;11)）。

66190.recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓抹片中的芽細胞胞質淡藍、有核旁淡染區，可見橘粉紅色胞質小球（紅三角）、大型粉紅顆粒（假契東二氏顆粒，pseudo–Chédiak-Higashi）、單一細長 Auer 小體與小核（micronuclei）；搭配 C 圖 P53 強陽性與 D 圖 Circos 圖上多條染色體重排，指向 TP53 突變的 AML。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large blasts with fine chromatin, irregular nuclear contours and moderate pale-to-deep blue cytoplasm with paranuclear hof
Salmon/orange-pink cytoplasmic globules at the cell periphery (red triangles)
Large round pink-violet pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules filling part of the cytoplasm (right panel A)
Single thin Auer rod (thin black arrow) and small detached nuclear fragments/micronuclei (thick arrows)
Biopsy (C): diffuse sheets of blasts on H&E; CMYC and P53 show strong diffuse nuclear staining in most cells
Flow (B): CD34-negative, CD117-positive, HLA-DR-negative blast population; Circos plot (D) shows complex rearrangements with chromothripsis of chromosome 4
66190.describe_en: Composite figure. Bone marrow aspirate smears (A, May-Grünwald-Giemsa) show sheets of blasts with moderately basophilic cytoplasm, paranuclear hofs, peripheral salmon-colored cytoplasmic globules, large pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules, a single thin Auer rod, and micronuclei; background multilineage dysplasia is described. Flow cytometry (B) shows blasts that are CD34-negative, HLA-DR-negative and CD117-positive. The core biopsy (C, H&E) shows diffuse sheets of blasts, which are strongly and diffusely positive for P53 and CMYC by immunohistochemistry (insets). Optical genome mapping Circos plot (D) shows a complex genome with multiple interchromosomal rearrangements. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with mutated TP53 and complex karyotype; PML::RARA was negative by FISH.

ddx.vs: t(8;21) AML shares salmon globules, pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules and single slender Auer rods but typically has CD34+/CD19+ blasts, maturing granulocytes and no strong diffuse P53 overexpression or complex karyotype.
APL can be CD34-/HLA-DR- but shows bilobed nuclei, bundles of Auer rods and PML::RARA, which was negative here.
Morphology overlaps; distinction requires sequencing for TP53 (strong diffuse P53 IHC is a surrogate) and cytogenetics.
Erythroid blasts have deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, lack Auer rods and are CD117+/E-cadherin+/CD71+ but MPO-negative, whereas these blasts are cMPO+ with CD13/CD33.

64334.recognize_zh: 流式圖中橘色 B 細胞群 CD23 陰性至弱陽性、CD200 陰性，但 CD49d 陽性；在 CD5+ B 細胞腫瘤中，CD23-/CD200- 的組合是區分被套細胞淋巴瘤（MCL）與 CLL（CD23+/CD200+）的重要線索。
features: CD200 vs CD23: orange B-cell population is CD200 negative and CD23 negative to dim
A small scatter of CD23/CD200 co-expressing events trails diagonally, without a discrete positive population
CD19 vs CD49d: orange CD19-positive B cells express CD49d at moderate intensity
Blue CD19-negative T cells are CD49d positive; grey events are CD49d negative internal controls
64334.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plots of viable events show the orange CD19-positive B-cell population to be CD23 negative to dim and CD200 negative. The same population expresses CD49d at moderate intensity. Blue CD19-negative T cells and grey CD49d-negative events serve as internal controls. In a CD5-positive, CD10-negative, lambda-restricted B-cell neoplasm, the CD23-negative, CD200-negative phenotype supports mantle cell lymphoma over chronic lymphocytic leukemia; CD49d positivity is not lineage-specific.

ddx.vs: CLL is characteristically CD23 and CD200 positive; CD49d positivity in CLL is a prognostic marker rather than a discriminator.
Atypical CLL may be CD23 dim, but it usually remains CD200 bright and lacks cyclin D1 and t(11;14).
It shares a CD200-negative profile but is often CD5 dim/negative and SOX11 negative, and needs CCND1 testing.
MZL is usually CD5 negative with variable CD200 and CD23 negativity, and is cyclin D1 negative.

exam.answer_en: Flow cytometry: CD19+ B cells CD23−/dim, CD200−, CD49d+ — phenotype supporting mantle cell lymphoma rather than CLL
pearls_zh: 讀圖：CD200 vs CD23 圖中橘色 B 細胞位於雙陰性象限，是本題重點；CD49d 陽性不具譜系專一性，只是輔助標記。
CD200 是區分 CLL 與 MCL 最實用的標記之一：CLL 幾乎一致 CD200 亮陽性，MCL 多為陰性；CD23 在 CLL 陽性、MCL 通常陰性或弱。
CD49d 在 CLL 是預後標記（常以 ≥30% 陽性為界）：CD49d 陽性 CLL 疾病進展較快、需治療時間較短，但不能用來診斷 MCL。
Matutes/CLL score 使用 CD5、CD23、FMC7、sIg 強度、CD22/CD79b；典型 CLL 得分高，MCL 得分低，最終仍以 CCND1/cyclin D1 確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 CD23 弱陽性當成 CLL：atypical CLL 可以 CD23 dim，但通常仍 CD200 亮陽性且無 t(11;14)；CD23 與 CD200 同時陰性時應優先排除 MCL。

quiz.q: CD5+ B 細胞腫瘤若 CD23 陰性、CD200 陰性，應優先考慮哪個診斷？CD49d 陽性在 CLL 代表什麼？
quiz.a: Mantle cell lymphoma；CLL 的不良預後標記（非診斷用）

65742.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片裡的組織球胞質塞滿大量大小一致的 2–5 µm 小圓形酵母，每顆周圍有清亮暈環，使胞質呈泡沫或點狀外觀；少數在細胞外，符合莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）。
features: Histiocytes with expanded cytoplasm packed with numerous small (about 2-5 um), uniform round to oval yeast forms
Each yeast shows a central basophilic dot surrounded by a clear halo (retraction artifact), giving a bubbly appearance
Occasional yeasts appear extracellular in the interstitium
Background marrow with admixed myeloid and erythroid precursors, plasma cells and lymphocytes
No granulomas or necrosis evident in this field
65742.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows interstitial aggregates of histiocytes whose cytoplasm is filled with numerous small, uniform, round to oval intracellular yeast forms measuring approximately 2-5 um, each surrounded by a clear halo; scattered organisms appear extracellular. The background contains residual trilineage hematopoiesis without well-formed granulomas or necrosis in this field. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis; confirmation with GMS or PAS staining, culture or Histoplasma antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and are GMS-negative, lacking the clear halo of Histoplasma.
Talaromyces yeasts are more variable and elongated with a central transverse septum from binary fission rather than budding.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size (4-20 um) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding.
Toxoplasma forms crescentic tachyzoites or cysts, and Pneumocystis appears as cup-shaped cysts, neither densely packed in macrophages with halos.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis in bone marrow — histiocytes packed with small uniform 2–5 μm intracellular yeasts with clear halos
pearls_zh: 考法：指組織球內的小圓點問「是什麼病原、怎麼確認」：Histoplasma capsulatum 小型窄基出芽酵母；GMS 或 PAS 染色陽性，Giemsa 不見 kinetoplast。
骨髓受侵犯代表 disseminated histoplasmosis，常見於 HIV/AIDS（CD4 低）、移植與 TNF 抑制劑使用者；可引起全血球低下並誘發 HLH。
診斷輔助：尿液或血清 Histoplasma antigen、真菌培養（需時較長）；中重度播散型以 liposomal amphotericin B 誘導，再以 itraconazole 維持。
台灣與東南亞 HIV 病人同樣要想到 Talaromyces marneffei：酵母以分裂增殖、可見橫隔（septum），而非出芽；兩者治療相近但流行病學不同。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 Leishmania amastigotes：Leishmania 在 Giemsa 可見核加棒狀 kinetoplast、GMS 陰性且無清亮暈環；Histoplasma 無 kinetoplast、GMS/PAS 陽性。

quiz.q: 骨髓切片中組織球內大量 2–5 μm、帶清亮暈環的小圓形酵母，最可能是哪種黴菌？與 Leishmania 靠哪個構造區分？
quiz.a: Histoplasma capsulatum；Leishmania 有 kinetoplast（且 GMS 陰性）

65678.recognize_zh: 單一視野內有七、八顆嗜酸性球聚集，細胞質充滿橘紅色粗顆粒；部分核呈單葉、環狀或三葉等異常分葉，少數顆粒分布不均，提示嗜酸性球增多且可能有形態異常，但確診 CEL 仍需克隆性證據。
features: Marked increase in eosinophils, with seven to eight in a single field
Abundant coarse orange-red eosinophilic granules filling the cytoplasm
Nuclear abnormalities including non-lobated/ring-like, bilobed, and trilobed forms
Uneven granule distribution with focal clear areas in some cells
Mature forms predominate; no blasts in this field
Background red cells with some elongated/teardrop-like forms, likely partly smear-related
65678.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a striking eosinophilia, with numerous mature eosinophils clustered in a single field. The eosinophils contain abundant coarse orange-red granules, some with uneven distribution and focal clear areas, and several show abnormal nuclear segmentation including non-lobated or ring-like and trilobed nuclei. No blasts are identified in this field. Morphology alone cannot establish clonality; the findings are consistent with marked eosinophilia and, with demonstrated clonality and exclusion of reactive causes and rearranged tyrosine kinase genes, support chronic eosinophilic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils can look identical, so exclusion of secondary causes and absence of clonal markers are required.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangement
ddx.vs: These are defined by FISH or molecular detection of the gene rearrangement, not by eosinophil morphology.
Idiopathic HES has persistent eosinophilia with organ damage but no demonstrable clonality or increased blasts.
It is identified by an aberrant cytokine-producing T-cell population (e.g., CD3-negative CD4-positive) on flow cytometry.

65422.recognize_zh: 三格周邊血拼圖中的異常細胞，核深深凹陷成雙葉或摺疊狀，形似蝴蝶或「滑動重疊」（sliding）的兩葉，細胞質淡粉紫色、顆粒細小稀少甚至看不到。雙葉核加上低顆粒細胞質，是微顆粒型 APL（M3v）的線索，容易被誤認為單核球。
features: Medium to large cells with bilobed, folded or deeply cleft nuclei (butterfly/sliding-lobe configuration)
Finely dispersed chromatin with occasional small nucleoli
Moderate pale pink-lilac cytoplasm with sparse fine or dust-like granules (hypogranular)
No obvious Auer rods identified in these fields
Numerous abnormal cells in the middle panel, suggesting high leukocyte count
65422.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, composite of three fields, shows numerous atypical cells with bilobed, folded or deeply cleft nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and moderate pale cytoplasm containing only sparse fine granules. Auer rods are not evident in these fields. The bilobed hypogranular morphology is characteristic of microgranular atypical promyelocytes and can mimic monocytes. Findings are suggestive of the microgranular variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation with MPO cytochemistry, PML::RARA testing and coagulation studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Monocytic cells have grey-blue cytoplasm, are MPO weak/negative and NSE positive, whereas M3v cells are strongly MPO positive and CD34/HLA-DR negative.
Classic APL shows abundant coarse granules and frequent faggot cells, whereas these cells appear nearly agranular on light microscopy.

ddx.dx: Sézary cells or ATLL flower cells
ddx.vs: T-cell leukemias have convoluted or cerebriform nuclei with condensed chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm, not fine chromatin with pale granular cytoplasm.
CMML shows mature monocytes with clumped chromatin and dysplastic neutrophils with low blast counts.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, microgranular (hypogranular) variant — bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei with sparse granules
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指雙葉核、看似單核球的細胞問「這是 monocyte 嗎？」答案是 M3v 的異常前骨髓球，必須立即排除 APL。
M3v 常伴高白血球（典型 APL 常白血球低下），WBC >10×10⁹/L 屬 Sanz 高風險。
關鍵鑑別：MPO 強陽性（單核球性白血病弱或陰性）；流式 CD34−/HLA-DR−，CD2 常陽性，並與 bcr3 short isoform 及 FLT3-ITD 相關。
顆粒微小到光學顯微鏡看不清，故稱 microgranular；仍可在少數細胞找到 Auer rod 或 faggot cell，應仔細搜尋。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 acute monocytic leukemia 或 CMML；靠對稱雙葉／蝴蝶核、MPO 強陽性與 CD34−/HLA-DR− 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中雙葉核細胞最需排除哪種急症白血病？一個可快速區分的染色？
quiz.a: APL 微顆粒型（M3v）；MPO 細胞化學強陽性

65230.recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中出現大型、細網狀染色質、有核仁、細胞質深藍且有空泡與泡狀突起的原紅血球樣細胞（pronormoblast-like），細胞塊免疫染色 E-cadherin 陽性、p53 強烈核染色，指向紅血球系白血病的髓外浸潤。
features: Large discohesive cells, several times red cell diameter, with high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with finely reticulated/stippled chromatin and one to several distinct nucleoli
Deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with scattered small vacuoles and irregular cytoplasmic blebs/budding
Cell block H&E: scattered large discohesive atypical cells in a fibrinous background
E-cadherin shows cytoplasmic/membranous staining in the large cells; p53 shows strong diffuse nuclear staining
65230.describe_en: Cytospin preparations of pleural fluid show scattered large atypical cells with round nuclei, finely reticulated chromatin, prominent nucleoli, and a rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with occasional vacuoles and cytoplasmic blebs, morphologically resembling pronormoblasts. The corresponding cell block shows discohesive large cells in a fibrinous background, which are positive for E-cadherin and show strong nuclear p53 expression. Cohesive epithelial clusters are not seen. In a patient with TP53-mutated MDS, findings are consistent with extramedullary involvement by acute erythroid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive three-dimensional clusters and is keratin positive, whereas these cells are discohesive with erythroblast morphology and lack epithelial markers despite E-cadherin expression.

Mesothelial cells show dense two-tone cytoplasm with a lacy brush border and 'windows' between cells, lack the finely reticulated blast chromatin, and are calretinin/WT1 positive rather than showing strong p53 and erythroid markers.
Myeloblasts are usually MPO or CD34/CD117 positive and have less intensely basophilic cytoplasm, whereas these cells are MPO and CD34 negative and E-cadherin positive.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or primary effusion lymphoma
ddx.vs: Both show deeply basophilic cytoplasm, but PEL/PBL cells often have a paranuclear hof and are CD138/MUM1 (and HHV-8 for PEL) positive rather than E-cadherin positive.

65102.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 40 倍：左側可見聚集的大型細胞，核呈泡狀、核仁明顯、細胞質雙嗜性（plasmablasts／plasmacytoid immunoblasts），夾雜玻璃樣基質；右側為成熟小淋巴球，這種小群聚的漿母細胞是 HHV8 相關 MCD 的形態特徵。
features: Aggregates of large cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent central to eccentric nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with plasmacytoid features
Admixed pink hyaline stroma and scattered apoptotic bodies and clear vacuoles
Adjacent area of small mature lymphocytes with dense chromatin (mantle/interfollicular)
Clusters remain small without diffuse sheet-like effacement in this field
65102.describe_en: Lymph node section (H&E, 40x) shows small aggregates of large plasmacytoid cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, set in a background of eosinophilic hyaline material with scattered apoptotic bodies. These cells abut a zone of small mature lymphocytes. The large cells form clusters rather than confluent sheets. Findings are consistent with plasmablasts in HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease; LANA-1 immunostaining and lambda light-chain assessment are recommended.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: HHV8+ DLBCL shows confluent sheets of plasmablasts effacing the architecture rather than small aggregates within preserved follicular structures.
This entity has plasmablasts confined to germinal centers that are EBV (EBER)-positive in addition to HHV8, whereas MCD plasmablasts are EBV-negative and involve mantle zones.
Plasmablastic lymphoma forms diffuse sheets of CD138+/EBER+ cells that are HHV8-negative, unlike these LANA-1-positive CD138-negative plasmablasts.

65038.recognize_zh: 淋巴結被膜薄而無增厚，被膜下竇（subcapsular sinus）擴張，竇腔內含疏鬆排列的小淋巴球與少數紅血球；中央大片空白區兩側皆有薄被膜，可能為組織間隙，判讀時應聚焦被膜下的竇擴張。
features: Thin, non-thickened fibrous capsule without hemorrhage beneath it
Dilated subcapsular and cortical sinuses containing loosely arranged small lymphocytes
Scattered congested small vessels and extravasated red cells within sinus areas
Dense underlying cortex with a follicle-like nodule of small lymphocytes at the upper right
Large central clear space bounded by capsule on both sides, likely a tissue gap rather than a lesion
65038.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a thin, non-thickened capsule with dilated subcapsular and cortical sinuses containing loosely arranged small lymphocytes, scattered red cells and a few congested small vessels. The underlying cortex is densely cellular with small lymphocytes and a follicle-like nodule. There is no capsular fibrosis, subcapsular hemorrhage or atypical infiltrate. A large clear space in the center is bordered by capsule on both sides and most likely represents separation between tissue fragments. Findings are consistent with subcapsular sinus dilatation as part of nodal lymphangiectasia.

ddx.vs: Sinus histiocytosis distends the sinuses with abundant pale histiocytes rather than small lymphocytes and lymph.
Vascular transformation fills sinuses with red cell-rich capillary channels and fibrosis, often with capsular thickening, which is absent here.

ddx.dx: Sinusoidal lymphoma or metastatic tumor in sinuses
ddx.vs: Neoplastic sinus involvement shows cohesive tumor cells or large atypical lymphoid cells (e.g., ALK+ ALCL) within the sinuses, whereas these sinuses contain only small mature lymphocytes.

64974.recognize_zh: 拼圖中大量漿細胞：核偏位、細胞質深藍且有核旁淡染區，大小不一，其中有雙核、三核的多核漿細胞，也有核仁可見的不成熟形態，這些異型性支持腫瘤性漿細胞疾病。
features: Markedly increased plasma cells of variable size, occurring in loose sheets
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse chromatin; some larger immature forms with visible nucleoli
Abundant deep basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof; occasional flame-like reddish cytoplasmic edges
Binucleated and multinucleated (three-nucleus) plasma cells
Scattered small lymphocytes, neutrophils and erythroid precursors in the background
64974.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show a marked increase in plasma cells with variation in size, eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs. Binucleated and multinucleated plasma cells, as well as immature plasma cells with nucleoli, are present. Residual hematopoietic elements are scattered in the background. Findings are consistent with a neoplastic plasma cell proliferation (plasma cell dyscrasia/myeloma); flow cytometry showing CD38bright/CD138+/CD56+ aberrant plasma cells supports clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, lack multinucleation and nucleoli, and are polytypic and CD56-negative.
LPL shows a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P and IgM paraprotein.
Osteoblasts are larger with a hof separated from the nucleus and are CD138-negative.
Osteoclasts have many uniform nuclei in granular pink cytoplasm, and megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus, unlike multinucleated basophilic plasma cells.

64718.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片觸印片中成片中大型母細胞，核圓或稍不規則、染色質細緻、有小核仁，細胞質中等量、灰藍色且無顆粒，部分細胞質邊緣可見細小空泡，這種無顆粒的母細胞需靠免疫表型（CD123/CD4/CD56）確認 BPDCN。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large blasts with a relatively uniform appearance
Round to slightly indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm, focally with fine peripheral vacuoles
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Rare residual small lymphocyte/erythroid precursor; red cells in background
64718.describe_en: Touch imprint of the bone marrow core biopsy is dominated by a cohesive-appearing population of medium-to-large blasts. The blasts have round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, one or more small nucleoli, and a moderate rim of agranular gray-blue cytoplasm, some with fine vacuoles along the cytoplasmic margin. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not seen, and normal hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced. These agranular blasts are morphologically nonspecific; with a CD4+/CD56+/CD123+/TCF4+ phenotype and absence of MPO, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia (minimally differentiated or monocytic)
ddx.vs: AML may show granules, Auer rods or MPO/NSE positivity and expresses myeloid/monocytic markers, whereas BPDCN blasts are MPO-negative with bright CD123 and TCF4/TCL1.
Lymphoblasts usually have scantier cytoplasm and express TdT with CD19/CD79a or cCD3, markers absent in BPDCN.

In AML with pDC expansion the plasmacytoid dendritic cells are mature-appearing CD34-/CD56- and accompany a separate CD34+ myeloid blast population, unlike the uniform CD56+ neoplastic pDC blasts of BPDCN.
These require lack of lineage markers or dual lineage assignment by flow, whereas BPDCN has a defined pDC phenotype (CD123, CD303, TCF4).

64462.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成群的大型細胞，核圓或略不規則並有核仁，細胞質藍色並有紫紅色細顆粒散布、部分蓋過細胞核，形態類似異常前骨髓球；但本圖看不到典型的柴束細胞（faggot cell）或雙葉核，顆粒也不如典型高顆粒 APL 濃密。
features: Clusters of large cells, about twice the diameter of red cells, with high to moderate N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin and occasional visible nucleoli
Basophilic cytoplasm with fine purple-red azurophilic granules, in places dusted over the nucleus
No convincing bilobed (butterfly) nuclei, Auer rod bundles or faggot cells identified
Background red cells and scattered platelet clumps; a few maturing granulocytic/erythroid cells in one panel
Photomicrograph quality (soft focus, low contrast) limits assessment of granule density and Auer rods
64462.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (composite of six fields) shows clusters of large immature myeloid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli, and basophilic cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules that partly overlie the nucleus, consistent with abnormal promyelocytes. However, the cytoplasm is not densely packed with coarse granules, and bilobed nuclei, Auer rod bundles, and faggot cells are not evident in these fields; image focus also limits evaluation. The morphology is therefore only partly representative of classic hypergranular APL, and confirmation by PML::RARA FISH or RT-PCR (and strongly MPO-positive, CD34/HLA-DR-negative immunophenotype) is essential. Findings are suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: AML with maturation has blasts with scant granules and occasional single Auer rods plus maturing neutrophils, usually CD34/HLA-DR positive and PML::RARA negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocyte hyperplasia (e.g., marrow recovery after G-CSF or agranulocytosis)
ddx.vs: Recovering marrow shows normal promyelocytes with a perinuclear Golgi hof and orderly maturation to myelocytes, without Auer rods or coagulopathy.
The microgranular variant has bilobed, reniform nuclei with sparse visible granules and high WBC count, but shares PML::RARA.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules, are nonspecific esterase positive and MPO weak or negative.

64142.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨核細胞，細胞偏小，核為單一緻密圓形、不分葉，周圍有粉紫色細顆粒狀細胞質，並有不規則邊緣；與旁邊的小淋巴球相比體積只有數倍大，這種「小型單圓核巨核細胞」是 del(5q) MDS 的特徵。
features: Megakaryocyte smaller than normal, a few times the size of adjacent lymphocytes
Single round, non-lobated, dense nucleus positioned eccentrically
Moderate pink-purple finely granular cytoplasm with irregular, ruffled borders
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with granular (maturing) cytoplasm
Background small dark lymphoid/erythroid cells and red cells; limited image resolution
64142.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a small megakaryocyte with a single round, dense, non-lobated nucleus and a moderate rim of finely granular pink-purple cytoplasm with irregular borders. The granular cytoplasm indicates cytoplasmic maturation despite the absent nuclear lobation. Image resolution limits fine chromatin detail. Findings are consistent with a hypolobated/mononuclear megakaryocyte as seen in myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q).

ddx.vs: True micromegakaryocytes are near lymphocyte size with scant cytoplasm, whereas 5q- megakaryocytes are larger with more cytoplasm; both are dysplastic and require cytogenetics.
Immature forms have deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with blebs, not the pink granular cytoplasm seen here.
Plasma cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin, without platelet-type azurophilic granules.

exam.answer_en: MDS with isolated del(5q) — small megakaryocyte with a single dense round non-lobated nucleus and granular cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：與旁邊小淋巴球比較大小，問這顆細胞的身份與異常；答 hypolobated/mononuclear megakaryocyte，指向 del(5q) MDS。
MDS 的 dysplasia 門檻：單一系列 ≥10% 細胞具發育不良才算該系 dysplastic；巨核細胞建議至少評估 30 顆。
del(5q) 常見共同缺失區含 RPS14、CSNK1A1 等基因；lenalidomide 經 cereblon 促 CK1α 降解，對 del(5q) 細胞特別有效。
臨床典型：中老年女性、大球性貧血、血小板正常或增加、骨髓 blast <5%。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 micromegakaryocyte（dwarf megakaryocyte）：micromegakaryocyte 體積約 promyelocyte 大小或更小、核小、胞質少，常見於 CML 與其他 MDS；del(5q) 型則為單圓核、胞質量較多的巨核細胞。

quiz.q: Lenalidomide 對 del(5q) MDS 特別有效，其作用機轉涉及哪個蛋白的降解？
quiz.a: Cereblon 介導的 CK1α（CSNK1A1）降解。

64078.recognize_zh: 四格低倍 IHC：瀰漫單一的腫瘤細胞在 CD4（A）、CD8（B）、CD20（C）皆為陰性，只有零星背景細胞著色，而 Ki-67（D）幾乎所有核都呈棕色陽性；CD4/CD8 雙陰性加上極高增生指數，符合 T 淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Four low-power immunohistochemistry panels of a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate effacing the tissue
CD4 (A): tumor cells negative; only scattered positive background cells (histiocytes/T helper cells)
CD8 (B): tumor cells negative with rare positive cells
CD20 (C): tumor cells negative; scattered small positive background B cells
Ki-67 (D): nuclear staining in the large majority of tumor cells (estimated >90%)
Hematoxylin counterstain shows a vague nodular/lobulated pattern with thin intervening septa
64078.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stains at low power show a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate that is negative for CD4 and CD8, with only scattered positive background cells, and negative for CD20, which highlights only rare residual small B cells. Ki-67 labels the great majority of tumor nuclei, indicating a very high proliferation index. The CD4/CD8 double-negative phenotype is typical of an immature T-cell population. In combination with T-lineage markers (cytoplasmic CD3) and TdT or CD34 positivity, the findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic lymphoma; these confirmatory stains are not shown in this image.

ddx.vs: Burkitt also has Ki-67 near 100% but is CD20+/CD10+/BCL6+, TdT-negative, with a starry-sky pattern and MYC rearrangement.
Blastoid MCL is CD20+ and cyclin D1+, TdT-negative, whereas this infiltrate is CD20-negative.
Myeloid sarcoma is also CD20-negative with high Ki-67 but expresses MPO, CD33, CD117, or lysozyme and lacks cytoplasmic CD3.

ddx.dx: Thymoma (type B) with immature T cells
ddx.vs: Thymoma contains cytokeratin-positive epithelial network with polyclonal TdT+ thymocytes, typically CD4/CD8 double positive rather than double negative.

64014.recognize_zh: 兩個圓形寄生蟲幾乎把整顆紅血球填滿，胞質呈粉紫色、內有散佈的棕黑色瘧色素（hemozoin），染色質偏一側且緻密，形狀為圓形而非香蕉形，符合間日瘧（P. vivax）配子體。
features: Two round to oval intraerythrocytic parasites occupying nearly the entire red cell, with little or no residual red cell rim visible
Parasite cytoplasm purple-pink with abundant fine, diffusely scattered brown-black malarial pigment
Compact, eccentric chromatin mass without division into merozoites
Round (not crescent/banana-shaped) contour
Background red cells normocytic without other parasite stages in this field
64014.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood film (Giemsa-type stain, high power) shows two round intraerythrocytic parasites that almost completely fill their host red cells. Each has purple-pink cytoplasm with abundant fine, diffusely distributed brown pigment and a compact, eccentrically placed chromatin mass without segmentation into merozoites. The round shape excludes the crescentic gametocytes of P. falciparum. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax gametocytes.

ddx.vs: Falciparum gametocytes are crescent or banana-shaped and deform the red cell, whereas vivax gametocytes are round and fill an enlarged cell.
P. malariae gametocytes are smaller, with coarser pigment, and sit in a normal-sized or small red cell without Schuffner dots.

ddx.dx: Plasmodium vivax mature trophozoite or early schizont
ddx.vs: Trophozoites have irregular amoeboid cytoplasm with vacuoles and schizonts show multiple divided chromatin masses, rather than one compact eccentric chromatin mass.
Ovale gametocytes are similar but occupy an oval, fimbriated red cell with James dots; distinction often requires other stages or PCR.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium vivax gametocytes — round parasites nearly filling the host RBC with diffuse fine brown pigment and a single compact chromatin mass
pearls_zh: 考法：問這顆圓形、塞滿紅血球的寄生蟲是哪一期；答 gametocyte：單一未分裂的 chromatin、遍佈細小色素，與 schizont（多顆 merozoites）區分。
物種線索：P. falciparum gametocyte 為香蕉/新月形；P. vivax、ovale、malariae 的 gametocyte 為圓形，故圓形只能排除 falciparum，需配合宿主紅血球大小與 dots。
Gametocyte 是蚊子傳播期，本身不致病；P. vivax gametocytes 在病程早期即出現於周邊血，因此治療前就可能具傳染力。
Primaquine 除了清除 P. vivax hypnozoites，也具 gametocytocidal 作用；使用前需檢測 G6PD 以免溶血。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與成熟 trophozoite 或 schizont 混淆：成熟 trophozoite 形狀不規則、常有空泡；schizont 可見多顆分離的 merozoite chromatin 點；本圖圓形緻密、chromatin 單一且偏心，為 gametocyte。

quiz.q: 圖中圓形、幾乎填滿紅血球、只有一團偏心 chromatin 的寄生蟲是哪一期？為何可以排除 P. falciparum？
quiz.a: Gametocyte；falciparum 的 gametocyte 為香蕉/新月形，不是圓形。

63758.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中脂肪空泡之間有三系造血，含大量核圓而深染的紅血球前驅細胞、散在的骨髓系細胞與偶見的巨核細胞，細胞量大致正常，未見明顯異常浸潤，單看 H&E 形態缺乏特異性。
features: Bone marrow core with roughly 40–50% cellularity interspersed with adipocytes
Trilineage hematopoiesis with maturing erythroid, granulocytic and megakaryocytic elements
Numerous erythroid precursors with small round dark nuclei, some in clusters
Scattered megakaryocytes with normal-appearing lobulated nuclei
Interstitial red cells; no abnormal infiltrate, fibrosis or granulomas in this field
63758.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, 40x) shows marrow with approximately 40–50% cellularity and trilineage hematopoiesis among adipocytes. Erythroid precursors with small, round, hyperchromatic nuclei are readily identified, together with maturing granulocytic cells and scattered morphologically unremarkable megakaryocytes. No abnormal infiltrate, fibrosis or granulomas are seen in this field. The H&E morphology is nonspecific, and evaluation of erythroid precursors requires immunohistochemistry (glycophorin A, spectrin) and clinical correlation with the red cell disorder under investigation.

ddx.vs: Morphologically similar; any erythroid membrane or hemoglobin defect is not detectable on H&E and requires ancillary studies.
Shows a clearly increased erythroid-to-myeloid ratio with erythroid colonies dominating the marrow.
Shows prominent binucleated and multinucleated erythroid precursors, better seen on aspirate smears.
Small lymphocytes with dark nuclei can mimic erythroid precursors but form aggregates and are CD20 or CD3 positive, glycophorin A negative.

63694.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的紅血球中央有一顆單一、小而圓、深紫色的緻密包涵體（Howell-Jolly body）；這顆紅血球本身略帶藍灰色（多染性）。
features: Single small (~1 µm), round, dense, dark purple inclusion within a red cell
Inclusion is solitary and sharply defined, not refractile
Host cell slightly larger with bluish-gray (polychromatophilic) tint and no central pallor
Another polychromatophilic red cell in the lower field
Background red cells normochromic without other inclusions; rare platelet
63694.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with occasional polychromatophilic cells. One polychromatophilic red cell (arrow) contains a single small, round, densely basophilic inclusion consistent with a Howell-Jolly body. No basophilic stippling, Pappenheimer body clusters, or intraerythrocytic parasites are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with Howell-Jolly body formation, which suggests hyposplenism or asplenia, or less often megaloblastic or dyserythropoietic states, in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are multiple, smaller, irregular granules clustered at the cell periphery and are Prussian blue positive, whereas a Howell-Jolly body is a single larger round dot.
An overlying platelet is larger, granular pink-purple, often has a clear halo, and lies in a different focal plane.
A Plasmodium ring has a thin blue cytoplasmic ring attached to the chromatin dot, not a solid dot alone.
Stippling consists of numerous fine punctate granules distributed throughout the red cell rather than one discrete inclusion.

exam.answer_en: Howell-Jolly body — single small round dense basophilic DNA remnant in a red cell, suggesting hyposplenism/asplenia
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指紅血球內單一深紫色圓點，問成分與臨床意義；答核 DNA 殘餘（Feulgen 陽性、Prussian blue 陰性），代表脾功能低下或無脾。
常見原因：脾切除後、鐮刀型貧血自體脾梗塞（autosplenectomy）、celiac disease 相關脾功能低下；巨母細胞性貧血與骨髓造血不良也可出現。
臨床意義：無脾病人有 overwhelming post-splenectomy infection 風險，應接種肺炎鏈球菌、b 型嗜血桿菌與腦膜炎雙球菌疫苗，發燒須積極處理。
延伸：正常新生兒可少量出現；若病人未脾切除卻大量出現，要回頭找脾功能低下原因。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為重疊在紅血球上的血小板：血小板較大、顆粒狀、周圍常有淡暈且不在同一焦平面；Howell-Jolly body 小而圓、均質深染、邊界銳利。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指紅血球內的深紫色圓點是什麼？最常提示哪種臨床狀態？
quiz.a: Howell-Jolly body（DNA 殘餘）；脾功能低下或無脾（如脾切除後）

63566.recognize_zh: 箭頭處巨噬細胞整個胞質被大量無色、折光、邊界銳利的長方形與多角形結晶塞滿，只剩中央一小塊被擠壓的紫色核；這種不染色的多角形結晶是胱胺酸症（cystinosis）的胱胺酸結晶。
features: Macrophage packed with numerous colorless, refractile, sharply angulated crystals (rectangular, hexagonal and polygonal)
Crystals do not take up stain and appear as clear outlines with dark refractile edges
Small compressed, dark purple nucleus in the center, partly obscured by crystals
Surrounding marrow cells (erythroid precursors, myeloid cells, plasma cell) without crystals
Background red cells overlaid with fine dark granular deposits, most consistent with stain precipitate
63566.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows a macrophage whose cytoplasm is filled with numerous colorless, refractile, polygonal and rectangular crystals that do not take up stain, with a small compressed central nucleus. Adjacent hematopoietic cells are unremarkable and do not contain crystals. Fine dark granular deposits over the red cells likely represent stain precipitate. Findings are consistent with crystal-laden macrophages of cystinosis; confirmation by leukocyte cystine content or CTNS gene testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Light-chain crystals are eosinophilic/pink needle-like or rhomboid in histiocytes associated with a clonal plasma cell or B-cell population, rather than colorless hexagonal cystine crystals.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are slender bipyramidal hexagonal needles derived from eosinophils, usually extracellular and pink-staining.
Oxalate crystals are birefringent, yellowish, rosette or fan-shaped deposits often with foreign-body giant cell reaction and marrow fibrosis.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm without discrete refractile polygonal crystals.

63502.recognize_zh: A–F 格周邊血嗜鹼性球的深紫色粗顆粒大部分消失，細胞質留下許多空泡狀的空顆粒；G 格骨髓見異常嗜鹼性細胞與嗜酸性球，H 格 CD123 染色陽性，I–J 流式顯示 CD123 強陽性、HLA-DR 陰性族群，符合骨髓增生性腫瘤中的去顆粒嗜鹼性球（degranulated basophils）。
features: A-C: basophils with partial degranulation, residual coarse dark purple granules mixed with clear empty granule spaces
D-F: basophils with near-complete degranulation, cytoplasm filled with clear vacuole-like empty granules and lobulated nuclei
G: hypercellular marrow (H&E) with eosinophils and abnormal mononuclear basophilic cells
H: IHC CD123 highlights numerous abnormal basophils in the marrow
I-J: flow cytometry shows a basophil population in the low-SSC blast region of CD45/SSC with bright CD123
63502.describe_en: This composite figure shows peripheral blood basophils (A-F) with abnormal granulation: panels A-C show partial degranulation with residual coarse purple granules, and panels D-F show near-complete degranulation with cytoplasm occupied by clear, empty granule spaces around lobulated nuclei. The bone marrow biopsy (G) is hypercellular with eosinophils and abnormal basophilic cells, which are highlighted by CD123 immunohistochemistry (H). Flow cytometry (I-J) shows basophils falling within the low side-scatter blast gate on CD45 versus SSC with bright CD123 expression, a pitfall that may lead to overcounting blasts. Findings are consistent with a clonal basophilia with dysplastic, degranulated basophils in an advanced-phase myeloproliferative neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Toxic neutrophils have pink cytoplasm with fine toxic granules and small vacuoles plus segmented nuclei, whereas these cells show large empty basophil granule spaces and express CD123 without MPO.

ddx.dx: CML in chronic or accelerated phase
ddx.vs: CML also shows basophilia, so BCR::ABL1 testing is required, and it was negative here with JAK2-positive MPN history.
Mast cells have round nuclei and are tryptase and CD117 positive with CD25 aberrancy, while basophils have lobulated nuclei and are CD123 positive with weak or absent CD117.
Degranulated basophils fall in the CD45-dim/low-SSC blast gate, so CD123-bright/HLA-DR-negative gating and CD34 IHC are needed to avoid overcounting blasts.

63310.recognize_zh: 整片骨髓幾乎被單一型態的小型成熟淋巴球取代，核質比高、染色質呈塊狀斑駁的「足球樣」（soccer ball chromatin）、核仁不明顯、胞質極少，符合慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）。
features: Sheets of monomorphic small to slightly enlarged lymphoid cells replacing normal hematopoietic elements
High N:C ratio with scant pale cytoplasm, often barely visible
Round nuclei with coarsely clumped, block-like chromatin alternating with paler areas (soccer ball pattern)
Nucleoli inconspicuous in most cells; a minority of larger cells with paler, more open chromatin
Very few residual myeloid or erythroid precursors in the field
63310.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (MGG) is markedly cellular and shows near-total replacement of normal hematopoiesis by a monomorphic population of small mature-appearing lymphocytes. The cells have a high N:C ratio, scant cytoplasm, round nuclei with coarsely clumped 'soccer ball' chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. Occasional slightly larger cells with more open chromatin are present, but there is no dominant population of prolymphocytes or blasts. Residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors are sparse. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23+, dim sIg, CD200+) is recommended.

ddx.vs: MCL cells tend to have more irregular or cleaved nuclei with less block-like chromatin, and are CD5+ but CD23-/cyclin D1+/SOX11+ by ancillary studies.
MZL cells often show more abundant pale cytoplasm, villous projections or plasmacytoid features and are usually CD5-/CD23-.
FL cells are small cleaved centrocytes with notched nuclei and form paratrabecular aggregates, and are CD10+/BCL6+ rather than CD5+/CD23+.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic transformation / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes are larger with moderately condensed chromatin and a single prominent central nucleolus, which is lacking in most cells here.

exam.answer_en: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia in marrow — monomorphic small lymphocytes with clumped 'soccer ball' chromatin replacing hematopoiesis
pearls_zh: 考法：指小淋巴球問染色質型態（soccer ball / block-like chromatin）與確認診斷的下一步（flow cytometry）；周邊血抹片另一常考點是 smudge cells。
Flow 表型：CD19+、CD5+、CD23+、CD200+，sIg、CD20、CD79b 弱表現，FMC7−；MCL 則 CD23−、cyclin D1+、SOX11+。
iwCLL 門檻：周邊血 clonal B cell ≥5×10⁹/L；低於此值且無淋巴結腫大、器官腫大或血球減少者屬 monoclonal B-cell lymphocytosis（MBL）。
治療前必查預後標記：del(17p)/TP53 突變與 unmutated IGHV 預後較差；FISH 最常見異常為 del(13q)。
淋巴結快速腫大、LDH 上升或 B 症狀時要想到 Richter transformation（多為 DLBCL），需切片確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 mantle cell lymphoma 白血病期混淆：MCL 核較不規則、有切跡，flow 為 CD5+ 但 CD23−、cyclin D1+；形態相近時一定要以 flow/IHC 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中小淋巴球的染色質型態稱為什麼？確認 CLL 最關鍵的 flow 標記組合為何？
quiz.a: Soccer ball（塊狀）chromatin；CD19+ B cells 共表現 CD5 與 CD23（sIg 弱）

63246.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片（May-Grünwald-Giemsa）中兩個淋巴樣細胞，上方細胞核圓、染色質均勻，細胞質中等量淡灰藍色，周緣有細小毛狀突起、無顆粒；這種細胞質邊緣毛糙的淋巴球即毛細胞（hairy cell），支持毛細胞白血病，但影像解析度有限。
features: Two mononuclear lymphoid cells in a red cell background (image captured through the eyepiece; resolution limited)
Upper cell: medium-sized, round nucleus with homogeneous chromatin, no obvious nucleolus
Moderate rim of pale gray-blue, agranular cytoplasm with fine, circumferential hair-like projections
Lower cell: smaller with scant cytoplasm and slightly ragged border, more condensed chromatin
Red cells show rouleaux-like overlapping in thicker areas; no granulocytes in this field
63246.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows two atypical lymphoid cells in a red cell background. The larger cell has a round nucleus with homogeneous chromatin finer than that of a mature lymphocyte, no obvious nucleolus, and a moderate rim of pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections; the second cell is smaller with scant cytoplasm and a slightly irregular border. Image resolution limits assessment of fine cytoplasmic detail. The findings are suggestive of circulating hairy cells; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: SMZL villous lymphocytes show short villi concentrated at one or both poles and are CD103-negative, whereas hairy cells have circumferential projections and are CD103+/CD25+.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-variant cells have a conspicuous central nucleolus and lack CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.
Artifactual frayed borders occur in thick or slowly dried areas and affect all cells, while true hairy projections are fine, regular and seen in well-spread monolayer areas.
Reactive lymphocytes have deeply basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells rather than pale cytoplasm with fine hair-like projections.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia (suggestive) — circulating lymphoid cell with pale agranular cytoplasm and fine circumferential hair-like projections
pearls_zh: 考法：指上方細胞問「毛細胞」辨識重點：核圓至腎形、染色質均勻、核仁不明顯，胞質淡灰藍無顆粒，周緣一整圈細絲狀突起。
此圖解析度有限，確認需 flow cytometry：CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123 陽性，加上 BRAF V600E 檢測；細胞化學 TRAP 陽性為傳統考點。
毛狀突起在乾燥慢或厚片區會被壓扁或出現假影，應在薄的單層區判讀；phase contrast 或新鮮抹片較易看清。
HCL 周邊血中毛細胞常很少，典型表現是全血球減少伴 monocytopenia 與脾腫大，而非明顯淋巴球增多。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 SMZL 的 villous lymphocytes 或抹片假影混淆：SMZL 絨毛短且集中在兩極、CD103−；假影的毛糙邊緣會出現在同區所有細胞上。

quiz.q: 要確認圖中細胞為 hairy cell，flow cytometry 應檢查哪些標記？應加做哪個分子檢測？
quiz.a: CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123；BRAF V600E

63182.recognize_zh: 低倍下幾乎每顆紅血球形狀都不同：橢圓形、淚滴狀、碎片與鋸齒狀細胞混雜，並有許多深染的小圓形紅血球或碎片，只有一顆嗜中性球，呈現嚴重的紅血球大小不等與異形。
features: Marked anisocytosis with admixed normal-sized, oval and very small red cells
Severe poikilocytosis: elliptocytes, teardrop cells, fragments and crenated/spiculated forms
Numerous small dense microspherocyte-like cells and fragments (some may be platelets)
Rare leukocytes; a single neutrophil in the field
Low-power view limits assessment of fine inclusions
63182.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows severe red cell anisopoikilocytosis. There are numerous elliptocytes, teardrop cells, red cell fragments and spiculated forms, together with many small dense microspherocyte-like cells and fragments. Leukocytes are sparse, with a single neutrophil in the field. Fine red cell inclusions cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the context of a myelodysplastic neoplasm with complex karyotype, findings are consistent with marked dyserythropoietic red cell changes.

ddx.vs: MAHA shows predominant schistocytes with helmet forms and marked thrombocytopenia with hemolysis markers rather than a broad mixture of elliptocytes and teardrops.
HPP presents from childhood with extreme microcytosis, budding and fragments and abnormal thermal sensitivity/spectrin studies, not in an adult with clonal cytogenetics.
Myelofibrosis also shows teardrops but typically has leukoerythroblastosis, splenomegaly and reticulin fibrosis on marrow biopsy.
Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytes with pencil cells, lacking the dense microspherocytes and fragments seen here.

63118.recognize_zh: 大量淡染的標靶細胞與小球性紅血球為背景，其間夾雜少數細長鐮刀細胞；另見一顆正常分葉的嗜中性球與散在血小板，符合鐮刀型 β 地中海型貧血的血片。
features: Numerous target cells on a background of microcytic, hypochromic red cells
Scattered sickle cells with elongated, crescent shapes
Anisocytosis with occasional larger cells
One red cell with a small dense dot, possibly a Howell-Jolly body or an overlying platelet
Normal-appearing segmented neutrophil and adequate scattered platelets
63118.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows predominantly microcytic, hypochromic red cells with numerous target cells, anisocytosis, and scattered sickle cells. A single red cell contains a small dense dot that may represent a Howell-Jolly body or an overlying platelet, not resolvable at this image quality. A segmented neutrophil with normal morphology and adequate platelets are present. Findings are suggestive of a compound sickling hemoglobinopathy, consistent with sickle β-thalassemia in the context of the confirmed mutation analysis.

ddx.vs: HbSS usually has normocytic indices with more numerous sickle cells and Howell-Jolly bodies from autosplenectomy, whereas microcytosis with hypochromia favors Sβ-thalassemia; HPLC (HbA2 elevated, HbA absent/reduced) and molecular testing separate them.
HbSC shows many target cells and characteristic HbC crystals and folded/boat-shaped cells, with fewer classic sickle cells and HbC on HPLC.
β-thalassemia shows microcytosis, target cells, and nucleated red cells but no sickle cells, and HbS is absent on HPLC.
Iron deficiency has microcytic hypochromic cells and pencil cells but lacks sickle cells and prominent target cells, with low ferritin.

63054.recognize_zh: 拼圖集合 COVID-19 周邊血液變化：A–C 為細胞質灰藍、帶空泡且核摺疊的反應性單核球／淋巴球，G–K 為細胞質深藍的漿細胞樣淋巴球（K 箭頭），另見嗜中性球異常、凋亡細胞（F）及大型或去顆粒血小板與血小板團塊（L–N）。
features: Panels A-C: large reactive mononuclear cells with folded/indented nuclei and abundant gray-blue, vacuolated cytoplasm
Panels G, H, J, K (arrow): plasmacytoid/reactive lymphocytes with intensely basophilic cytoplasm and condensed chromatin
Panels D, E: neutrophils with vacuolated cytoplasm and abnormal nuclear shapes, alongside a small cell with a dense round nucleus
Panel F: apoptotic cell with a pyknotic dense nucleus and granular cytoplasm
Panels L-N: large, hypogranular platelets and a platelet clump
Background red cells without significant fragmentation
63054.describe_en: Composite of peripheral blood smear images shows a spectrum of reactive changes. There are large mononuclear cells with folded nuclei and abundant vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm, and several plasmacytoid lymphocytes with deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Neutrophils show cytoplasmic vacuolation and nuclear irregularities, and an apoptotic cell with a pyknotic nucleus is noted. Platelets include large, hypogranular forms and clumps. Findings are consistent with reactive morphologic changes of SARS-CoV-2 infection; no definitive neoplastic population is identified.

ddx.vs: Mononucleosis shows predominantly large reactive lymphocytes with cytoplasm scalloping around red cells, whereas COVID-19 more often shows plasmacytoid lymphocytes with lymphopenia; serology/PCR distinguishes.
Circulating clonal plasma cells are numerous, monomorphic and light-chain restricted, whereas these plasmacytoid lymphocytes are few, variable and polytypic.
Blasts have fine chromatin, nucleoli and a high N:C ratio, unlike the condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm of these reactive cells.
Bacterial sepsis shows toxic granulation, Dohle bodies and left shift with neutrophilia; distinction is clinical and microbiologic.

62990.recognize_zh: 油鏡下 CD25 在許多卵圓至紡錘形、核呈卵圓形的細胞呈細顆粒狀細胞質/膜染色；肥大細胞表現 CD25 屬異常表現，是系統性肥大細胞增生症的次要診斷標準之一。
features: Spindled to oval cells with elongated oval nuclei and moderate cytoplasm
Finely granular membranous and cytoplasmic CD25 staining in many of the elongated cells
Nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli; mild nuclear irregularity
Intermixed CD25-negative cells with oval nuclei
Interstitial, loosely cohesive arrangement of positive cells
62990.describe_en: CD25 immunostain at oil immersion shows numerous spindled to oval cells with elongated nuclei and moderate cytoplasm displaying finely granular membranous and cytoplasmic positivity. Negative cells are admixed. In the context of a CD117/tryptase-positive spindled mast cell infiltrate, aberrant CD25 expression by mast cells is consistent with neoplastic mast cells of systemic mastocytosis (minor diagnostic criterion).

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are round, scattered and CD25-negative.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia or ATLL infiltrate
ddx.vs: These CD25+ lymphoid cells are round, CD117/tryptase-negative and express B-cell (HCL) or CD4 T-cell (ATLL) markers.
Activated lymphocytes are round and CD3+, and histiocytes are CD68/CD163+, while neoplastic mast cells co-express CD25 with CD117 and tryptase.

62862.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的 Perls 普魯士藍鐵染色（紅色對比染色），骨髓顆粒（particle）中央有大片密集的藍黑色含鐵血黃素沉積，代表儲存鐵明顯增加，常見於鐵粒母細胞性貧血等鐵利用障礙。
features: Bone marrow particle with dense, coarse blue-black hemosiderin deposits
Iron deposits abundant and confluent within the particle stroma (increased storage iron)
Red counterstain of surrounding cells and blood background
Individual erythroblast (sideroblastic) iron cannot be assessed at this magnification
62862.describe_en: Perls Prussian blue stain of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a marrow particle containing abundant, coarse and confluent blue-black hemosiderin deposits, indicating markedly increased storage iron (approximately grade 5-6 on a semiquantitative scale). The surrounding cellular background is counterstained red. Erythroblast iron and ring sideroblasts cannot be assessed at this low magnification and require high-power examination of cellular trails. Increased storage iron is consistent with a disorder of iron utilization such as sideroblastic anemia in this clinical context, and excludes iron deficiency.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows absent stainable iron in marrow particles, the opposite of the abundant deposits here.
Storage iron is normal to increased but sideroblasts are reduced and ring sideroblasts absent on high-power assessment.

ddx.dx: Transfusional iron overload or hereditary hemochromatosis
ddx.vs: Storage iron is also increased, so distinction requires history, serum studies and high-power sideroblast evaluation rather than particle iron alone.

62798.recognize_zh: 未染色的濕片（鐮刀試驗，sickling test）中，絕大多數紅血球變成新月形、鐮刀形或尖角狀，只有少數仍保持圓盤狀，表示去氧狀態下HbS聚合，支持鐮刀型血紅素的存在。
features: Unstained wet-mount preparation viewed under reduced light with refractile, greenish-grey red cells
Majority of red cells transformed into crescent, sickle and holly-leaf shapes with pointed ends
Few residual round discoid cells
Occasional small debris/crystal-like particles in the background
No nuclear or leukocyte detail assessable in this preparation
62798.describe_en: An unstained wet-mount sickling preparation shows that the majority of red cells have assumed elongated crescent, sickle and holly-leaf shapes with pointed ends, with only occasional residual discoid cells. This appearance reflects polymerization of deoxygenated hemoglobin S under a reducing agent. A sickling test does not distinguish sickle cell trait from sickle cell disease. Findings are consistent with a positive sickling test, indicating the presence of hemoglobin S; quantitation by HPLC or electrophoresis is required for genotype assignment.

ddx.vs: Trait also gives a positive sickling test; separation from HbSS requires HPLC or electrophoresis to quantify HbS versus HbA.
Artifactual cells show short, regular spicules around a round cell rather than elongated crescents with two pointed ends.
Elliptocytes are smooth oval or cigar-shaped with rounded ends and do not form sharp crescents under deoxygenation.

62734.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一條分枝狀、細長的管狀結構，由一排排梭形、雪茄狀的核沿長軸平行排列構成，胞質淡紫色、邊界不清，是被抽吸出來的微血管碎片（capillary endothelial cells），不要誤認為腫瘤細胞團。
features: Branching elongated tubular fragment at low power (200x)
Spindle-shaped, oval to cigar-shaped nuclei aligned parallel to the long axis
Bland, evenly distributed chromatin without nucleoli or mitoses
Syncytial pale violet cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Background of dispersed hematopoietic cells and red cells
62734.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a branching, elongated tubular fragment composed of cohesive spindle cells with oval to cigar-shaped nuclei oriented parallel to the long axis. The nuclei are bland with smooth chromatin and no nucleoli, and the cytoplasm is pale and syncytial without distinct cell borders. Scattered hematopoietic cells are present in the background. Findings are consistent with a capillary fragment lined by endothelial cells, a normal constituent of marrow aspirates.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma clusters are cohesive three-dimensional groups of large pleomorphic cells with high N:C ratio and nucleoli, not linear branching tubes of bland spindle nuclei.
Fibroblasts form looser, non-tubular clusters of spindle cells with wispy cytoplasm and may have a fibrillary matrix, rather than a vessel-shaped branching structure.
Sarcoma cells show nuclear atypia, hyperchromasia and mitoses and do not form orderly capillary tubes.

62670.recognize_zh: PAX5 染色中，深棕色核陽性的是散在的小型 B 細胞，而右側細胞質豐富、界線清楚的大型腫瘤細胞核為陰性；腫瘤細胞失去 PAX5 等 B 細胞標記是 PEL 的特點。
features: Strong nuclear PAX5 staining in numerous small background B cells
Large tumor cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and distinct cell borders are PAX5-negative
Negative large cells form a cohesive cluster at right and are scattered elsewhere
Weak non-specific cytoplasmic/dendritic staining in the background
Positive small cells serve as an internal positive control
62670.describe_en: PAX5 immunohistochemistry shows strong nuclear staining in numerous small background B lymphocytes, which serve as an internal positive control. The large neoplastic cells, with abundant pale cytoplasm, distinct borders and vesicular nuclei, lack nuclear PAX5 and are best seen as a cohesive cluster on the right. Findings demonstrate loss of the B-cell program in the tumor cells, consistent with primary effusion lymphoma (extracavitary) in conjunction with HHV8 positivity.

ddx.vs: Large cells retain nuclear PAX5 and CD20 expression.
Also PAX5/CD20-negative, but HHV8 (LANA-1) is negative.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells show weak (dim) rather than absent nuclear PAX5, with CD30 and CD15 positivity.

62606.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見密集深藍色的單一細胞浸潤，由下方往上侵入並分割粉紅色的平滑肌層（固有肌層），呈破壞性浸潤，是腫塊型 PTLD 的結構線索。
features: Dense sheet-like cellular infiltrate occupying the lower half of the field
Infiltrate dissects and splays smooth muscle bundles of the muscularis propria
Monotonous small-to-intermediate cells at this power, without follicles
Scattered small vessels; no necrosis or granulomas evident
62606.describe_en: Low-power section shows a diffuse, dense cellular infiltrate that extends into and dissects the smooth muscle bundles of the bowel wall, effacing normal architecture. The infiltrate appears monotonous without lymphoid follicles, and no necrosis is seen. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification; high-power views and immunostains show plasma cells that are CD20-negative, MUM1-positive, EBER-positive and light-chain restricted. Findings are consistent with a destructive monomorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, plasmacytoma-like type.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (monomorphic PTLD, DLBCL type)
ddx.vs: DLBCL shows large CD20+ centroblasts/immunoblasts, whereas this lesion is composed of CD20-negative plasma cells at high power.

ddx.dx: Chronic inflammatory bowel disease with transmural inflammation
ddx.vs: Inflammation is polymorphous with neutrophils, lymphoid aggregates and polytypic plasma cells, rather than a monotonous destructive sheet.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma has CD20+ marginal zone B cells and lymphoepithelial lesions accompanying the plasma cells.

62542.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中造血組織與脂肪交錯，可見分散的紅系聚落與顆粒球，巨核細胞稀少；本視野細胞量並未明顯降低，單憑此圖無法確認 RCC，需配合抹片中的發育不良特徵。
features: Marrow space between bony trabeculae with interspersed fat cells; cellularity roughly moderate in this field
Trilineage hematopoiesis with scattered dark erythroid clusters and granulocytic cells
Megakaryocytes sparse and difficult to identify at this magnification
No sheets of blasts or abnormal infiltrate
62542.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low-to-medium power shows marrow spaces between bony trabeculae with interspersed adipocytes and trilineage hematopoiesis. Erythroid clusters and maturing granulocytes are present, whereas megakaryocytes are sparse. Cellularity in this field is not markedly decreased, which may occur in a minority of refractory cytopenia of childhood cases, but hypocellularity elsewhere cannot be excluded from a single field. No abnormal infiltrate is identified. Findings are nonspecific in isolation and must be integrated with aspirate dysplasia, blast count and cytogenetics.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia would show a markedly hypocellular, predominantly fatty marrow, unlike the preserved hematopoietic tissue in this field.
Normal pediatric marrow has adequate megakaryocytes and no dysplasia; distinction requires the aspirate and clinical cytopenias.
MDS-EB requires at least 5% blasts in the marrow, typically shown by CD34 immunostaining, which is not assessable on this H&E field.

62478.recognize_zh: CD10 染色下，擴大的淋巴結節整體呈陰性，只有結節間紅髓內散在的陽性細胞（多為顆粒球等非淋巴細胞），沒有 CD10 陽性的濾泡中心，排除濾泡性淋巴瘤，支持脾邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Large lymphoid nodules entirely CD10 negative
No CD10-positive germinal center or follicle center cell population
Scattered CD10-positive cells confined to internodular red pulp/cords, likely neutrophils or stromal cells
Low-power pattern of expanded nodules separated by red pulp
62478.describe_en: CD10 immunohistochemical stain on spleen at low power shows expanded lymphoid nodules that are uniformly negative, with no CD10-positive germinal centers. Scattered positive cells are restricted to the internodular red pulp and most likely represent neutrophils or stromal elements, serving as an internal control. Lack of CD10 expression by the nodular B cells argues against follicular lymphoma and Burkitt lymphoma and supports splenic marginal zone lymphoma in context.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma nodules would be CD10 positive, often with interfollicular spillover of CD10-positive cells.
HCL can be CD10 positive in a minority of cases but diffusely infiltrates red pulp rather than forming white pulp nodules.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, GCB type
ddx.vs: GCB-type DLBCL forms sheets of large CD10-positive cells rather than CD10-negative nodules of small lymphocytes.

62414.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以小淋巴球為主，其中夾雜帶有偏心核、少量藍色細胞質的漿細胞樣淋巴球（黃箭頭）、漿細胞（黑箭頭），以及充滿深紫色顆粒的肥大細胞（紅箭頭）；小淋巴球、漿細胞樣分化加上肥大細胞增多是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤（lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma）的典型組合。
features: Increased small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei and condensed chromatin
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and a rim of basophilic cytoplasm (yellow arrow)
Mature plasma cell with eccentric nucleus and abundant blue cytoplasm (black arrow)
Mast cell packed with dark purple metachromatic granules (red arrow)
Spectrum of lymphocyte-to-plasma cell differentiation in the same cluster
62414.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increase in small mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin. Admixed are plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and modest basophilic cytoplasm, occasional mature plasma cells, and a mast cell with densely packed metachromatic granules. Blasts and large atypical lymphoid cells are not seen in this field. In the context of an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P mutation, the findings are consistent with involvement by lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL can look identical, so separation depends on clinical distribution, absence of MYD88 L265P in most cases, and lack of a prominent IgM paraprotein syndrome.
CLL cells have clumped soccer-ball chromatin with smudge cells, lack plasmacytoid differentiation, and co-express CD5 and CD23.
Myeloma shows sheets of clonal plasma cells without an accompanying clonal small B-lymphocyte population and usually lacks MYD88 mutation.

exam.answer_en: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma — small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with increased mast cells in marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會分別指黃箭頭（plasmacytoid lymphocyte）、黑箭頭（plasma cell）與紅箭頭（mast cell），問三者組合提示何病：LPL。
分子：MYD88 L265P 見於絕大多數 LPL/Waldenström macroglobulinemia；CXCR4 突變約見於三分之一，與 BTK inhibitor 反應較差相關。
LPL 合併 IgM 單株蛋白且侵犯骨髓即為 Waldenström macroglobulinemia；表型 CD19+、CD20+、CD5−、CD10−，漿細胞多為 CD19+、CD45+（異於 myeloma）。
急症：IgM 高黏滯症候群（視力模糊、出血、神經症狀）需緊急 plasmapheresis；使用 rituximab 可能出現 IgM flare。
Plasma cell 內可見 Dutcher bodies（核內 PAS+ 包涵體）；也要留意 cryoglobulinemia、cold agglutinin、anti-MAG 周邊神經病變等 IgM 相關表現。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為伴漿細胞分化的 marginal zone lymphoma：形態可幾乎相同，靠 MYD88 L265P、IgM 單株蛋白與臨床分布區分；若為 CD5+/CD23+ 則考慮 CLL。

quiz.q: 圖中紅箭頭所指充滿深紫色顆粒的細胞是什麼？此疾病最常見的突變為何？
quiz.a: Mast cell；MYD88 L265P

62350.recognize_zh: 高倍下萎縮生發中心內有大塊粉紅色透明化物質與穿入的血管，外圍小淋巴球沿著中心呈規則的同心圓層層排列（洋蔥皮外觀），這種組合就是透明血管型 Castleman 病。
features: Atretic germinal center containing irregular hyalinized eosinophilic deposits around traversing vessels
Scattered follicular dendritic cells with oval vesicular nuclei within the regressed center
Small round lymphocytes in tight concentric layers around the center (onion-skin mantle)
Bland lymphocytes with dense chromatin and scant cytoplasm; no atypia
Interfollicular small vessels with plump endothelium at the upper right
62350.describe_en: High-power view shows an atretic germinal center composed of hyalinized eosinophilic material surrounding penetrating vessels, with scattered follicular dendritic cells. The surrounding mantle zone is composed of small, bland lymphocytes arranged in tight concentric layers, producing an onion-skin appearance. Interfollicular vessels with plump endothelial cells are seen at the periphery. No large atypical cells or sheets of plasma cells are present. Findings are consistent with Castleman disease, hyaline vascular type.

ddx.vs: MCL cells are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD5-positive with light-chain restriction, whereas the onion-skin mantle cells here are polyclonal IgD-positive B cells.
IgG4-related disease shows numerous interfollicular IgG4-positive plasma cells (IgG4/IgG ratio >40%) and eosinophils, often with elevated serum IgG4.
iMCD usually shows plasma cell-rich interfollicular sheets with systemic inflammatory symptoms, and the diagnosis requires clinical and laboratory criteria rather than morphology alone.

exam.answer_en: Hyaline vascular Castleman disease — atretic hyalinized germinal center with penetrating vessels and tight onion-skin mantle of bland lymphocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍確認外套層小淋巴球無異型、無核分裂，問是否為淋巴瘤：否，屬反應/局部淋巴增生性疾病。
FDC 可增生甚至有 dysplastic 形態；若出現片狀梭形 FDC 並 CD21/CD23/CD35 陽性，要注意 FDC sarcoma。
濾泡間可見 plasmacytoid dendritic cells 聚集；漿細胞片狀增生則提示 plasma cell 型，較常見於 MCD。
UCD 若無法切除，可考慮 rituximab、放射治療或栓塞等減積處置（依腫塊位置評估）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 透明化生發中心易誤判為 amyloid 或 hyalinized vessel 的非特異變化：Castleman 的透明物位於萎縮生發中心並伴血管穿入與同心圓外套層，Congo red 陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中外圍規則同心排列的小淋巴球屬於濾泡哪一區？這些細胞是否呈 clonal？
quiz.a: Mantle zone；否，為 polyclonal 反應性淋巴球

62286.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見多個大型、圓形的紅血球前驅細胞，核染色質細緻開放、周圍一圈深藍色細胞質；較成熟的紅血球前驅細胞仍保留點狀開放染色質，部分小細胞核形不規則，呈現核質發育不同步，符合巨母紅血球性貧血。
features: Large round megaloblastic proerythroblasts/basophilic erythroblasts with fine open chromatin and a thin rim of deep blue cytoplasm
Polychromatic erythroblasts retaining stippled 'checkerboard' open chromatin despite hemoglobinizing cytoplasm
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony across the maturation series
Occasional late erythroid precursors with irregular or lobulated nuclear contours
Macrocytic red cells in the background
62286.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid hyperplasia with numerous enlarged erythroid precursors. The early forms are large round cells with finely dispersed open chromatin and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, while more mature polychromatic erythroblasts retain stippled open chromatin, demonstrating nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. Some late precursors show irregular, lobulated nuclear contours, and background red cells are macrocytic. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis due to vitamin B12 or folate deficiency; correlation with serum B12, folate, methylmalonic acid and homocysteine is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proerythroblasts with vacuolated cytoplasm without progressive maturation, and does not respond to vitamin replacement.

Myeloblasts have finer chromatin with nucleoli and lighter cytoplasm with granules or Auer rods and are MPO/CD34 positive, whereas these cells show erythroid deep blue cytoplasm and E-cadherin/CD71 positivity.
MDS megaloblastoid change is accompanied by dysplastic megakaryocytes and neutrophils, ring sideroblasts or clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, with normal B12/folate.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia — enlarged erythroid precursors with open stippled chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony
pearls_zh: 考法：指大型、深藍細胞質、染色質細緻的早期紅血球前驅細胞，問是否為母細胞：不是，是 megaloblastic proerythroblast/basophilic erythroblast。
與 pure erythroid leukemia 鑑別：megaloblastic anemia 有完整成熟序列且各階段皆 asynchrony，補充 B12/folate 後迅速改善；應在診斷血液腫瘤前先查 B12、folate。
檢驗：serum B12、folate；B12 邊界值時測 methylmalonic acid（B12 缺乏才升高）與 homocysteine（兩者皆升高）。
Pernicious anemia：anti-intrinsic factor antibody 特異性高、anti-parietal cell antibody 敏感但特異性低；台灣亦需考慮胃切除術後。
exam.pitfall_zh: 大量大型早期紅血球前驅細胞易誤判為 AML（pure erythroid leukemia）或 MDS：megaloblastic anemia 有全成熟序列、無 TP53 等克隆證據，且補充維生素後可逆。

quiz.q: 圖中晚期紅血球前驅細胞細胞質已血紅素化但染色質仍開放，此現象稱為什麼？區分 B12 與 folate 缺乏的代謝物檢查為何？
quiz.a: Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony；methylmalonic acid（B12 缺乏時升高）

62222.recognize_zh: 淋巴結副皮質區（paracortex）在中低倍呈斑駁淡染外觀，是因散在許多細胞質豐富、淡粉紅的組織球與蘭格漢斯細胞（Langerhans cell）夾在小淋巴球之間；本倍率下看不到明顯黑色素顆粒。
features: Mottled, pale paracortical expansion due to scattered histiocytes/Langerhans cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Background of small round lymphocytes with dense chromatin
Preserved nodal compartments with a denser lymphoid area on the left
High endothelial venules with red cells in the paracortex
No melanin pigment, sheets of atypical cells or effacement seen at this magnification; a dark linear fold artifact at left
62222.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows preserved architecture with expansion of the paracortex. At low to medium power the paracortex has a mottled appearance produced by numerous scattered histiocytes and Langerhans-type cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, admixed with small lymphocytes and high endothelial venules. There is no cytologic atypia or architectural effacement, and melanin pigment is not appreciable at this magnification. A linear fold artifact is present at left. Findings are consistent with dermatopathic lymphadenopathy.

ddx.vs: LCH shows sinusoidal infiltration by sheets of grooved Langerhans cells with numerous eosinophils and often necrosis, rather than a nodular paracortical expansion mixed with interdigitating dendritic cells and melanophages.
Nodal MF shows clusters of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes and partial effacement, confirmed by T-cell clonality, whereas dermatopathic change has bland small lymphocytes.
RDD shows markedly dilated sinuses filled with large S100+ histiocytes showing emperipolesis, not a paracortical process.
Toxoplasmosis shows follicular hyperplasia, small epithelioid histiocyte clusters encroaching on germinal centers and monocytoid B-cell sinus distension.

62158.recognize_zh: 左側血液抹片紅血球大小與形狀差異大，可見淚滴狀、橢圓形、鉛筆狀與小球性紅血球；右側超活體染色可見許多含藍色網狀物的網狀紅血球，符合 β 型中間型地中海貧血的溶血及紅血球生成增加。
features: Moderate anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells, elliptocytes, pencil forms and fragmented cells (left)
Microcytic hypochromic red cells with occasional larger polychromatic-appearing cells (left)
Supravital stain showing numerous reticulocytes with dark blue precipitated reticulum (right)
Reticular material ranges from coarse networks to a few granules
Pale, low-contrast image with limited resolution for fine red cell inclusions
62158.describe_en: The left panel shows a peripheral blood smear with moderate anisopoikilocytosis, including teardrop cells, elliptocytes, pencil cells and small hypochromic red cells; staining is pale and resolution limits assessment of target cells and basophilic stippling. The right panel is a supravital (reticulocyte) preparation showing numerous red cells containing blue-staining reticular material, indicating increased reticulocytes. No nucleated cells are clearly identified in these fields. In a child with severe anemia, splenomegaly, and raised HbF and HbA2, findings are consistent with beta thalassemia intermedia with an erythropoietic response.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows microcytic pencil cells with a low reticulocyte response and normal or low HbA2, rather than marked reticulocytosis with raised HbA2 and HbF.
HbH disease also has microcytosis and reticulocytosis, but supravital brilliant cresyl blue incubation shows golf-ball HbH inclusions and HPLC shows HbH rather than raised HbA2.
Thalassemia major presents in infancy with transfusion dependence, numerous nucleated red cells and HbF often above 90%, distinguished clinically and by HbF level.
HS shows reticulocytosis with spherocytes and high MCHC rather than microcytic hypochromic poikilocytes with raised HbA2.

exam.answer_en: Beta-thalassemia intermedia — microcytic hypochromic anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells and marked reticulocytosis on supravital stain
pearls_zh: 考法：右圖問是什麼染色、藍色網狀物是什麼：new methylene blue 等超活體染色沉澱的核糖體 RNA，即 reticulocyte。
Hb 分析：β-thal intermedia 常 HbF 升高、HbA2 可升高；嚴重度介於 trait 與 major 之間，現稱 non-transfusion-dependent thalassemia（NTDT）。
NTDT 即使不常輸血仍會鐵過載：無效造血抑制 hepcidin、腸道鐵吸收增加，需定期追蹤 ferritin 與 liver iron（MRI）。
併發症：髓外造血腫塊、膽結石、肺高壓、血栓（尤其脾切除後）與腿部潰瘍。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與缺鐵性貧血混淆：兩者皆小球性低色素，但缺鐵網狀紅血球不會明顯增加且 RDW 高、RBC 數低；本例網狀紅血球顯著增加並見明顯 poikilocytosis。

quiz.q: 右側超活體染色中含藍色網狀沉澱物的細胞是什麼？這種增加代表骨髓處於什麼狀態？
quiz.a: Reticulocytes；紅血球生成增加（對溶血／無效造血的代償）

62094.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片左上角有一條細長、盤曲、體內核柱深染的微絲蟲（microfilaria），外圍可見淡色的鞘（sheath）延伸超出蟲體；本視野並未清楚看到間日瘧原蟲（P. vivax）滋養體，只能確認微絲蟲。
features: Long, slender, coiled microfilaria at upper left with a column of densely stained somatic nuclei
Pale, faintly staining sheath visible extending beyond the body of the larva (sheathed microfilaria)
Background of red cells without clearly identifiable Plasmodium trophozoites in this field
A few scattered platelets and a single elongated stained cell fragment/artifact centrally
Pinkish overall stain tone and limited resolution preclude assessment of tail nuclei
62094.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single long, slender, coiled microfilaria at the upper left with a column of densely stained nuclei and a pale sheath extending beyond the body. The surrounding red cells appear largely unremarkable, and definite Plasmodium vivax trophozoites are not clearly resolved in this field at this resolution. The tail nuclear pattern cannot be evaluated, so species identification is limited, although a sheathed microfilaria in an Indian patient most likely represents Wuchereria bancrofti or Brugia malayi. Findings confirm microfilaremia; the reported concomitant P. vivax infection is not demonstrated in this particular image.

ddx.vs: Both are sheathed, but B. malayi has two discrete terminal tail nuclei with a kinked body, while W. bancrofti has a tapering tail free of nuclei and smooth curves.
Loa loa is sheathed but has nuclei extending continuously to the tail tip and is endemic to Central/West Africa rather than India.
Mansonella microfilariae are smaller and unsheathed with nuclei extending to a blunt tail tip.
Artifacts lack the internal column of nuclei and the defined sheath and cephalic space seen in a true microfilaria.

exam.answer_en: Sheathed microfilaria in peripheral blood — coiled larva with a column of somatic nuclei and a pale sheath (Plasmodium not evident in this field)
pearls_zh: 考法：指盤曲的長蟲問是否有鞘（sheath）；有鞘的血中微絲蟲為 Wuchereria bancrofti、Brugia malayi、Loa loa，Mansonella 無鞘。
鑑別靠尾端核：W. bancrofti 尾端無核；Brugia malayi 尾端有兩顆分離核；Loa loa 核連續延伸至尾尖。此圖尾端無法評估。
採血時間：W. bancrofti 與 Brugia 多為夜間週期性，需午夜前後採血；Loa loa 為白天週期性。可用 thick smear 或 Knott concentration 提高敏感度。
治療陷阱：Loa loa 微絲蟲量高時使用 DEC 或 ivermectin 可誘發 encephalopathy，治療前須先排除並定量。
標題提示合併瘧疾（P. vivax）：看到一種寄生蟲不代表排除其他，需完整檢視 thick 與 thin smear。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把推片中的纖維、棉絮或拉長的細胞碎片誤認為微絲蟲：微絲蟲有規則排列的體核柱與可辨認的頭尾端，且可見鞘膜延伸超出蟲體。

quiz.q: 圖左上盤曲的長條結構是什麼？圖中可見鞘，列出兩種有鞘的血中微絲蟲。
quiz.a: Microfilaria；Wuchereria bancrofti、Brugia malayi（或 Loa loa）

61966.recognize_zh: TIA1染色中許多細胞的細胞質呈點狀、粗顆粒狀棕色陽性，陽性顆粒環繞於淡染的大核周圍，表示腫瘤細胞帶有細胞毒性顆粒相關蛋白，支持ALCL的細胞毒性T細胞表型。
features: Coarse dot-like granular cytoplasmic TIA1 staining in many cells
Granules surround pale, oval-to-irregular vesicular nuclei of intermediate-to-large cells
Widespread positivity with a granular background
Some negative cells interspersed
61966.describe_en: TIA1 immunostain shows coarse granular cytoplasmic staining in many intermediate-to-large cells with pale vesicular nuclei, with some interspersed negative cells. The dot-like granular pattern reflects cytotoxic granule-associated protein expression. Together with granzyme B and perforin positivity, this establishes a cytotoxic phenotype in ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive TIA1+ cells are small lymphocytes, whereas positivity here involves large atypical cells.
ENKTL is TIA1-positive but EBER-positive and CD56-positive, with angiodestruction rather than uniform CD30+ hallmark cells.
MEITL cells are monomorphic medium-sized CD8+/CD56+ cytotoxic cells in the intestine, not large pleomorphic CD30+ cells.

61902.recognize_zh: 中倍可見表皮內網狀退化形成多房性水疱，真皮乳頭水腫合併紅血球外滲，下方真皮有致密的小至中型淋巴球浸潤，符合 HV 樣淋巴增生性疾病（HVLPD）的水疱性病變。
features: Intraepidermal multiloculated vesicle from reticular degeneration with elongated keratinocyte septa
Papillary dermal edema with extravasated red blood cells
Dense infiltrate of small to medium lymphocytes in the superficial and mid dermis
Perivascular accentuation of the lymphoid infiltrate around dermal vessels
No multinucleated keratinocytes or viral inclusions evident at this magnification
61902.describe_en: Skin biopsy at intermediate power shows an intraepidermal multiloculated vesicle formed by reticular degeneration of keratinocytes, with residual elongated keratinocyte strands spanning the blister cavity. The papillary dermis is edematous with extravasated red cells. The superficial and mid dermis contain a dense infiltrate of small to medium lymphocytes with perivascular accentuation. No multinucleated keratinocytes or viral cytopathic changes are seen at this magnification. Findings are consistent with the vesicular lesion of hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoproliferative disorder, pending EBER and immunophenotypic correlation.

ddx.vs: Herpetic vesicles show ballooned multinucleated keratinocytes with nuclear molding and inclusions, which are absent here.
PLEVA shows interface vacuolar change with necrotic keratinocytes, parakeratosis and a wedge-shaped CD8-predominant infiltrate that is EBER negative.
PMLE has subepidermal papillary edema with perivascular lymphocytes but lacks intraepidermal reticular vesiculation and EBV-infected cells.

61838.recognize_zh: 小淋巴球背景中有一顆巨大的雙核細胞，兩個核呈對稱「鷹眼」樣，CD30 在細胞膜與細胞質呈強陽性；小淋巴球完全陰性，這就是典型的 Reed-Sternberg 細胞 CD30 染色型態。
features: Single very large binucleate cell with two mirror-image round nuclei (owl-eye appearance)
Nuclei with central nucleoli visible through the counterstain
Strong membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD30 staining
Background of small CD30-negative lymphocytes and histiocytes
Faint scattered CD30 staining in rare background cells only
61838.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD30 shows a very large binucleate cell with two mirror-image nuclei containing central nucleoli, displaying strong membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD30 positivity. The surrounding small lymphocytes and histiocytes are negative. In classical Hodgkin lymphoma, the Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are typically CD30+ and CD15+, with weak PAX5 and loss of CD45 and CD20; EBV (EBER) positivity was reported in this case. Findings are consistent with a Reed-Sternberg cell of classical Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows sheets of CD30+ hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei, often ALK+ and EMA+, and lacks PAX5 and CD15.

ddx.dx: Nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma (LP cells)
