ddx.vs: LP 'popcorn' cells are CD30-negative, CD20+, and CD45+, unlike the CD30+ Reed-Sternberg cell.
Reactive CD30+ immunoblasts retain CD45 and strong CD20/PAX5 and lie in a polymorphous activated background rather than showing classic HRS phenotype.
THRLBCL large cells are CD20+/CD45+ and usually CD30-negative, scattered in a T-cell and histiocyte background.

exam.answer_en: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma — binucleate Reed-Sternberg cell with strong membranous and Golgi-type CD30 staining amid negative small lymphocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：指這顆鏡像雙核「owl-eye」大細胞問名稱與染色型態：Reed-Sternberg cell，CD30 膜狀加核旁 Golgi 點狀（dot-like）陽性。
cHL 典型表型：CD30+、CD15+（多數）、PAX5 weak+、CD45−、CD20 陰性或弱且不均、OCT2/BOB1 常缺失；EBER 在部分亞型（如 mixed cellularity）陽性。
NLPHL 的 LP（popcorn）cells 表型相反：CD20+、CD45+、OCT2/BOB1+、CD30−、CD15−；ICC 2022 將其改稱 nodular lymphocyte predominant B-cell lymphoma。
治療連結：anti-CD30 抗體藥物複合體 brentuximab vedotin 用於 cHL 與 CD30+ T 細胞淋巴瘤；PD-1 抑制劑於 cHL 有效（9p24.1 PD-L1/PD-L2 擴增）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為 ALCL：ALCL 的 CD30 是成片大細胞均勻強陽性、有 hallmark cells（腎形核）、常 CD15−、EMA+、PAX5−，可 ALK+；cHL 為少數 RS 細胞散在大量反應性背景中。

quiz.q: 圖中 CD30 強陽性的鏡像雙核大細胞叫什麼？同一疾病中它通常 CD15、CD45 與 PAX5 染色結果為何？
quiz.a: Reed-Sternberg cell（cHL）；CD15+、CD45−、PAX5 弱陽性。

61774.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 可見大型組織球有豐富淡粉紅細胞質與泡狀圓核、單一清楚核仁，中央一顆組織球內包著數個完整淋巴球（emperipolesis），背景有淋巴球與漿細胞，符合 Rosai-Dorfman disease。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic, finely granular to vacuolated cytoplasm
Round vesicular histiocyte nuclei with a single distinct nucleolus (e.g. upper left center)
Emperipolesis of several intact lymphocytes within a central histiocyte, with halos around engulfed cells
Scattered plasma cells, small lymphocytes and occasional neutrophils in the background
Loose, dyscohesive tissue with clear spaces and focal red cells
61774.describe_en: High-power sections show numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei containing distinct nucleoli. A central histiocyte contains multiple intact lymphocytes within its cytoplasm (emperipolesis), and other histiocytes show similar engulfed cells. The background contains small lymphocytes, plasma cells and scattered neutrophils without atypical large lymphoid cells. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.vs: Langerhans cells have grooved, folded nuclei with eosinophils and express CD1a and langerin, without emperipolesis.
Hallmark cells have horseshoe nuclei, marked atypia and strong CD30/ALK positivity rather than bland vesicular histiocyte nuclei.
Shows marked nuclear pleomorphism, mitoses and necrosis, with at most focal emperipolesis and weak or absent S100.
Histiocytes are smaller and S100 negative and lack prominent engulfed lymphocytes.

exam.answer_en: Rosai-Dorfman disease — large histiocytes with vesicular nuclei and distinct nucleoli engulfing intact lymphocytes (emperipolesis)
pearls_zh: 考法：指中央組織球胞質內帶暈的完整淋巴球，問現象與疾病：emperipolesis → RDD；並問組織球核特徵：圓形泡狀核、單一清楚核仁（無核溝）。
IHC 組合：S100+、OCT2+、cyclin D1+，CD1a−、langerin−；淋巴結病灶位於擴張淋巴竇內。
與 sinus histiocytosis 區分：反應性竇組織球增生的組織球較小、S100 陰性、無明顯 emperipolesis。
ALCL 也可呈竇狀分布：大型異型細胞 CD30 強陽性並常 ALK+，組織球標記陰性，可藉 IHC 排除。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把核仁明顯的大型組織球誤認為 ALCL 或 histiocytic sarcoma：本圖核溫和、無明顯異型與核分裂，且有 emperipolesis；ALCL CD30+，histiocytic sarcoma 核高度異型、S100 通常陰性或局部。

quiz.q: 圖中央組織球內含完整淋巴球，這個現象與最可能的診斷是什麼？加做哪兩個 IHC 最能支持？
quiz.a: Emperipolesis，Rosai-Dorfman disease；S100 與 OCT2 陽性（CD1a 陰性）。

61710.recognize_zh: 中期（metaphase）FISH 圖中有兩個分裂中期細胞，每個細胞各在一條染色體上可見緊鄰重疊的紅綠（黃色）融合訊號；表示 PML 與 RARA 序列被併在同一條染色體上，符合隱匿性插入所形成的 PML::RARA 融合。
features: Two DAPI-counterstained metaphase spreads
Each metaphase shows one colocalized red-green (yellow) fusion signal on a single chromosome
Fusion signal located within an otherwise normal-appearing chromosome
Separate normal red and green signals are not clearly resolved in this image
61710.describe_en: Metaphase FISH shows two DAPI-counterstained metaphase spreads, each containing a single colocalized red-green fusion signal on one chromosome, without an obvious translocation-derived chromosome. Assuming a PML/RARA probe set, this indicates juxtaposition of PML and RARA sequences, consistent with a cryptic insertion producing PML::RARA in a karyotypically normal or near-normal case. The expected separate normal signals are not clearly visible at this resolution, and chromosome identification requires inverted-DAPI or sequential banding; RT-PCR confirmation of the fusion transcript is recommended.

61646.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片左側可見大片密集的早期紅血球前驅細胞（核大圓、染色質細緻、可見核分裂），右側則滿布含粉紅橘色顆粒的嗜酸性球，紅血球系早期細胞聚集加上嗜酸性球增多，是 PCM1::JAK2 骨髓/淋巴腫瘤的典型組合。
features: Large cohesive sheets/clusters of early erythroid precursors with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and nucleoli
Frequent mitotic figures within the erythroid clusters
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders in the erythroid sheets
Adjacent area with marked eosinophilia (orange-red granulated eosinophils and precursors)
Background granulocytic cells; sheets separated by delicate fibrovascular septa
61646.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular marrow with two striking components. On one side there are large cohesive clusters and sheets of early erythroid precursors with round nuclei, fine chromatin, nucleoli, and frequent mitoses, while the adjacent marrow contains markedly increased eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors. This combination of left-shifted erythroid proliferation and eosinophilia is characteristic of a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PCM1::JAK2 fusion; confirmation by FISH/RT-PCR for t(8;9)(p22;p24.1) is required, and E-cadherin/CD71 immunostains can confirm the erythroid nature of the clusters.

ddx.vs: Cohesive sheets can mimic carcinoma, but the cells here are erythroid (CD71/E-cadherin/glycophorin positive, cytokeratin negative) with admixed hematopoiesis.
Pure erythroid leukemia lacks the prominent eosinophilia and the PCM1::JAK2 rearrangement, and typically has complex karyotype/TP53 mutation.
These also show eosinophilia but lack the clusters of early erythroid precursors; separation requires FISH for the specific rearrangement.
PMF shows atypical megakaryocytic clusters with fibrosis and JAK2 V617F, not eosinophilia with immature erythroid sheets.

61582.recognize_zh: 下肢皮膚近照可見密集的紫紅色丘疹與光滑圓頂狀結節，大小不一，部分融合成斑塊，周圍另有小的紅棕色斑點；在 AML 病人這些浸潤性結節提示白血病皮膚浸潤。
features: Multiple discrete violaceous to red-purple dome-shaped papules and nodules with smooth surface
Lesions range from pinpoint macules to nodules approximately 1 cm, focally coalescing into a plaque
Scattered smaller red-brown petechia-like macules between nodules
No ulceration, crusting or scale
61582.describe_en: Close-up clinical photograph of the leg shows numerous violaceous to erythematous, smooth, dome-shaped papules and nodules of varying size, some coalescing into an infiltrated plaque, with intervening smaller red-brown macules. There is no ulceration or scale. The raised, infiltrated character of the lesions distinguishes them from flat purpura. In a patient with acute leukemia these findings are suggestive of leukemia cutis, to be confirmed by skin biopsy.

ddx.vs: Vasculitic purpura is typically smaller, uniform and non-nodular, and biopsy shows leukocytoclasis and fibrinoid necrosis rather than a dense dermal infiltrate of blasts.
Petechiae are flat, non-palpable pinpoint hemorrhages, whereas the dominant lesions here are raised infiltrated nodules.
KS forms purple plaques and nodules on the legs but biopsy shows HHV8+ spindle-cell vascular proliferation.

61518.recognize_zh: 三個箭頭指向核圓而極度濃縮、深紫黑色、周圍帶少量細胞質的小細胞，即有核紅血球（NRBC）；畫面上方另有數顆未標箭頭的相同細胞，顯示 NRBC 數量很多，背景紅血球則普遍呈鋸齒狀並夾雜顆粒沉澱。
features: Multiple nucleated red cells (three arrowed, several more unmarked) with small, round, homogeneously dark pyknotic nuclei
Thin rim of gray-blue to pink cytoplasm around NRBC nuclei
Background red cells show diffuse crenation (echinocytic artifact) and anisocytosis
Some red cells with target-like central staining
Scattered pink-purple granular precipitate throughout the background; bluish overall staining limits color assessment
61518.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous nucleated red cells, three indicated by arrows and several others unmarked, with small round pyknotic nuclei and a thin rim of cytoplasm. The background red cells show anisocytosis, occasional target-like forms, and widespread crenation that is likely artifactual. Staining is suboptimal with a bluish cast and granular precipitate, which limits assessment of hypochromia, inclusions, and platelets. The high NRBC count requires correction of the automated WBC count and warrants evaluation for thalassemia, hemolytic anemia, or a leukoerythroblastic process.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have larger nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin and blue cytoplasm, whereas NRBC nuclei are smaller, round, and homogeneously dense.
Thalassemia is favored when NRBCs accompany marked hypochromia, microcytosis, and target cells, and is confirmed by hemoglobin electrophoresis/HPLC.

ddx.dx: Hemolytic anemia with brisk marrow response
ddx.vs: Hemolytic anemia shows polychromasia, spherocytes or schistocytes, and raised LDH/bilirubin with low haptoglobin.
A leukoerythroblastic picture also contains myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and teardrop cells.

61454.recognize_zh: CEN 12 橘色著絲點探針間期 FISH：中央細胞有 3 個橘色訊號（三體 12），上下兩顆細胞各為 2 個訊號（正常）；三體 12 是慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）常見、屬中等風險的異常。
features: Interphase FISH with a chromosome 12 centromeric probe (spectrum orange) on DAPI-counterstained nuclei
Central nucleus shows three discrete orange signals - trisomy 12
Upper-right and lower-left nuclei each show two signals (normal disomy); a split/satellite signal in the upper nucleus should not be counted separately
Signals are well separated and bright with low background
61454.describe_en: Interphase FISH using a centromeric chromosome 12 (CEP12) probe shows three nuclei. The central nucleus contains three orange signals consistent with trisomy 12, whereas the other two nuclei contain two signals, reflecting a normal disomic pattern. A closely adjacent doublet in one nucleus represents a split signal and is scored as one. Trisomy 12 in a proportion of cells above the laboratory cutoff is consistent with a clonal abnormality in CLL, conferring intermediate prognostic risk; it is often associated with atypical morphology, CD38 expression and NOTCH1 mutation.

ddx.vs: Polyploidy doubles all probe signals (including control loci), and overlapping cells give two nuclear outlines rather than three signals in one nucleus.
A split signal appears as two tiny adjacent dots within one signal diameter and is scored as a single copy.
These require locus-specific probes (13q14, ATM, TP53) and show signal loss rather than an extra centromeric signal.

61390.recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 下，在由小淋巴球、組織球、漿細胞、嗜中性球與凋亡碎屑組成的多樣性發炎背景中，散佈大型、核仁明顯的多核或多葉 Hodgkin 樣大細胞，符合 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍（EBVMCU）的型態。
features: Scattered large atypical cells, some binucleate or multilobated, with vesicular chromatin and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli (Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like)
Intermediate-sized immunoblast-like cells with open chromatin and single nucleoli
Polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells and neutrophils
Apoptotic bodies and karyorrhectic debris
Loose edematous to fibrinoid stroma with extravasated red cells
61390.describe_en: Sections show a diffuse polymorphous inflammatory infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells and neutrophils, with scattered apoptotic bodies and extravasated red cells within an edematous stroma. Admixed are scattered large atypical cells and immunoblasts, including binucleate and multilobated forms with prominent nucleoli resembling Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells. Sheets of large atypical cells are not present in this field. In an ulcerated mucosal or cutaneous lesion, particularly in an immunosuppressed patient, the findings are suggestive of EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer, pending immunohistochemistry and EBER in situ hybridization.

ddx.vs: HRS cells are typically CD20-negative/weak PAX5 with CD15 positivity and arise in lymph nodes, whereas EBVMCU cells are often CD20+ with a sharply circumscribed ulcer and no nodal or systemic disease.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Shows sheets of large atypical B cells forming mass lesions with systemic spread, rather than scattered large cells in a polymorphous infiltrate limited to a circumscribed ulcer.
Angiocentric, angiodestructive EBV+ B-cell proliferation typically in the lung with multiple nodules, rather than a solitary mucocutaneous ulcer.
Contains activated immunoblasts but lacks the numerous EBER-positive HRS-like cells.

61326.recognize_zh: 四格 CD34 骨髓切片：A、B 見大量 CD34 陽性母細胞成群分布，並勾勒出竇狀血管內皮；C、D 在脂肪較多的區域中，一些形狀不規則、帶分葉核的較大細胞呈 CD34 陽性，形態似小型或發育不良的巨核細胞，提醒判讀時不可把所有 CD34 陽性細胞都算作母細胞。
features: Panels A-B: numerous CD34-positive mononuclear blasts forming clusters and sheets in cellular marrow
CD34-positive sinusoidal endothelium outlining vascular channels (internal control)
Panels C-D: in fatty marrow, larger irregular CD34-positive cells with lobated nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, suggestive of small dysplastic megakaryocytes
Adjacent CD34-positive capillaries in C-D
Negative background myeloid and erythroid cells
61326.describe_en: This composite of CD34 immunohistochemistry on bone marrow core biopsy shows, at low and intermediate power (A, B), markedly increased CD34-positive blasts forming clusters and sheets, with CD34-positive sinusoidal endothelium serving as an internal control. At high power in a hypocellular, fat-rich area (C, D), several larger, irregularly shaped cells with lobated nuclei and moderate cytoplasm are CD34-positive; their size and nuclear configuration suggest small dysplastic megakaryocytes rather than blasts. The figure illustrates that CD34 highlights endothelium and, in myeloid neoplasms, aberrant megakaryocytes, so blast counts should rely on cytologic confirmation; correlation with CD61 or CD42b is recommended for the cells in C-D.

ddx.vs: Endothelial cells are flattened and line lumens, whereas blasts are round mononuclear cells and megakaryocytes are large lobated cells.
Blasts are small, uniform, round mononuclear cells without nuclear lobation and are CD61-negative.
Hematogones are small scattered cells with a maturation spectrum (CD34 dim to negative, CD20 acquired) and do not form sheets.

61262.recognize_zh: 箭頭處是一團黏聚的大型細胞，共享大片深藍色細胞質、界線不清，核大而圓、染色質細緻並有多個明顯核仁，細胞比周邊的造血細胞大得多，左下另有一顆含細胞質空泡的細胞；這種黏聚成團、核仁明顯的非造血細胞，是骨髓轉移性腺癌。
features: Cohesive cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells with indistinct borders (arrow)
Large round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin and multiple conspicuous nucleoli
Moderate to abundant basophilic, somewhat foamy cytoplasm
Single detached cell at lower left with a large cytoplasmic vacuole indenting the nucleus (possible mucin/signet-ring-like vacuole)
Background red cells, scattered platelets and stain precipitate; eyepiece photograph with blue-green cast
61262.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large cells with indistinct cell borders, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and large round nuclei with fine chromatin and multiple prominent nucleoli. A nearby single cell contains a large cytoplasmic vacuole that indents the nucleus. These cells are morphologically distinct from hematopoietic elements. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma involving the bone marrow; trephine biopsy with immunohistochemistry is needed to confirm epithelial origin and suggest a primary site.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts have small nucleoli, uniform eccentric nuclei and a Golgi zone away from the nucleus, without prominent multiple nucleoli or vacuoles.
Cells are discohesive with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hof and are CD138/MUM1 positive and keratin negative.
May show prominent nucleoli but often contains fine melanin pigment and is S100/SOX10/HMB45 positive rather than keratin positive.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia or erythroid clusters
ddx.vs: Blast clusters have scant cytoplasm with blebs or deep blue rims and express CD61 or E-cadherin/CD71 rather than cytokeratin.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic adenocarcinoma in bone marrow — cohesive cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells with prominent nucleoli and a vacuolated cell
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭處黏聚成團的大細胞，問「是不是造血細胞？」重點在 cohesion（細胞彼此黏在一起）與體積遠大於造血細胞，這是 non-hematopoietic tumor 的線索。
抹片上腫瘤團塊常被推到抹片邊緣與 feathered edge，低倍掃描時要特別看這些區域；腫瘤常伴纖維化導致 dry tap，因此骨髓切片（trephine biopsy）偵測率高於抽吸。
IHC 確認：pan-cytokeratin（AE1/AE3）陽性、CD45 陰性；再以 CK7/CK20、TTF-1、CDX2、GATA3、PSA/NKX3.1 等推測原發部位。
周邊血常見 leukoerythroblastic picture（有核紅血球＋未成熟顆粒球）與 teardrop cells，是骨髓浸潤（myelophthisis）的提示。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為成團的 osteoblasts：osteoblast 核偏位、核仁小、Golgi 淡染區離核較遠且大小一致；腺癌細胞核大小不一、多個明顯核仁、可有黏液空泡，必要時以 cytokeratin 區分。

quiz.q: 箭頭處的細胞團屬於哪一類細胞？骨髓切片上最先要做哪個 IHC 確認？
quiz.a: 非造血來源的轉移性腺癌細胞；pan-cytokeratin（如 AE1/AE3）

61198.recognize_zh: 血液抹片右側可見一顆接近紅血球大小、含紫紅色顆粒的巨大血小板，與畫面中央正常大小的小血小板形成對比；但本圖只見一顆巨血小板且解析度低，無法看出「大量」巨血小板。
features: One giant platelet at right, approaching the diameter of an adjacent red cell, with a central purple granulomere and pale peripheral hyalomere
A normal-sized small platelet in the center for comparison
Two neutrophils (one band-like, one segmented) with normal granulation and no visible Döhle-like inclusions
Normocytic red cells with central pallor
Low image resolution limits assessment of platelet number and granule detail
61198.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a giant platelet approaching red cell size with preserved purple granulation, contrasting with a normal-sized platelet nearby. Two neutrophils show normal granulation without obvious Döhle-like cytoplasmic inclusions, and red cells are unremarkable. Only a single giant platelet is present in this low-resolution field, so the degree of macrothrombocytopenia cannot be assessed. The finding is compatible with an inherited macrothrombocytopenia such as Bernard-Soulier syndrome, which requires absent ristocetin-induced agglutination and reduced GPIb-IX-V expression by flow cytometry for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Giant platelets are accompanied by Döhle-like basophilic inclusions in neutrophils, and ristocetin agglutination is normal.
Large platelets are pale gray and agranular rather than normally granulated.
Young large platelets are present but not consistently red-cell sized, platelet function testing is normal, and there is no lifelong family history.

61134.recognize_zh: T 細胞標記免疫染色中，陽性淋巴球沿著表皮基底層排成一列並散入表皮（epidermotropism），真皮淺層亦有成群陽性細胞，而表皮角質細胞本身為陰性，呈現蕈狀肉芽腫的表皮親和分布。
features: Positive lymphocytes lining up along the dermal-epidermal junction in a linear basal distribution
Single positive lymphocytes scattered within the spinous layer (epidermotropism) with minimal accompanying spongiosis
Superficial dermal aggregates of positive lymphocytes, some with irregular, enlarged nuclei and membranous/cytoplasmic staining
Keratinocytes and dermal fibroblasts/endothelium are negative
Specific antibody not labeled in the image (pattern consistent with a pan-T or CD4 stain)
61134.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for a T-cell marker on a skin biopsy shows positive lymphocytes arranged linearly along the basal layer of the epidermis and scattered singly within the spinous layer, with only slight spongiosis. Additional aggregates of positive lymphocytes, some with enlarged irregular nuclei, are present in the superficial dermis. Keratinocytes and stromal cells are negative. The pattern of epidermotropic, basally aligned T cells disproportionate to spongiosis supports mycosis fungoides, typically with a CD3+, CD4+, CD8- phenotype and frequent loss of CD7.

ddx.vs: Inflammatory dermatitis shows exocytosis proportional to marked spongiosis, a mixed CD4/CD8 population and lacks linear basal alignment of atypical T cells.

ddx.dx: Lichenoid drug eruption or lichen planus
ddx.vs: Lichenoid infiltrates are band-like with basal vacuolar change and necrotic keratinocytes, and are often CD8-rich.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: This entity shows pagetoid epidermotropism with keratinocyte necrosis and a CD8+ cytotoxic phenotype rather than CD4+.
Pagetoid reticulosis presents as a solitary lesion with marked intraepidermal pagetoid spread of large atypical cells and little dermal involvement.

61006.recognize_zh: 這張骨髓抹片染色過深、偏藍，許多有核細胞呈深藍色實心圓團，核細節無法辨識；中央一顆較大的橢圓形淡藍細胞可能是單核或低分葉的巨核細胞，但影像品質不足以確認任何 aCML 的特異形態。
features: Thick, overstained (predominantly blue) aspirate smear with poor nuclear detail
Numerous nucleated cells appearing as dense, dark blue round masses
Central large oval cell with homogeneous pale blue cytoplasm-like staining; nature uncertain (possible hypolobated megakaryocyte)
Crenated, refractile red cells and abundant granular background debris
Dense cellular particle at right edge
61006.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is thick and heavily overstained, with nucleated cells appearing as dark blue masses lacking discernible chromatin or cytoplasmic detail, crenated red cells and abundant granular background debris. A large oval cell in the center with homogeneous pale blue staining may represent a mononuclear or hypolobated megakaryocyte, but this cannot be confirmed. A cellular particle is present at the right edge, suggesting a cellular specimen. Owing to staining and thickness artifacts, lineage assignment and dysplasia assessment are not possible from this image, and the findings are only nonspecifically compatible with the stated diagnosis of atypical CML.

ddx.dx: Hypolobated megakaryocyte of MDS/MPN or 5q- syndrome
ddx.vs: Would require clear visualization of a single round non-lobated nucleus in a large granular cell, which the overstaining prevents here.
Macrophages have abundant vacuolated cytoplasm with ingested debris and a small eccentric nucleus rather than a large homogeneous cell body.
Overstaining and thick areas obscure nuclear detail across all cells; a thinner area or restained slide is needed for interpretation.

60942.recognize_zh: 胸部 CT 左上肺有空洞性腫塊（像肺膿瘍），PET 呈強烈攝取；切片為混合性發炎背景（嗜伊紅性球、組織球、壞死）中散在大型異型細胞，免疫染色大型細胞呈膜與高基氏體區陽性，符合典型何杰金淋巴瘤。
features: Clinical photo: hand with metallic-painted, curved nails (nail changes/clubbing cannot be reliably assessed)
Cytology: large atypical mononuclear/multinucleated cell with prominent nucleolus among small lymphocytes
H&E: polymorphous infiltrate of lymphocytes, eosinophils and histiocytes with necrotic areas and scattered large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like cells
IHC: large cells with membranous and paranuclear dot-like staining (consistent with CD30/CD15); background lymphocytes negative
CT: left upper lobe cavitating consolidation/mass; PET-CT: intense FDG uptake; follow-up PET: resolution with residual physiologic mediastinal activity
60942.describe_en: Chest CT shows a cavitary consolidative mass in the left upper lobe that is intensely FDG-avid on PET-CT, radiologically mimicking a lung abscess, with marked metabolic response on follow-up imaging. Cytologic preparation contains a large atypical cell with a prominent nucleolus among small lymphocytes. The biopsy shows a polymorphous inflammatory background of small lymphocytes, eosinophils and histiocytes with necrosis, in which scattered large cells with irregular, multilobated nuclei and prominent nucleoli are present. The large cells show membranous and Golgi-pattern immunoreactivity, while the background is negative. Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma involving lung, presenting as a cavitating lesion.

ddx.vs: Abscesses show neutrophil-rich necrosis with organisms and lack CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells.
GPA shows geographic necrosis with palisading histiocytes, vasculitis and ANCA positivity rather than CD30+ HRS cells.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These form sheets of large neoplastic cells (ALK/CD30 cohesive sheets, or CD20/CD45+ B cells) rather than rare HRS cells in a reactive milieu.
Angiocentric EBV+ large B cells expressing CD20 and CD45 with vascular infiltration, whereas HRS cells are CD15+ and CD20/CD45 negative.

60942.stain: H&E; cytology; IHC (CD30/CD15 pattern); CT; PET-CT

60878.recognize_zh: 這是一張流式細胞儀教學投影片：CD34/CD10/CD19/CD20/CD38/TdT 雙參數圖上，早期（藍，CD34+TdT+CD10 亮）、中間期（紅，CD34−CD10+ CD20 逐漸上升）與成熟 B 細胞（黃，CD20+CD10−）形成連續的成熟路徑，這種可預期的連續成熟模式就是 hematogone 的特徵。
features: Non-morphologic slide of eight flow cytometry dot plots with color-coded B-cell stages: blue early, red intermediate, yellow mature B cells
CD45 vs SSC: B-lineage events in the low-SSC region spanning dim to bright CD45
CD19 vs CD10 and CD34 vs CD10: early hematogones CD34+/CD10 bright, intermediate CD34-/CD10+, mature B cells CD10-
CD20 vs CD19 and CD38 vs CD20: continuous acquisition of CD20 from negative to positive across stages with CD38 on immature cells
CD34 vs cytoplasmic TdT: TdT restricted to CD34+ early (blue) cells; cytoplasmic CD22 vs TdT gating shown
Slide text: MRD detection relies on leukemia-associated immunophenotype and/or 'different-from-normal' approach
60878.describe_en: This figure is a flow cytometry teaching slide rather than a morphologic image. Bone marrow B-lineage precursors are displayed on eight dot plots, with early-stage hematogones (blue) expressing CD34, TdT and bright CD10 without CD20, intermediate hematogones (red) losing CD34/TdT while retaining CD10 and gradually acquiring CD20, and mature B cells (yellow) showing CD20 positivity and loss of CD10. The populations form a continuous, predictable maturation spectrum without discrete clustered abnormal events. Interpretation: this normal antigen continuum distinguishes hematogones from B-lymphoblastic leukemia/MRD, which typically shows an aberrant, 'different-from-normal' cluster (e.g., asynchronous CD34/CD20, CD10/CD38 aberrancy, or loss of CD45).

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts form a tight discrete cluster deviating from the normal maturation pathway (e.g., CD10 overexpression, CD38 underexpression, CD45 negative, CD58/CD81 aberrancy) instead of a smooth continuum.
Lymphoma cells are CD34/TdT negative with surface light-chain restriction rather than a TdT+/CD34+ to CD20+ maturation spectrum.

60878.stain: Flow: CD45, CD19, CD10, CD20, CD34, CD38, TdT, cCD22

exam.answer_en: Hematogones (normal B-cell precursors) by flow cytometry — continuous maturation from CD34+/TdT+/CD10 bright to CD20+/CD10− mature B cells
pearls_zh: 判讀方式：非形態圖。看各點圖是否形成「連續、可預期」的抗原變化軌跡；正常 hematogone 是由 CD34+TdT+ 早期經 CD10+CD20 漸增到成熟 B 細胞的平滑連續帶。
考法：問「這是 B-ALL MRD 還是 hematogone？」關鍵是有沒有偏離正常路徑的緊密異常族群。
B-ALL MRD 常見 aberrancy：CD10 過強、CD38 減弱、CD45 缺失、CD58 過強、CD34 與 CD20 不同步表現，或 CD81 異常；即 LAIP 與 different-from-normal 兩種策略。
臨床情境：化療後、移植後骨髓再生、兒童及自體免疫或感染時 hematogone 可明顯增加，勿誤判為復發。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常把增加的 hematogone 誤判為 B-ALL 殘存病灶：hematogone 呈連續成熟軌跡且抗原強度正常，B-ALL 則形成偏離正常路徑的緊密族群並有 CD10/CD38/CD45 等異常。

quiz.q: 流式圖中 CD34+TdT+ 細胞逐步失去 CD10、獲得 CD20 形成連續帶，這群細胞是什麼？
quiz.a: Hematogones（正常 B 前驅細胞），非 B-ALL MRD

60814.recognize_zh: CD3 在多數中小型淋巴球呈強膜狀陽性，密集分布於浸潤中，其間夾雜未染色的較大細胞與組織球，顯示 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍中豐富的背景反應性 T 細胞。
features: Numerous small to medium lymphocytes with strong membranous/cytoplasmic CD3 staining
Dense, diffuse distribution of T cells throughout the field
Interspersed unstained larger cells and histiocytes with pale blue nuclei
No sheets of CD3-negative large cells in this field
60814.describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry highlights a dense population of small to medium-sized T cells distributed diffusely throughout the infiltrate. Scattered larger CD3-negative cells and histiocytes are interspersed among the positive cells. The T cells represent the reactive background component (reported as CD8-predominant) of an EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer, in which the large atypical cells are B cells.

ddx.vs: Would show cytologically atypical CD3+ cells, often with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR rearrangement, rather than bland reactive T cells around CD20+ large cells.
Also T-cell rich, but lacks the ulcerative circumscribed lesion and EBER positivity and has few scattered large B cells.
Positive cells are atypical, cytoplasmic CD3ε+/CD56+ and EBER+, with angiodestruction and necrosis.

60750.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中的大型異常細胞核偏位、細胞質深藍且有拖尾或芽狀突起，看起來像芽細胞；但流式細胞儀顯示 CD45 弱/陰性、CD38 強陽性與 CD138 陽性的族群，證實是漿細胞而非骨髓芽細胞。
features: Large atypical circulating cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderately condensed to dispersed chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some with tail-like (hand-mirror) projections or irregular cytoplasmic blebs
Perinuclear hof inconspicuous in several cells, producing a blast-like appearance
Flow cytometry: dominant CD45-dim/negative, CD138-positive, bright CD38 population (purple) lacking CD34, CD117 and HLA-DR
Neutrophils and red cells otherwise unremarkable in the background
60750.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous large atypical mononuclear cells with eccentric nuclei, relatively fine chromatin and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some with cytoplasmic tails or blebs, imparting a blast-like appearance. Flow cytometry reveals a large CD45-dim to negative population that is CD38 bright and CD138 positive and does not express CD34, CD117 or HLA-DR; the cytoplasmic light-chain plot resolution is limited in this figure. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia with atypical, blast-like morphology mimicking acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: AML blasts are CD34/CD117/HLA-DR or monocytic-marker positive and lack bright CD38 with CD138 and cytoplasmic light-chain restriction.
Shares CD138/CD38 expression but usually presents as extramedullary mass in immunodeficiency with EBER positivity and MYC rearrangement rather than primary marrow myeloma with circulating clone.
Reactive plasma cells are mature-appearing, polytypic for light chains and usually retain CD19 and CD45 without CD56 aberrancy.
Shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with a CD19+/CD20+ B-cell component and MYD88 L265P, not sheets of large atypical plasma cells.

60622.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色顯示骨小樑旁緻密的紡錘形細胞聚集，胞質強陽性（肥大細胞標記）；臨床照片中前臂皮膚刮擦後出現線狀紅色風疹塊（Darier's sign），伴散在紅棕色斑丘疹，符合肥大細胞增生症。
features: Bone marrow biopsy immunostain: dense paratrabecular and perivascular aggregate of spindle-shaped cells with strong cytoplasmic positivity
Aggregated positive cells form a compact multifocal infiltrate adjacent to bone trabeculae, with scattered negative hematopoietic cells and fat
Clinical photo: linear erythematous urticarial wheal along the stroked skin of the forearm (Darier's sign)
Scattered small reddish-brown macules/papules on the arm consistent with urticaria pigmentosa-type skin lesions
60622.describe_en: The bone marrow core biopsy immunostained for a mast cell marker (likely tryptase or CD117) shows a dense, compact paratrabecular infiltrate of spindle-shaped positive cells forming aggregates well in excess of 15 cells, with residual hematopoiesis and fat. The clinical photograph demonstrates a linear urticarial wheal and flare after stroking of the forearm skin (Darier's sign), with scattered pigmented maculopapular lesions. Findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis with cutaneous involvement; CD25/CD2 aberrant expression, KIT D816V mutation and serum tryptase support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are scattered, round and interstitial without dense spindle-cell aggregates or CD25 expression.
Fibroblasts are spindle-shaped but tryptase- and CD117-negative.
HCL infiltrates are CD20/annexin A1-positive B cells with fried-egg appearance rather than tryptase-positive spindle cells.
Simple dermatographism arises from normal skin, whereas Darier's sign is elicited on pigmented mastocytosis lesions with increased dermal mast cells.

60622.stain: IHC: mast cell marker (tryptase/CD117); clinical photo

exam.answer_en: Systemic mastocytosis with skin involvement — dense paratrabecular aggregates of spindle-shaped mast cells on IHC plus Darier's sign on skin
pearls_zh: 考法：臨床照片考 Darier's sign（摩擦病灶皮膚後出現風疹塊，為肥大細胞去顆粒）；骨髓 IHC 考主要診斷標準——多灶性緻密浸潤、每團 ≥15 顆肥大細胞。
次要標準（WHO/ICC 共通概念）：>25% 紡錘形/非典型肥大細胞、KIT D816V（或其他活化性 KIT 突變）、CD25 和/或 CD2（WHO 5th 加入 CD30）異常表現、serum tryptase 持續 >20 ng/mL。
IHC 判讀：tryptase 與 CD117 標出肥大細胞；CD25 異常表現是區分腫瘤性與反應性肥大細胞最實用的指標；toluidine blue 呈 metachromatic。
臨床連結：誘發因子（摩擦、昆蟲叮咬、酒精、NSAIDs、麻醉藥物）可致全身性過敏反應，應備 epinephrine；advanced SM 可用 midostaurin 或 avapritinib。
exam.pitfall_zh: 紡錘形肥大細胞緻密浸潤易誤認為骨髓纖維化或纖維母細胞增生：纖維母細胞 tryptase/CD117 陰性；反應性肥大細胞增生則為散在圓形細胞、無緻密聚集且 CD25 陰性。

quiz.q: 照片中摩擦前臂皮膚後出現線狀風疹塊，這個徵象稱為什麼？骨髓中最具特徵的 KIT 突變為何？
quiz.a: Darier's sign；KIT D816V。

60686.recognize_zh: 抹片背景中散在淡紫藍色、雲霧狀無結構的細胞外沉積物（箭頭），為冷球蛋白；自動血球計數器把這些沉積物誤判為血小板，B 圖可見儀器血小板數突然升到約 500×10³/µL，但人工計數始終偏低。
features: Extracellular pale lilac-blue, amorphous, cloud-like or fluffy deposits in the smear background (arrows)
Deposits lack granules, nuclei or defined membranes, distinguishing them from platelets
Deformed red cells with indentations or folding (arrowheads) and an occasional crenated red cell
True platelets are scarce in this field
Panel B graph: analyzer-derived platelet count spikes to ~500 × 10^3/µL around days 5–9 while manual counts remain below ~25 × 10^3/µL
60686.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows extracellular, pale lilac-blue, amorphous cloud-like deposits scattered between red cells, consistent with precipitated cryoglobulin, together with deformed red cells and very few true platelets. The accompanying graph shows a discrepancy in which the automated analyzer platelet count rises abruptly to about 500 × 10^3/µL while manual platelet counts remain severely low. This indicates that cryoglobulin particles were counted as platelets, producing pseudo-recovery. Findings are consistent with cryoglobulins causing spurious platelet counts in a patient with mantle cell lymphoma after chemoimmunotherapy; warmed-sample recount and manual smear review are recommended.

ddx.vs: Recovered platelets are discrete granular fragments on the smear with concordant manual counts, whereas here the smear shows amorphous deposits and manual counts stay low.

ddx.dx: Red cell or leukocyte fragments counted as platelets
ddx.vs: Fragments (schistocytes, microspherocytes, blast cytoplasm) have red cell color or cellular structure, unlike featureless pale blue cloud-like material.
Platelet clumps contain granular platelets and fibrin forms fibrillar strands, not homogeneous amorphous blotches.
Stain precipitate is dark purple and granular and lies on top of cells, whereas cryoglobulin is pale, smooth and extracellular and disappears when the sample is warmed.

60558.recognize_zh: 紅色箭頭指向一個偏小、略呈藍灰色的紅血球，細胞邊緣內側有一圈紫色細線環（Cabot ring）；藍色箭頭指向同一細胞邊緣的小顆深紫色圓點，為 Howell-Jolly 小體。
features: Small, slightly polychromatic red cell containing a thin violet ring outlining the inner cell periphery (red arrow)
Tiny dense dark-purple round inclusion at the edge of the same cell, consistent with a Howell-Jolly body (blue arrow)
Surrounding red cells show anisocytosis with normochromic cells lacking central pallor
Teardrop-shaped poikilocyte in the upper field
Clean background without leukocytes or parasites
60558.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with anisocytosis and scattered poikilocytes, including a teardrop cell. A small polychromatic red cell contains a fine violet ring inclusion tracing its periphery, consistent with a Cabot ring, together with a small, dense, round basophilic inclusion consistent with a Howell-Jolly body. No intraerythrocytic parasites are identified. Findings are consistent with a Cabot ring and Howell-Jolly body in the setting of hemolytic anemia with stressed erythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: A malarial ring has a blue cytoplasmic loop with an attached red chromatin dot inside the cell, whereas here the ring traces the cell border and the dot (Howell-Jolly body) is a separate, larger dense nuclear remnant.
Pappenheimer bodies are multiple small peripheral clustered granules that are Prussian blue positive, unlike a single round Howell-Jolly body.
An overlying platelet shows a pale halo and granular purple center, whereas a Howell-Jolly body is a smooth, homogeneous, sharply round dot within the cell.

exam.answer_en: Cabot ring with Howell-Jolly body in the same red cell — stressed erythropoiesis in hemolytic anemia
pearls_zh: 考法：一顆紅血球內同時有細紫環與小而圓的深藍紫色點，考官會要求兩個都命名 → Cabot ring 加 Howell-Jolly body。
Howell-Jolly body 為核 DNA 殘片，單一、圓形、約 1 µm；正常由脾臟移除，增加提示無脾/脾功能低下或 megaloblastic anemia。
Howell-Jolly body 為 DNA，Feulgen 染色陽性；Pappenheimer body 含鐵、Prussian blue 陽性，兩者以此區分。
看到多顆紅血球有 Howell-Jolly body 時應追問脾切除史或功能性無脾（如 sickle cell），並注意莢膜菌感染風險。
exam.pitfall_zh: Howell-Jolly body 易與 Pappenheimer bodies 或疊在紅血球上的血小板混淆：Pappenheimer 為多顆細小、成簇偏周邊；血小板較大、有顆粒且常超出紅血球邊界。

quiz.q: 圖中同一顆紅血球內的細環與小圓點各是什麼？
quiz.a: Cabot ring 與 Howell-Jolly body

60494.recognize_zh: 黏膜切片表面有纖維素性壞死滲出，中央一條血管壁被不典型淋巴樣細胞浸潤並環繞（血管中心性／血管破壞，angiodestruction），周圍為密集的中等大小、核形不規則的淋巴細胞。
features: Dense diffuse infiltrate of small-to-medium atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, elongated hyperchromatic nuclei
Central blood vessel with wall infiltrated and surrounded by lymphoid cells (angiocentric/angiodestructive growth)
Fibrinoid change in the involved vessel wall
Surface ulceration with fibrinous exudate
Scattered small vessels within a crushed-appearing infiltrate
60494.describe_en: Mucosal biopsy shows surface ulceration with fibrinous exudate overlying a dense diffuse infiltrate of atypical small-to-medium lymphoid cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei. A central vessel shows transmural infiltration by the atypical cells with fibrinoid change of the wall, consistent with angiocentric and angiodestructive growth. In the appropriate site and with cytoplasmic CD3, CD56, cytotoxic granule, and EBER positivity, findings are consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.

ddx.vs: GPA shows necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with multinucleated giant cells and mixed inflammation without cytologically atypical EBER-positive lymphoid cells.
LyG is an EBV-positive B-cell process (CD20+ large atypical B cells) in a T-cell-rich background, usually pulmonary, rather than a CD56+ cytotoxic infiltrate.
Reactive infiltrates are polymorphous without atypical nuclei, transmural vessel invasion, or EBER-positive cells.

exam.answer_en: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma — ulcerated mucosa with atypical lymphoid cells showing angiocentric/angiodestructive vessel infiltration
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指中央被腫瘤細胞穿透、管壁纖維素樣變化的血管，問此生長型態名稱（angiocentric/angiodestructive）及其後果（凝固性壞死）。
必考表型：cytoplasmic CD3ε+（表面 CD3−）、CD56+、細胞毒性顆粒（TIA-1、granzyme B、perforin）+，EBER in situ hybridization 陽性是診斷必要條件。
治療與追蹤：局限期以放射治療合併含 asparaginase 的化療；進展期用含 asparaginase 方案（如 SMILE、P-GemOx）；血漿 EBV DNA 用於分期、療效與復發監測。
WHO 5th 名稱為 extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma（刪除 nasal type）；可併發 hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis（HLH）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 血管中心性浸潤易誤認為 granulomatosis with polyangiitis 或 lymphomatoid granulomatosis；GPA 有肉芽腫與 ANCA，LYG 為 EBV+ 大型 B 細胞，本病為 EBER+ 的 NK/T 細胞。

quiz.q: 圖中央血管壁被不典型淋巴細胞穿透浸潤，這種生長型態稱為什麼？它導致此腫瘤常見的哪種組織變化？
quiz.a: Angiocentric/angiodestructive growth；大片凝固性壞死與潰瘍

60430.recognize_zh: OCT2 核染色中，背景小 B 細胞只呈淡棕色的弱陽性，而散布其間的大量較大細胞核呈深棕黑色的強陽性，這些強染的散在大細胞就是 LP 細胞；「LP 細胞 OCT2 強於周圍小 B 細胞」是 NLPHL 與典型霍奇金淋巴瘤（HRS 細胞 OCT2 弱或陰性）區分的重點。
features: OCT2 nuclear immunostain at low-medium power
Scattered larger nuclei with strong, dark brown OCT2 staining (LP cells), more numerous in some nodular areas
Background small B cells with weaker, finer nuclear OCT2 positivity forming vague nodules
Negative (blue) areas between nodules corresponding to T-cell-rich zones and histiocytes
No sheets of large strongly positive cells
60430.describe_en: OCT2 immunohistochemistry shows weak to moderate nuclear staining of the background small B cells, which are arranged in vague nodules separated by unstained areas. Scattered throughout the nodules are larger cells with strong, dark nuclear OCT2 expression that stand out above the background, corresponding to lymphocyte-predominant (LP) cells. Strong OCT2 expression in the large neoplastic cells indicates an intact B-cell transcription program. These findings support nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HRS cells of cHL show absent or weak OCT2 and BOB1 with CD30/CD15 positivity, in contrast to the strong OCT2 of LP cells.
THRLBCL large cells are also OCT2-strong, but lie in a diffuse T-cell/histiocyte background without small B-cell nodules or FDC meshworks.
Reactive nodes have polarized germinal centers with many OCT2-positive centroblasts and tingible-body macrophages rather than scattered isolated strongly positive large cells in small B-cell nodules.

60366.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中 CD45 弱／陰性、低側向散射（SSC）的母細胞群佔 84%，CD19 與 CD10 共同表現，CD34 大多陰性，CD20、CD13、CD5 陰性且表面輕鏈（kappa/lambda）皆不表現，是 B 淋巴母細胞的免疫表型。
features: CD45 vs SSC: dominant population (~84%) with dim-to-negative CD45 and low side scatter in the blast region; few granulocytes (0.75%) and lymphocytes
CD19+/CD10+ in ~96% of gated events
CD34 largely negative (~2% CD19+CD34+)
CD20 negative, CD5 negative, CD13 negative
No surface kappa or lambda light chain expression
60366.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood shows a dominant abnormal population comprising approximately 84% of events in the low side scatter, dim-to-negative CD45 blast region. These cells coexpress CD19 and CD10 (approximately 96%), are largely negative for CD34, and are negative for CD20, CD5, CD13 and surface kappa and lambda light chains. The lack of surface immunoglobulin and CD20 with CD10 expression indicates an immature B-cell phenotype rather than a mature B-cell neoplasm. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia (common/pre-B phenotype, CD34-negative); TdT and cytogenetic studies are recommended for completion.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are CD10+CD19+ but express CD20, bright CD45 and monotypic surface light chain and are TdT-negative.
Hematogones show a continuous maturation spectrum from CD34+/TdT+ to CD20+ with normal CD45 and CD10 intensity, rather than a single uniform CD20-negative population.
FL cells are CD10+ but are mature B cells with CD20 and bright CD45 and monotypic surface light chains.

60174.recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片中這顆巨核細胞有豐富的顆粒狀胞質，卻含有兩到三個彼此完全分離、圓形的細胞核（separated nuclear lobes，俗稱「銅板狀」），不像正常巨核細胞那樣分葉相連，是典型的巨核細胞發育不良。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant, finely azurophilic granular cytoplasm
Two to three discrete, round to oval, widely separated nuclei without connecting chromatin bridges
Nuclei have fairly homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin without visible nucleoli
Adjacent granulated myeloid precursor (myelocyte/promyelocyte) abutting the megakaryocyte
Background red cells and a few small lymphocytes/erythroid precursors
60174.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm containing multiple widely separated, round nuclear lobes ('pawn-ball' or multinucleated morphology). A granulated myeloid precursor lies adjacent to it, and the background contains red cells and a few small mononuclear cells. No blasts are present in this field. This megakaryocyte shows dysplasia, and when such forms constitute at least 10% of megakaryocytes in the setting of cytopenia, the findings are consistent with a myelodysplastic syndrome with single lineage (megakaryocytic) dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Normal megakaryocytes have lobes connected by chromatin bridges forming one convoluted nucleus, not separate round nuclei.
Reactive causes (B12/folate deficiency, drugs, HIV) can cause separated lobes but show megaloblastic erythroid and giant band changes and resolve with correction.
Osteoclasts have many (often >5) uniform, evenly spaced small nuclei with nucleoli and coarsely granular cytoplasm, rather than few large nuclei in platelet-type fine granular cytoplasm.
Tumor giant cells occur in cohesive clusters with pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli, lacking the fine platelet granularity of megakaryocytes.

exam.answer_en: Megakaryocytic dysplasia in MDS with single lineage dysplasia — megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated round nuclei ('pawn-ball' form)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著含多個彼此分離圓核的巨核細胞問「正常嗎？」——正常巨核細胞分葉彼此相連，完全分離的核（separated nuclear lobes）屬發育不良。
發育不良門檻：單一系列 ≥10% 細胞具發育不良才算該系 dysplasia；巨核細胞建議至少評估 30 顆。巨核系中 micromegakaryocyte 被認為最可靠。
分類：WHO 2016 稱 MDS-SLD；WHO 5th 歸入 MDS with low blasts（MDS-LB），ICC 2022 則為 MDS, NOS with single lineage dysplasia。
診斷 MDS 前必排除非腫瘤性發育不良：維生素 B12/葉酸或銅缺乏、酒精、藥物（如化療、MMF）、HIV、近期 G-CSF 使用。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把正常分葉重疊的巨核細胞或 megakaryocytic emperipolesis 誤判為多核發育不良；真正的 separated lobes 核與核之間無染色質橋相連，且需達 ≥10% 巨核細胞才有意義。

quiz.q: 圖中巨核細胞有多個彼此完全分離的圓核，屬於哪一種發育異常？要判定為巨核系發育不良至少需多少比例的巨核細胞呈此變化？
quiz.a: Megakaryocyte with separated nuclear lobes（pawn-ball form）；≥10%。

60110.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中聚集多個大小不一、核分葉少或單核的異常巨核細胞（atypical megakaryocytes），右上角可見細胞質邊緣呈泡狀突起的芽細胞；巨核細胞系異常加上帶 blebs 的芽細胞，符合 ML-DS。
features: Numerous atypical megakaryocytes of variable size, many with hypolobated, monolobated or folded nuclei
Megakaryocytic cells with moderate to abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and indistinct granulation
Large cell (upper right) with coarse cytoplasmic granules and a rim of vacuolated cytoplasmic blebs
Admixed maturing granulocytes, including segmented neutrophils, and small erythroid precursors
Clustered arrangement of megakaryocytic elements in a blood-rich background
60110.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of numerous atypical megakaryocytes with variable size and predominantly hypolobated to monolobated or folded nuclei, admixed with maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors. A large cell at the upper right shows cytoplasm with prominent peripheral blebs. The degree of megakaryocytic atypia and clustering is abnormal. In the setting of Down syndrome with 11% blasts, findings are consistent with myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome.

ddx.vs: In a Down syndrome child under 4 years, MDS and AML are unified as ML-DS; outside that context MDS lacks the megakaryoblast predominance and GATA1 mutation.
Morphology overlaps; constitutional trisomy 21 with somatic GATA1 mutation defines ML-DS.
ITP megakaryocytes are increased but show normal lobation without blasts or blebbed megakaryoblasts.

29198.recognize_zh: 周邊血中出現核偏位、胞質深嗜鹼的漿細胞樣細胞，骨髓抹片則被成片漿細胞取代（核偏位、核旁淡染區，偶見雙核），指向漿細胞腫瘤，並需評估是否有循環漿細胞增加。
features: Circulating plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm in the peripheral blood (panel A)
Occasional short red cell stacks suggestive of mild rouleaux in the blood film
Marrow aspirate particle and trails replaced by sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and abundant basophilic cytoplasm (panel B)
Perinuclear hof (Golgi zone) and occasional binucleate or immature plasma cells with more open chromatin at higher power (panel C)
Marked reduction of normal hematopoietic elements, with only scattered neutrophils
29198.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered circulating plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, with short rouleaux in the background. The bone marrow aspirate is hypercellular and composed predominantly of sheets of plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hofs and abundant basophilic cytoplasm, including occasional binucleate and immature forms; normal trilineage hematopoiesis is markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with circulating plasma cells; quantitation of blood plasma cells (plasma cell leukemia threshold ≥5%), clonality studies and serum/urine protein studies are required for classification.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are usually mature, polytypic and rarely exceed 10-20% of marrow cells, without sheets or immature binucleate forms.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with mast cells and MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell population.
Plasmablasts are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli and very high Ki-67, unlike the predominantly mature plasma cells seen here.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell neoplasm with circulating plasma cells (evaluate for plasma cell leukemia) — marrow sheets of plasma cells with hof and binucleate forms, plasma cells in blood
pearls_zh: 考法：周邊血指著核偏位、胞質深藍、有核旁淡染區（hof）的細胞問「這是什麼細胞？」→ plasma cell；再問要算多少比例以判斷 plasma cell leukemia。
IMWG 2021 與 WHO 5th 將 plasma cell leukemia 門檻由 ≥20% 下修為周邊血 plasma cell ≥5%（佔白血球），primary PCL 預後極差。
Flow/IHC：CD138+、CD38+，cytoplasmic κ 或 λ light chain restriction；PCL 常 CD56 陰性。細胞遺傳學 t(11;14) 在 primary PCL 相對常見。
下背痛線索：myeloma 的 lytic lesion 或 vertebral compression fracture；需查 CRAB（高血鈣、腎功能、貧血、骨病灶）、SPEP/IFE、serum free light chain。
exam.pitfall_zh: 周邊血的 plasma cell 易被誤認為 reactive lymphocyte 或 plasmacytoid lymphocyte（LPL）；靠明顯核偏位、核旁 hof 與深藍胞質，並以 flow 的 CD138/CD38 與 light chain restriction 區分。

quiz.q: 周邊血中這些核偏位、胞質深藍的細胞佔白血球多少比例以上，依現行定義可診斷 plasma cell leukemia？
quiz.a: ≥5%（IMWG 2021 / WHO 5th）

24846.recognize_zh: 單一受感染紅血球內含形狀不規則的阿米巴樣滋養體（amoeboid trophozoite）與金褐色瘧色素，細胞質布滿細小粉紅色 Schüffner 小點（Schüffner dots），符合間日瘧原蟲（P. vivax）。
features: Single parasitized red cell, about the size of or slightly larger than neighboring RBCs
Fine, evenly distributed pink-red stippling (Schüffner dots) throughout the host cell
Irregular amoeboid trophozoite/early schizont with several chromatin dots and golden-brown hemozoin pigment
Uninfected RBCs normocytic and normochromic; no multiply infected cells or banana-shaped gametocytes
Scattered platelets in the background
24846.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with a single parasitized erythrocyte. The infected cell is not smaller than surrounding RBCs and contains an irregular, amoeboid late trophozoite/early schizont with several chromatin masses and golden-brown pigment, while its cytoplasm is filled with fine pink Schüffner stippling. No multiply infected erythrocytes, appliqué forms or crescentic gametocytes are seen. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax infection; parasitemia should be quantified on thin film.

ddx.vs: P. ovale also shows Schüffner-type (James) dots but the infected RBC is oval with fimbriated edges and the trophozoite is compact rather than amoeboid.
P. falciparum shows delicate ring forms with double chromatin dots, frequent multiply infected RBCs, crescentic gametocytes and Maurer clefts, without enlargement or Schüffner dots.
P. malariae infects small RBCs lacking stippling and forms band trophozoites and rosette schizonts with coarse dark pigment.
Babesia forms small pleomorphic rings or Maltese-cross tetrads without hemozoin pigment or Schüffner dots.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium vivax — amoeboid trophozoite with hemozoin in a non-shrunken red cell filled with Schüffner dots
pearls_zh: 考法：指著受感染紅血球問「細胞內粉紅色細點叫什麼？是哪一種瘧原蟲？」→ Schüffner dots，P. vivax（P. ovale 也有類似點）。
P. vivax 偏好感染 reticulocyte，受感染紅血球常變大；其入侵依賴 Duffy antigen，Duffy 陰性族群相對有抵抗力。
肝內 hypnozoite 會造成復發，急性期治療後需用 primaquine 或 tafenoquine 根除，用藥前必驗 G6PD（台灣需特別注意）。
P. vivax 可在周邊血看到各期（ring、trophozoite、schizont、gametocyte），與 falciparum 多只見 ring 和 gametocyte 不同。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與 P. ovale 混淆，兩者皆有 Schüffner-type dots；ovale 紅血球呈橢圓且邊緣鋸齒狀、滋養體較緊密，vivax 則為阿米巴樣滋養體。

quiz.q: 受感染紅血球內布滿的細小粉紅點稱為什麼？根除此種瘧疾前必須先驗什麼？
quiz.a: Schüffner dots；G6PD 活性（再給 primaquine/tafenoquine）

28110.recognize_zh: 腦部 MRI FLAIR 看不出異常，但周邊血中出現大型、細胞質深藍的異常淋巴細胞，骨髓切片的免疫染色則顯示棕色陽性大細胞沿著竇狀血管呈線狀、分支狀排列——這種血管內分布是血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（intravascular large B-cell lymphoma）的線索。
features: Panel A: axial FLAIR MRI without discernible parenchymal signal abnormality
Panel B (PB): large atypical lymphoid cells with round nuclei, fine-to-moderately condensed chromatin and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Panel C (BM H&E): hypercellular marrow with large atypical cells; inset shows a branching linear vascular structure
Panel D (IHC): positive large cells distributed in linear, branching intrasinusoidal/intravascular cords
Relative sparing of the interstitial marrow away from the stained sinusoids
28110.describe_en: Composite figure: an axial FLAIR MRI of the brain shows no discernible abnormality (A). The peripheral blood smear contains occasional large atypical lymphoid cells with round nuclei and moderately abundant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm (B). The bone marrow trephine is hypercellular with large atypical cells (C), and immunohistochemistry (likely a B-cell marker) highlights these cells in a linear, branching intrasinusoidal distribution (D). Findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma involving bone marrow and blood.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS with marrow involvement
ddx.vs: DLBCL forms nodular or interstitial mass-like infiltrates rather than being confined to the lumina of sinusoids and small vessels.
Also sinusoidal, but the cells are medium-sized, express CD3 (usually CD4/CD8-negative, TCR gamma-delta) and lack B-cell markers.

ddx.dx: Aggressive NK-cell leukemia / intravascular NK/T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Can be intravascular but is CD20-negative, cytoplasmic CD3-epsilon/CD56-positive and EBER-positive.
Carcinoma cells are cohesive and keratin-positive, CD45/CD20-negative.

28110.stain: MRI FLAIR; Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC (B-cell marker)

exam.answer_en: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma — large atypical lymphoid cells confined to marrow sinusoids on IHC, with circulating cells and a normal brain MRI
pearls_zh: 考法：指著 IHC 呈線狀、分支狀排列的陽性大細胞問「分布有何特殊？」→ 侷限於竇狀隙/血管腔內，這就是 IVLBCL 的診斷核心。
腫瘤細胞 CD20+，常 MUM1/IRF4+，部分病例 CD5+；缺乏腫塊，影像常陰性，因此腦 MRI 正常不能排除 CNS 侵犯。
臨床常見不明熱、LDH 與 soluble IL-2R 升高；Asian variant 以噬血症候群、血球減少、肝脾腫大為主。
診斷可做 random skin biopsy 或骨髓切片；治療以 R-CHOP 為基礎，常加入 high-dose methotrexate 等 CNS-directed therapy。
exam.pitfall_zh: 竇內分布易誤認為 hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma 或一般 DLBCL 骨髓侵犯；HSTCL 為 CD3+ 中型 T 細胞，DLBCL 呈結節或間質浸潤，靠 CD20 與血管內侷限分布區分。

quiz.q: D 圖陽性大細胞呈線狀分支排列，代表腫瘤位於哪裡？診斷為何？
quiz.a: 竇狀隙/血管腔內（intravascular）；intravascular large B-cell lymphoma

15118.recognize_zh: A 圖頰黏膜可見蒼白、緊繃的纖維化條帶（細箭頭）與白色網狀角化（粗箭頭）；B 圖口周皮膚緊繃、張口受限並伴色素沉著，這些口腔與口周硬化變化是慢性移植物抗宿主病（cGVHD）的硬化型表現。
features: A: pale, taut buccal mucosa with fibrotic bands (thin arrows) near the retromolar region
A: white reticular/hyperkeratotic lichenoid change on the buccal mucosa (thick arrow)
A: patchy erythema of the mucosa and lips; mouth opening assisted by a retractor
B: perioral skin sclerosis with tight, thinned lips and reduced oral aperture
B: mottled perioral hyperpigmentation; clinical photographs only
15118.describe_en: Composite clinical photographs of orofacial sclerotic chronic graft-versus-host disease. Panel A shows the buccal mucosa with pale, taut fibrotic bands (thin arrows) and white reticular hyperkeratotic lichenoid change (thick arrow), with patchy erythema. Panel B shows sclerosis of the perioral skin with tight, thinned lips, a reduced oral aperture, and mottled perioral hyperpigmentation. Together these findings indicate mucosal and perioral skin sclerosis that can cause restricted mouth opening (microstomia/trismus), consistent with sclerotic chronic GVHD, often in combination with lichenoid oral disease.

ddx.vs: Submucous fibrosis produces similar blanched fibrous bands but occurs with areca (betel) nut chewing and no transplantation history.
Systemic sclerosis causes perioral furrowing and microstomia with Raynaud phenomenon and specific autoantibodies, without lichenoid oral mucosal changes or transplant history.
Lichen planus shows reticular white striae but does not produce mucosal fibrotic bands or perioral skin sclerosis.
Radiation-induced trismus follows head and neck irradiation and is confined to the radiation field.

captions: A: Buccal mucosal fibrotic bands (thin arrows) and lichenoid hyperkeratosis (thick arrow)
B: Perioral sclerosis with restricted mouth opening and hyperpigmentation

13838.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中一個緻密的小淋巴球聚集沿著骨小樑表面貼附生長（paratrabecular aggregate），周圍骨髓其餘部分多為出血與稀疏細胞；緊貼骨小樑的淋巴球聚集是濾泡性淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓的特徵分布。
features: Dense aggregate of small dark lymphoid cells hugging and molding along the surface of a bony trabecula (paratrabecular pattern)
Aggregate composed of monotonous small cells with round to irregular hyperchromatic nuclei at low power
Few interspersed fat spaces within the aggregate
Remaining intertrabecular space largely hemorrhagic with sparse hematopoietic cells
Cytologic detail (nuclear clefts) not resolvable at this magnification
13838.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone marrow trephine shows a dense, well-circumscribed aggregate of small lymphoid cells applied along the surface of a bony trabecula in a paratrabecular distribution. The remaining intertrabecular spaces are largely hemorrhagic with sparse hematopoiesis, which limits assessment of cellularity. Nuclear detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma; CD20, CD10, BCL6 and BCL2 immunostains are recommended to confirm and to distinguish from a benign lymphoid aggregate.

ddx.vs: Reactive aggregates are small, well circumscribed and located in the intertrabecular space away from bone, with a mixed T- and B-cell composition.
Mantle cell lymphoma involves marrow in nodular, interstitial or paratrabecular patterns but is CD5+ and cyclin D1+.
CLL/SLL forms non-paratrabecular nodular or interstitial infiltrates with proliferation centers and is CD5+ CD23+ LEF1+.
SMZL typically shows nodular and intrasinusoidal involvement highlighted by CD20 in sinusoids, and is CD10 negative.

exam.answer_en: Follicular lymphoma involving marrow — dense paratrabecular lymphoid aggregate applied along a bony trabecula
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍切片問淋巴聚集的「位置」→ paratrabecular；緊貼骨小樑生長是 FL 骨髓侵犯的典型分布，良性聚集多位於骨小樑間。
IHC：CD20 標出 B 細胞聚集，CD10 與 BCL6 支持濾泡中心來源；骨髓內的 FL 細胞有時 CD10 減弱，需配合 flow 與 t(14;18) FISH。
MCL 與 FL 都可以 paratrabecular 分布，一定要加做 cyclin D1 與 CD5；CLL/SLL 多為間質或非骨小樑旁結節。
意義：骨髓侵犯屬 Ann Arbor stage IV，也是 FLIPI-2 的預後因子之一；單側骨髓切片可能漏掉局部病灶，取得足夠長度的 core 很重要。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與良性淋巴聚集混淆；良性聚集較小、邊界清楚、位於骨小樑間、混有 T 細胞與血管，FL 則貼著骨小樑、以單一 CD20+/CD10+ B 細胞為主。

quiz.q: 這個淋巴細胞聚集相對於骨小樑的分布方式稱為什麼？最常代表哪一種淋巴瘤？
quiz.a: Paratrabecular aggregate；follicular lymphoma

11726.recognize_zh: 這是 CSF 流式細胞圖：CD45 亮、低 SSC 的淋巴球閘門內約 97% 事件，主族群為 CD19 陽性且共表現 CD5、CD10 陰性，這種 CD5+ CD10- B 細胞表型支持被套細胞淋巴瘤（需加 CD23 與 cyclin D1 區分）。
features: CD45 vs SSC: dominant CD45-bright, low side scatter lymphoid population (R2, about 97% of gated events)
CD19 vs CD5: large CD19-positive population co-expressing CD5 at moderate intensity (upper right quadrant)
Small separate CD19-negative CD5-bright population representing residual T cells
CD19 vs CD10: B cells are CD10-negative to dim, without a distinct CD10-positive subset
Total events about 5,700 - adequate for a CSF specimen
11726.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the cerebrospinal fluid shows that nearly all events fall within a CD45-bright, low side scatter lymphoid gate. The predominant population is CD19-positive B cells that co-express CD5 and lack CD10, with a minor residual CD5-bright T-cell population. This aberrant CD5-positive, CD10-negative B-cell population in CSF indicates involvement by a CD5-positive B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder; in the clinical context, findings support CNS involvement by mantle cell lymphoma, pending light chain restriction, CD23/FMC7 status and cyclin D1 confirmation.

ddx.vs: CLL is CD5+CD23+ with dim CD20 and dim surface light chain, FMC7 negative, whereas mantle cell lymphoma is CD23-negative, FMC7 positive and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.
Reactive B cells are polytypic for kappa and lambda and generally CD5-negative, unlike a light chain restricted CD5-positive clone.
CD5+ DLBCL shows larger cells with higher forward scatter and is cyclin D1-negative, requiring morphology and IHC to separate from blastoid MCL.

10062.recognize_zh: 這是非形態學圖表：鹼性膠在 C 與 S 位置各有一條帶、酸性膠也分出 C 與 S，HPLC 在 S 與 C 窗口各有一個大峰且無 HbA，即為 HbSC；SS 病只見 S 峰且 HbF 峰明顯升高。
features: Alkaline (cellulose acetate) gel lanes labeled C, S, F, A; patient 1 shows bands at the C (A2/E/O co-migration) and S (D/G co-migration) positions with no A
Acid (citrate agar) gel resolves true HbC from HbE/O and true HbS from HbD/G; patient 1 shows C and S, patient 2 shows S only
HPLC patient 1 (SC disease): two dominant peaks in the S window (~4.5 min) and C window (~5.1 min), small F and A2 peaks, no HbA
HPLC patient 2 (SS disease): single dominant S peak with a prominent HbF peak (~1.1 min) and A2, no HbA or HbC
10062.describe_en: This figure is a non-morphologic laboratory panel comparing alkaline and acid gel electrophoresis with cation-exchange HPLC. For patient 1, both gels show hemoglobins migrating at the C and S positions with absent HbA, and HPLC shows approximately equal peaks in the S and C retention windows, consistent with compound heterozygous hemoglobin SC disease. For patient 2, only an S band is present on both gels, and HPLC shows a dominant HbS peak with a relatively increased HbF peak and no HbA, consistent with homozygous sickle cell (SS) disease. The acid gel is needed to confirm that the alkaline-gel bands represent true HbS and HbC rather than co-migrating HbD/G or HbE/O.

ddx.vs: Electrophoresis mimics SS, but HbA2 is increased (>3.5%) with microcytosis and splenomegaly, and family studies or beta-globin sequencing separate it from SS.
HbD and HbG co-migrate with S on alkaline gel but move with A on acid gel and have distinct HPLC retention times.
HbO and HbE co-migrate with C on alkaline gel, but on acid gel they do not migrate at the C position, and HPLC retention differs (E in the A2 window).
Trait shows an HbA band/peak exceeding HbS (A > S), unlike the absent HbA in SC and SS disease.

exam.answer_en: Hemoglobin SC disease vs sickle cell (SS) disease — S and C bands on alkaline and acid gels with S/C HPLC peaks and no HbA; SS shows S only with raised HbF
pearls_zh: 判讀邏輯：鹼性電泳（cellulose acetate）先分區，但 HbS 與 HbD、HbG 同位，HbC 與 HbE、HbO-Arab、HbA2 同位；酸性電泳（citrate agar）再把 S 與 D/G、C 與 E/O 分開。
HPLC 重點：HbE 與 HbA2 落在同一窗口；HbSC 的 S 與 C 約各半；有 HbS 時 HbA2 值易被高估，判讀 S/β-thalassemia 時需小心。
SS 與 S/β0-thalassemia 電泳相似（皆無 HbA），區分靠 MCV 偏低、HbA2 上升與父母檢查；S/β+ 則仍有少量 HbA。
臨床連結：HbSC 溶血較輕，但增生性視網膜病變與骨壞死風險仍高；hydroxyurea 可提升 HbF，HbF 高者 SS 症狀較輕。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常把鹼性膠 S 位置的帶直接當成 HbS：HbD-Punjab 與 HbG 也在同位置，需以酸性電泳或 HPLC 保留時間及 sickling solubility test 確認，否則可能把 SD 誤判成 SS 或 SC。

quiz.q: 病人鹼性與酸性電泳皆在 S 與 C 位置各有一帶、無 HbA，HPLC S 與 C 峰約等量，診斷為何？
quiz.a: Hemoglobin SC disease（compound heterozygote HbS/HbC）

3022.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群中小型「小圓藍細胞」形成鬆散的黏合團，核質比高、染色質細緻顆粒狀、細胞質稀少淡藍且核互相擠壓變形（nuclear molding），在兒童背景下提示轉移性視網膜母細胞瘤。
features: Cohesive aggregate of small to intermediate round blue cells
High N:C ratio with scant pale gray-blue cytoplasm
Round to angulated nuclei showing nuclear molding
Finely granular, stippled chromatin with small inconspicuous nucleoli
Syncytial arrangement without cytoplasmic granules; background red cells
3022.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive aggregate of small to intermediate round cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, scant pale cytoplasm, nuclear molding, finely granular stippled chromatin and small inconspicuous nucleoli. The clustering and molding favor a non-hematopoietic small round blue cell tumor over leukemia. In a child with a history of retinoblastoma, findings are consistent with metastatic retinoblastoma; immunohistochemistry (e.g., synaptophysin, CRX, loss of RB1) and exclusion of other small round blue cell tumors are advised.

ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma cells also cluster and mold but often form Homer Wright rosettes with fibrillary neuropil and PHOX2B positivity; clinical history and markers separate them.
Lymphoblasts are discohesive single cells without molding and express TdT, CD34 and B/T markers.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells may show cytoplasmic vacuoles and multinucleation and are desmin/myogenin positive.
Ewing sarcoma cells often have PAS-positive cytoplasmic glycogen vacuoles, are CD99/NKX2.2 positive and carry EWSR1 rearrangement.

3790.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中，畫面中央有一顆組織球包著數顆完整的圓形有核細胞，旁邊聚集許多小型深染淋巴球；背景細胞以小淋巴球為主，符合 CLL 患者合併噬血現象。
features: Low-power view of a cellular aspirate with numerous small mature lymphocytes
Central macrophage containing several intact round nucleated cells
Adjacent clump of small dark lymphocytes
Scattered granulocytic precursors and occasional larger cells
Low magnification limits assessment of nuclear detail
3790.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with numerous small mature-appearing lymphocytes admixed with maturing granulocytic elements. A macrophage in the center of the field contains several intact phagocytosed nucleated cells. At this magnification cytologic detail is limited, but the findings indicate hemophagocytosis in a lymphocyte-rich marrow; in a patient with CLL and compatible clinical criteria, this supports secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are larger with lobulated nuclei and granular cytoplasm, which higher magnification would distinguish from a histiocyte.
Overlapping cells lack a surrounding shared histiocytic cytoplasmic membrane, which should be confirmed at high power.
Contains fragmented apoptotic debris rather than intact round nucleated cells.

2254.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量細胞質充滿粗大橘紅色嗜伊紅顆粒的細胞，包括成熟雙葉嗜伊紅球與圓核的嗜伊紅性骨髓細胞，部分顆粒帶紫藍色調（未成熟顆粒），顯示嗜伊紅球系明顯增生。
features: Markedly increased eosinophil lineage cells across all stages of maturation
Eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with round to indented nuclei and cytoplasm packed with coarse orange-pink granules
Some precursors contain admixed dark purple-blue (immature, basophilic-staining) granules
Mature bilobed and segmented eosinophils present
Scattered neutrophilic precursors, small lymphocytes and a few erythroid cells; no increase in blasts apparent in this field
2254.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked eosinophilic hyperplasia, with eosinophils at all stages of maturation including myelocytes, metamyelocytes and mature segmented forms containing coarse orange-pink granules. Some immature eosinophilic precursors contain admixed purple-blue granules. Neutrophilic precursors, lymphocytes and erythroid cells are present in reduced proportion, and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow eosinophilia; evaluation for reactive causes and for myeloid/lymphoid neoplasms with eosinophilia (PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, JAK2 rearrangements) and CEL is recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; distinguished clinically and by absence of clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities.
May show increased atypical mast cells and eosinophils with FIP1L1::PDGFRA detected by FISH or RT-PCR.
Shows increased myeloblasts/monoblasts with abnormal eosinophils bearing large purple-violet basophilic granules.
Shows granulocytic hyperplasia with basophilia and eosinophilia plus BCR::ABL1.

2126.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結免疫組化中，陰性的淡染濾泡之間，濾泡間與副皮質區有大量褐色陽性、呈網狀與環狀排列的細長結構，勾勒出豐富的血管／網狀構造並擴張 T 區；標記未標示，屬 ALPS 反應性型態的背景結構，無法單憑此圖診斷。
features: Low-power IHC of lymph node with multiple round negative (pale) follicles
Strong membranous/linear staining forming an interconnected meshwork and ring-like vascular profiles in the interfollicular zone
Expanded interfollicular/paracortical compartment highlighted by the positive network
Scattered individually positive cells within follicles and paracortex
Antibody not labeled; pattern resembles endothelial/vascular or stromal staining
2126.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of lymph node shows negative follicles separated by an expanded interfollicular compartment containing a prominent positive meshwork of linear and ring-like profiles, suggestive of a rich vascular or stromal network, along with scattered positive single cells. The antibody is not labeled, which precludes precise interpretation. This pattern highlights paracortical expansion with vascular proliferation, which can accompany the florid reactive changes of autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome, but it is not specific; diagnosis depends on demonstration of TCRαβ+ CD4-/CD8- double-negative T cells.

ddx.vs: Shows arborizing high endothelial venules with expanded CD21/CD23-positive follicular dendritic cell meshworks outside follicles and atypical PD1/CXCL13-positive T cells.
Similar vascular prominence but without increased double-negative T cells.
Features regressed follicles with penetrating hyalinized vessels and onion-skin mantles.

1934.recognize_zh: 一群圍繞巨噬細胞的紅血球前驅細胞（erythroblastic island）都偏大，核染色質呈細點狀、開放的篩網樣，而細胞質已有灰藍到粉紅的血紅素化，核質發育不同步，是巨母紅血球性貧血（megaloblastic anemia）的特徵。
features: Erythroblastic island of enlarged erythroid precursors clustered around a central macrophage
Round nuclei with finely granular, open 'sieve-like' chromatin
Moderate grey-blue to polychromatic cytoplasm, more mature than the nuclei (nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony)
Central macrophage cytoplasm with vacuoles and phagocytosed debris
Adjacent granulocytic cells, including a segmented neutrophil at the lower left
1934.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an erythroblastic island composed of enlarged erythroid precursors surrounding a vacuolated macrophage. The precursors have round nuclei with finely stippled, open chromatin that appears immature relative to their grey-blue to polychromatic cytoplasm, indicating nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. Scattered granulocytic cells are present at the edges. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: MDS megaloblastoid cells usually show nuclear budding, internuclear bridging, multinucleation and ring sideroblasts, and B12/folate levels are normal.
Reactive erythroid hyperplasia shows normal-sized precursors with progressively condensed chromatin synchronous with cytoplasmic hemoglobinization.
Leukemic proerythroblasts are predominantly immature with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, not a maturing population with asynchrony.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia — erythroblastic island of enlarged erythroid precursors with open sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著圍繞中央巨噬細胞的一群紅系細胞，先問構造名稱（erythroblastic island），再問這些前驅細胞異常在哪裡（megaloblastic change）。
Erythroblastic island 中央巨噬細胞提供鐵與支持、吞噬排出的核；此處巨噬細胞含碎屑，反映無效造血中前驅細胞在骨髓內凋亡。
Folate 缺乏常見於酗酒、營養不良、懷孕、溶血性貧血需求增加、藥物（methotrexate、trimethoprim、phenytoin）；體內儲存僅數月，缺乏發生較 B12 快。
Folate 缺乏時 homocysteine 上升而 methylmalonic acid 正常；若同時缺 B12，須先補 B12 或併補，避免神經症狀惡化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易當成溶血等反應性 erythroid hyperplasia；反應性增生的前驅細胞大小正常、染色質隨胞質成熟同步濃縮，megaloblast 則核仍細緻開放。

quiz.q: 圖中一群紅系前驅細胞圍繞著中央巨噬細胞，此構造叫什麼？這些前驅細胞呈何種異常？
quiz.a: Erythroblastic island；megaloblastic change（核質發育不同步、篩網狀染色質）

1550.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的是一顆巨大的原紅血球母細胞，細胞質深藍色、邊緣有像耳朵般的突起（cytoplasmic bleb），核大而圓、染色質細緻並有深色類核仁包涵體，比旁邊的嗜中性球大好幾倍，符合微小病毒 B19 引起的純紅血球再生不良（PRCA）。
features: Single giant pronormoblast several times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a blunt 'dog-ear' cytoplasmic bleb (arrow)
Large round nucleus with finely granular chromatin and dark nucleolus-like intranuclear inclusion areas
Adjacent mature neutrophils and a band form
Red cells without polychromasia or nucleated red cells in this field
1550.describe_en: Smear shows a giant pronormoblast, several times the size of adjacent neutrophils, with deeply basophilic cytoplasm bearing a prominent cytoplasmic bleb. Its large round nucleus has finely granular chromatin with dark nucleolus-like intranuclear inclusions. Nearby cells are mature neutrophils, and no maturing erythroid precursors or polychromatophilic red cells are present in this field. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection causing pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Leukemic proerythroblasts form sheets and often have cytoplasmic vacuoles, while parvovirus giant pronormoblasts are sparse in an erythroid-depleted marrow and confirmed by B19 PCR or immunostain.
Megakaryoblasts show platelet-like cytoplasmic budding and CD41/CD61 expression, and lack glassy intranuclear viral inclusions.
Non-viral PRCA shows an absence of erythroid precursors without giant pronormoblasts bearing intranuclear inclusions.

exam.answer_en: Parvovirus B19–associated pure red cell aplasia — giant pronormoblast with basophilic cytoplasmic 'dog-ear' bleb and intranuclear inclusions
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指巨大細胞問名稱與伴隨疾病；答 giant pronormoblast（有 dog-ear 胞質突起），考 parvovirus B19 所致 PRCA。
PRCA 實驗室特徵：正球性貧血、reticulocyte 幾近 0、骨髓紅系前驅細胞缺乏或僅剩早期細胞，白血球與血小板通常保留。
免疫低下者（移植、HIV、化療）B19 可持續感染，血清抗體可能陰性，須以 PCR 驗 B19 DNA；治療以 IVIG 並盡可能降低免疫抑制。
PRCA 其他病因需一併考：thymoma（查胸部影像）、T-LGL leukemia、ABO-incompatible 移植、anti-EPO antibody、藥物。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 megakaryoblast；megakaryoblast 胞質突起為血小板樣出芽、CD41/CD61 陽性且無核內病毒包涵體，此細胞為紅系且核內有深色包涵體。

quiz.q: 網狀紅血球幾乎為 0 的病人，骨髓可見圖中箭頭細胞。此細胞名稱為何？免疫低下者應以何種檢查確診？
quiz.a: Giant pronormoblast（parvovirus B19）；B19 DNA PCR

2510.recognize_zh: 淋巴結副皮質區有許多細胞質豐富淡粉紅、核有凹溝或折痕的組織球／樹突細胞，其間散布吞噬大量棕黑色色素的巨噬細胞（melanophages），是皮膚病性淋巴結病的典型組合。
features: Paracortex expanded by cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Histiocytic/dendritic nuclei that are oval, folded or grooved with fine chromatin
Macrophages laden with coarse brown-black pigment (melanin), concentrated in the upper field
Admixed small mature lymphocytes and occasional plasma cells
No sheets of atypical large lymphoid cells
2510.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a paracortex expanded by numerous cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval, folded or grooved nuclei, consistent with Langerhans cells and interdigitating dendritic cells. Scattered and clustered macrophages contain coarse brown-black pigment, most compatible with melanin. A background of small mature lymphocytes is present, without sheets of atypical lymphoid cells. Findings are consistent with dermatopathic lymphadenopathy; a Fontana-Masson stain can confirm melanin, and clonality studies are advised if mycosis fungoides is suspected clinically.

ddx.vs: LCH shows sinusoidal sheets of grooved Langerhans cells with numerous eosinophils and necrosis, typically without melanin-laden macrophages.
Melanoma cells are cohesive, atypical and have prominent nucleoli, and the pigment lies within tumor cells that are HMB-45/Melan-A positive rather than in bland macrophages.
MF involvement shows clusters of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes and a clonal TCR rearrangement, which morphology at this power cannot fully exclude.
Hemosiderin is golden-brown and refractile and Prussian blue positive, whereas melanin is brown-black and Fontana-Masson positive.

exam.answer_en: Dermatopathic lymphadenopathy — paracortical expansion by Langerhans/interdigitating dendritic cells with melanin-laden macrophages
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著帶棕黑色色素的細胞問「這是什麼色素？在哪種細胞？」；答 melanin 位於巨噬細胞（melanophages），配合副皮質區淡染組織球樣細胞 → dermatopathic lymphadenopathy。
IHC：副皮質區 Langerhans cells 為 S100+、CD1a+、langerin（CD207）+，interdigitating dendritic cells 為 S100+ 但 CD1a−；色素以 Fontana-Masson（melanin）與 Prussian blue（iron）區分。
臨床連結：常見於慢性皮膚病（eczema、psoriasis、剝脫性皮膚炎）的引流淋巴結；在 mycosis fungoides/Sézary 病人，須用 TCR clonality 評估是否有淋巴結侵犯。
本身為良性反應性變化，但不可據此排除早期 MF 侵犯，因為形態上可重疊。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Langerhans cell histiocytosis：LCH 以竇內片狀 Langerhans cells 伴大量嗜酸性球與壞死為主，且無 melanin 巨噬細胞；亦勿把色素當 metastatic melanoma。

quiz.q: 圖中巨噬細胞內的棕黑色色素為何？可用什麼特殊染色確認？
quiz.a: Melanin；Fontana-Masson stain

1230.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆特別大的異型細胞，核大且可見多個核仁，胞質深藍、周邊一圈排列整齊的明顯空泡，遠大於旁邊的骨髓細胞；骨髓抽吸液中出現這種大型、胞質藍帶空泡的異常細胞，要想到淋巴瘤浸潤如 ALCL。
features: Single very large atypical cell, several times the size of surrounding marrow cells
Large round nucleus with finely granular chromatin and multiple small distinct nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a peripheral rim of prominent clear vacuoles
No hallmark kidney- or horseshoe-shaped nucleus evident in this cell
Background of normal maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
1230.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly enlarged atypical cell, many times the size of adjacent hematopoietic cells, with a round nucleus, finely granular chromatin, multiple small nucleoli and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing a peripheral ring of prominent vacuoles. The background shows residual maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements and scattered lymphocytes. The cell is not specific on its own, as the characteristic horseshoe nucleus is not seen, but in the appropriate context it is consistent with marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-positive. Confirmation requires CD30 and ALK immunostains on the core biopsy or clot section.

ddx.vs: Non-hematopoietic tumor cells usually form cohesive clumps and are CD45/CD30-negative with keratin or myogenin positivity, whereas ALCL cells are single and CD30/ALK-positive.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with basophilic cytoplasm and small uniform lipid vacuoles throughout, not giant cells with multiple nucleoli.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cell of classic Hodgkin lymphoma
ddx.vs: Reed-Sternberg cells have bilobed nuclei with huge inclusion-like nucleoli and are CD15+/PAX5 weak and ALK-negative, while ALCL is ALK+ with strong CD30 and T-cell or null phenotype.
Megakaryocytic cells show cytoplasmic blebs or granular cytoplasm and express CD61, rather than a vacuole-rimmed basophilic cytoplasm with CD30 expression.

1294.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的芽細胞（blast）細胞質中有一條細長、粉紅紫色的針狀包涵體，即 Auer 小體（Auer rod），周圍是染色質細緻、有明顯核仁的芽細胞群。
features: Large blasts with high N:C ratio and round to oval nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with one or more prominent nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm, mostly agranular
Single slender, needle-shaped pink-purple Auer rod in the cytoplasm of the arrowed blast
Sheet of monotonous blasts replacing normal marrow elements
1294.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, prominent nucleoli and moderate amounts of basophilic, largely agranular cytoplasm. One blast (arrow) contains a thin, rod-shaped azurophilic cytoplasmic inclusion consistent with an Auer rod. Normal maturing hematopoietic elements are not evident in this field. Findings indicate myeloid lineage and are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; subtype assignment requires flow cytometry, cytogenetics and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts never contain Auer rods and are MPO negative, so an Auer rod establishes myeloid lineage.
APL cells are hypergranular with bilobed nuclei and often bundles of multiple Auer rods (faggot cells), rather than a single rod in an agranular blast.

ddx.dx: Cytoplasmic artifact or crystalline inclusion (e.g., stain precipitate)
ddx.vs: Precipitate lies over or outside the cell in a different focal plane, whereas an Auer rod is a sharply defined azurophilic MPO-positive rod within the cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Acute myeloid leukemia — sheet of blasts with a slender azurophilic Auer rod in the cytoplasm (arrow)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著箭頭問「胞質內針狀物是什麼？代表什麼？」答 Auer rod，代表髓系（myeloid）分化，可排除 ALL。
Auer rod 為融合的初級（azurophilic）顆粒，MPO 陽性、Sudan black B 陽性；在芽細胞未達 AML 門檻的 MDS 中出現時，會影響分類歸入較高風險組（如 WHO 2016 MDS-EB2）。
多條 Auer rod 成束（faggot cells）見於 APL（t(15;17) PML::RARA），此為急症：DIC 風險高，懷疑即應先給 ATRA，不必等基因確認。
AML with t(8;21) RUNX1::RUNX1T1 常見單一細長 Auer rod、核旁淡區與橘紅顆粒，預後相對良好；分類仍需 flow、cytogenetics 與分子（NPM1、FLT3、CEBPA 等）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把染劑沉澱或重疊顆粒誤認為 Auer rod；真正的 Auer rod 位於胞質內、粉紅紫色、兩端尖細且聚焦時與細胞同平面，必要時以 MPO 染色確認為陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中芽細胞胞質內的針狀粉紅紫色包涵體叫什麼？它對芽細胞系列判定的意義為何？
quiz.a: Auer rod；表示髓系（myeloid）芽細胞，支持 AML 而非 ALL

1166.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的紅血球中央有一團血紅素聚集，外圍是蒼白環，再外圈是血紅素邊緣，呈「靶心」樣，即標靶細胞（target cell / codocyte）；背景還有多個類似細胞與摺疊紅血球。
features: Target cells (codocytes): central dense hemoglobin spot, surrounding pale ring and peripheral hemoglobinized rim (arrow)
Several additional target cells and cells with irregular central pallor
Folded and elongated red cells with a central fold or ridge
Occasional echinocyte (crenated cell)
Scattered platelets; no leukocytes of note in this field
