1166.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cells with a central dense zone of hemoglobin surrounded by a pale halo and an outer hemoglobinized rim, consistent with target cells (arrow). Folded and elongated red cells and an occasional echinocyte are also present. No sickle cells or hemoglobin crystals are identified in this field. Target cells reflect an increased membrane-to-volume ratio and are suggestive of a hemoglobinopathy (e.g., hemoglobin C or E, thalassemia) or liver disease; hemoglobin analysis is recommended.

ddx.vs: Stomatocytes have a slit-like or mouth-shaped central pallor without a central hemoglobin spot.

ddx.dx: Hemoglobin C crystals / Hb SC disease
ddx.vs: HbC and SC disease show dense rhomboid or knobby crystals protruding from red cells, which are not present here.
Artifactual target cells are distributed only in thick or poorly dried areas and are not accompanied by other shape changes.
Morphology is identical; these are distinguished by clinical history, lipid studies, and a normal hemoglobin electrophoresis.

exam.answer_en: Target cells (codocytes) — red cells with central hemoglobin spot, pale ring and outer hemoglobinized rim
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著箭頭紅血球問「這是什麼細胞？形成機轉？可能原因？」答 target cell，機轉為細胞膜表面積相對於體積增加。
機轉分兩類：膜脂質增加（阻塞性黃疸、肝病，LCAT 活性改變）或細胞內血紅素減少（thalassemia、缺鐵）；脾切除後也常見。
Hemoglobinopathy：HbC、HbE、HbS/C 及 thalassemia 常見大量 target cells；台灣以 thalassemia 最重要，應做 CBC indices（MCV、Mentzer index）與 Hb electrophoresis/HPLC。
抹片中若同時見 HbC 結晶（棒狀、bar of gold）或鐮狀細胞，提示 HbC 或 HbSC disease。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與乾燥緩慢造成的假性標靶（artifact）或 stomatocyte 混淆；artifact 分布侷限於抹片某區，stomatocyte 中央淡區呈狹長口狀而非中央有血紅素點。

quiz.q: 圖中箭頭所指呈靶心狀的紅血球，其形成的基本機轉是什麼？
quiz.a: 細胞膜表面積相對於細胞體積增加（膜脂質增加或細胞內血紅素減少）

1102.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血中散布許多小型、深染的淋巴球而其他白血球很少，代表淋巴球增多；此倍率看不清腦回狀核，需高倍或流式細胞儀才能確認 Sézary 細胞。
features: Low-power field with increased number of small, round, dark-staining lymphoid cells
Cells roughly red-cell size with high N:C ratio
Nuclear contour detail (cerebriform folds) not resolvable at this magnification
Paucity of neutrophils in this field
Normocytic red cells and adequate platelets
1102.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows an increased number of small, uniform, dark-staining lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and few other leukocytes. Red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. The nuclear contours cannot be assessed at this magnification, so cerebriform morphology cannot be confirmed. The findings indicate a small-cell lymphocytosis compatible with Sézary syndrome in the appropriate clinical setting; high-power review and flow cytometry are required.

ddx.vs: CLL shows round nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin, smudge cells and a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.
T-PLL cells are slightly larger with basophilic blebbed cytoplasm and visible nucleoli rather than cerebriform nuclei.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with larger reactive forms and are polyclonal by flow cytometry and TCR studies.

4238.recognize_zh: 沿抹片邊緣排成一列的單核細胞，核圓到橢圓、染色質細緻，淡藍灰胞質邊緣不規則並有細絲狀突起，其中一顆為較大的雙葉或凹陷核；左下另有嗜中性球作對照。
features: Row of medium-sized mononuclear cells with round to oval nuclei and finely dispersed chromatin
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with irregular, frayed hair-like margins
One larger cell with an indented/bilobed nucleus
Segmented neutrophils and a granulated myeloid cell at lower left for comparison
Cells aligned along a smear edge, where cytoplasmic fraying can be accentuated
4238.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a group of medium-sized mononuclear cells aligned along the edge of the smear, with round to oval or indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular, fine hair-like projections. Segmented neutrophils and a granulated myeloid cell are present nearby. Because the cells lie at a smear edge where cytoplasmic fraying is common, projections should be confirmed in a well-spread area. Findings are consistent with hairy cells, suggestive of hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Monocytes have folded nuclei, lacy chromatin, fine azurophilic granules and vacuoles, and are CD14 positive rather than CD103/CD25 positive.
SMZL cells have short polar villi and clumped chromatin and lack the HCL immunophenotype and BRAF V600E.
HCL-v cells have prominent nucleoli and lack CD25 and annexin A1.

1038.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見兩處血小板聚集成團（右上與左下中性球旁），而紅血球之間游離的單顆血小板很少，這種血小板凝集是假性血小板低下（pseudothrombocytopenia）的線索，常與EDTA抗凝管有關。
features: Clumps of aggregated platelets (upper right and lower center-left)
Paucity of single free platelets between red cells
Segmented neutrophil adjacent to a platelet clump
Central dark, angular nucleated cell with distorted outline, of uncertain identity
Normochromic red cells with fine dark stain precipitate scattered over the field
1038.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several platelet clumps, with few individually dispersed platelets in the intervening field. A segmented neutrophil lies adjacent to one clump, and a distorted dark nucleated cell is present centrally. Red cells are normochromic, with fine stain precipitate over the background. The platelet aggregation indicates that an automated platelet count is likely falsely low; findings are consistent with pseudothrombocytopenia, and a repeat count in citrate or heparin anticoagulant is recommended.

ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia shows few platelets without clumps across the smear, including the feathered edge.
Satellitism shows platelets rosetting around neutrophils rather than free-standing platelet aggregates.
Macrothrombocytopenias show individual large platelets that analyzers undercount, not aggregates of normal-sized platelets.

exam.answer_en: Pseudothrombocytopenia (EDTA-dependent) — platelet clumps on smear with few free single platelets
pearls_zh: 考法：CBC 報血小板低但病人無出血，考官指血小板團問原因。答 in vitro platelet clumping 造成的 pseudothrombocytopenia。
機轉：EDTA 使 GPIIb/IIIa 暴露隱藏抗原，自然抗體在試管內引起凝集，具時間與溫度依賴性；不代表疾病，也無出血風險。
處理：改用 citrate（需乘稀釋校正）或 heparin 抗凝管、採血後立即計數，或以抹片估算血小板；務必檢查抹片羽狀緣（feathered edge）是否有團塊。
臨床意義：避免不必要的血小板輸注、類固醇或骨髓檢查；分析儀也可能把大血小板團誤計為白血球。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 ITP 等真性血小板低下：真性者全片（含羽狀緣）血小板稀少且無團塊；另需與 platelet satellitism 區分，後者是血小板環繞中性球排列。

quiz.q: 此抹片解釋了 CBC 血小板低的何種假象？下一步應怎麼重測？
quiz.a: EDTA-dependent pseudothrombocytopenia（platelet clumping）；以 citrate 或 heparin 管重測／抹片估計

4174.recognize_zh: 單一漿細胞：偏心圓形細胞核、核旁淡染區（hof），細胞質深紫色且周邊帶有偏紅紫的色調，這種細胞質邊緣呈火焰般紅紫色的漿細胞稱為火焰細胞（flame cell）。
features: Single large plasma cell with abundant cytoplasm and eccentric round nucleus
Coarse, clock-face-like clumped chromatin without visible nucleolus
Pale perinuclear hof (Golgi zone) adjacent to the nucleus
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a reddish-purple (fuchsinophilic) tinge toward the periphery
Surrounding red cells are unremarkable; background shows fine precipitate
4174.describe_en: Smear shows a single large plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus containing coarsely clumped chromatin, a perinuclear hof, and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a reddish-purple peripheral tinge. This fuchsinophilic cytoplasmic coloration, attributed to glycoprotein-rich (often IgA) immunoglobulin, defines a flame cell. Flame cells can be seen in plasma cell myeloma, particularly IgA type, but are not by themselves diagnostic of a clonal process. Findings are consistent with a flame cell; clonality should be assessed by light-chain restriction and plasma cell quantitation.

ddx.vs: Mott cells contain multiple pale round Russell bodies (grape-like vacuoles) rather than diffuse reddish-purple peripheral cytoplasm.
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes are smaller with less abundant cytoplasm and lack the prominent hof and fuchsinophilic rim.
Basophilic normoblasts have a central round nucleus with a thin rim of deep blue cytoplasm and no perinuclear hof or eccentric placement.
Thesaurocytes contain fibrillary crystalline cytoplasmic inclusions and a larger cell outline rather than a uniform flame-colored periphery.

exam.answer_en: Flame cell — plasma cell with eccentric clock-face nucleus, perinuclear hof and reddish-purple (fuchsinophilic) peripheral cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：指著胞質周邊呈火焰般紅紫色的漿細胞問名稱；答 flame cell，傳統與 IgA myeloma 相關，但不具特異性。
同類 Ig 堆積形態：Russell bodies（胞質內圓形 Ig 包涵體）、Mott cell（多個 Russell bodies 的葡萄狀細胞）、Dutcher body（疊在核上的核內假包涵體）。
要判斷腫瘤性需算漿細胞比例、做 κ/λ restriction，並查血清/尿液 M protein、serum FLC。
高風險細胞遺傳異常（IMWG）包括 del(17p)、t(4;14)、t(14;16)，以 CD138 純化後 FISH 檢測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 flame cell 直接當成 myeloma 的證據；反應性漿細胞也可有此形態，需克隆性與臨床 M protein 佐證。

quiz.q: 圖中這種漿細胞的名稱為何？與它同屬 Ig 堆積形態、呈葡萄串狀的細胞叫什麼？
quiz.a: Flame cell；Mott cell

4110.recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒周邊聚集大量細胞核偏心、細胞質藍色並有核旁淡染區的漿細胞，部分較大、染色質較開放，與少數嗜中性球及淋巴球混雜，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤復發時漿細胞明顯增加。
features: Marrow particle with numerous plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei and moderate to abundant blue cytoplasm
Perinuclear hof visible in many plasma cells
Variation in size with some larger plasma cells having more open chromatin (immature forms)
Occasional binucleated plasma cell and a cell with a visible nucleolus
Admixed neutrophils, lymphocytes and erythroid precursors with fat spaces
4110.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with fat spaces and a markedly increased population of plasma cells occurring singly and in clusters. The plasma cells have eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hofs, and basophilic cytoplasm, with variation in size, some immature forms with open chromatin, and occasional binucleated cells. Residual neutrophils, lymphocytes, and erythroid precursors are present. Findings are consistent with involvement by plasma cell myeloma, supporting relapse in the clinical context; plasma cell percentage should be quantified and clonality confirmed by flow cytometry or light-chain immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, rarely exceed 10% of cells, cluster around vessels, and are polytypic for kappa and lambda.
Shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with CD20-positive B cells and MYD88 L265P.
Consists of sheets of large plasmablasts with prominent nucleoli and high Ki-67, often EBER positive, in immunocompromised patients.
Erythroid precursors have central round nuclei and no hof, and are CD71/E-cadherin positive but CD138-negative.

3982.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見四顆小至中型的單核細胞，核質比極高、細胞質僅剩一薄圈、染色質細緻且均勻、無顆粒；在曾罹患 ALL 的兒童血液中出現這類母細胞樣細胞，應懷疑急性淋巴母細胞白血病復發，需流式細胞儀確認。
features: Small to medium-sized mononuclear cells, about 1.5-2 times a red cell diameter
Very high N:C ratio with a scant rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round nuclei with finely stippled to slightly condensed chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Red cells unremarkable; no mature neutrophils or platelets prominent in this field
3982.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small to medium-sized blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio with scant agranular cytoplasm. Normal leukocytes are not seen in this field. Given the history of pediatric acute lymphoblastic leukemia, findings are suggestive of circulating lymphoblasts consistent with relapse; flow cytometry (including comparison with the original leukemia-associated immunophenotype) is required, since small lymphoblasts can resemble mature lymphocytes.

ddx.vs: Hematogones are rarely prominent in blood and show a continuous maturation spectrum by flow cytometry without aberrant antigen expression.
Mature lymphocytes have coarse block-like clumped chromatin, whereas lymphoblasts have finer, more homogeneous chromatin.
Agranular myeloblasts can look identical; MPO cytochemistry and flow cytometry are required for lineage assignment.

3918.recognize_zh: 左下那顆大細胞沒有完整核膜，染色質凝集成許多粗顆粒狀的染色體團塊，散布在圓形細胞內，是有絲分裂（mitosis）的前中期；上方較小的細胞也見到凝集成團的染色質，可能是較小細胞的分裂象。
features: Large round cell without an intact nuclear membrane, with chromatin condensed into coarse clumped chromosomes (prometaphase mitotic figure)
Cytoplasm scant and not clearly visible around the condensed chromosomes
Smaller cells above with dark, knobby condensed chromatin, compatible with additional mitotic figures of smaller precursors
Background of crowded red cells; no obvious atypical cells in this field
3918.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cell lacking a nuclear membrane in which the chromatin is condensed into coarse, clumped chromosomes, consistent with a mitotic figure in prometaphase. Smaller cells nearby also show dark, knobby condensed chromatin compatible with mitoses in smaller precursors. Mitotic figures are a normal finding in a proliferating marrow, and in this field there is no other cytologic atypia. Findings are consistent with normal mitotic activity; abundant or atypical mitoses would warrant evaluation for a neoplastic process.

ddx.vs: Apoptotic cells show dense, round, smooth nuclear fragments with condensed eosinophilic cytoplasm, rather than threadlike or granular chromosome arms.
Megakaryocytic nuclei have an intact nuclear membrane with lobation and are surrounded by granular cytoplasm, unlike free condensed chromosomes.
Atypical mitoses show tripolar or asymmetric spindles, lagging chromosomes or bizarre forms, which are not seen here.

3854.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片見多個大型異常淋巴細胞：核大而圓、染色質細緻，細胞質強嗜鹼性且有小空泡，部分拉出細長尾巴（手鏡狀），與周圍小型造血細胞對比明顯，符合血管內大型 B 細胞淋巴瘤細胞。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells, several times the size of red cells
Round to oval nuclei with finely granular/vesicular chromatin and inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Moderate, deeply basophilic cytoplasm with small vacuoles
Cytoplasmic tails and blebs producing hand-mirror shapes
Admixed normal marrow elements (neutrophil, myelocytes, erythroid precursors)
3854.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous large atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and moderate amounts of deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm, some with cytoplasmic tails and blebs. These cells are markedly larger than the admixed normal granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Findings are consistent with involvement by a large B-cell lymphoma; in the clinical context, intravascular large B-cell lymphoma is favored, and correlation with biopsy (intrasinusoidal CD20+ cells) and flow cytometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts have folded nuclei, gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules, and are MPO/NSE and CD33/CD64 positive rather than CD19/CD20 positive.
Plasmablasts show eccentric nuclei with perinuclear hof and prominent central nucleoli and are CD138+ and CD20-negative.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with multiple lipid vacuoles in deeply basophilic cytoplasm, very high proliferation, and MYC rearrangement.
Metastatic tumor cells form cohesive clumps and are CD45-negative with lineage-specific markers.

3598.recognize_zh: 細胞圓形，核呈腎形／豆形凹陷，染色質細緻呈花邊狀，細胞質是均勻灰藍色、有極細的淡紫紅色顆粒、沒有空泡；這是成熟單核球。
features: Round cell about 2 times RBC diameter
Kidney/bean-shaped indented nucleus
Fine, lacy chromatin with small chromatin clumps; no distinct nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm with very fine azurophilic granules; no vacuoles
Scattered normal platelets in background
3598.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a round mononuclear cell with an indented, kidney-shaped nucleus and fine lacy chromatin without distinct nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderately abundant, grey-blue, and contains very fine azurophilic granules without vacuoles. Surrounding red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a mature monocyte.

ddx.vs: Metamyelocytes have more condensed chromatin and pink-lilac cytoplasm with specific granules.
Promonocytes have more delicate chromatin, occasional nucleoli, and more basophilic cytoplasm.
Reactive lymphocytes have a round to oval nucleus and clear blue cytoplasm with peripheral basophilia rather than grey granular cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Mature monocyte — bean-shaped indented nucleus with lacy chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic dust
pearls_zh: 考法：沒有空泡的單核球最容易被認錯；考官會問細胞質顏色與顆粒特徵，答「灰藍、極細嗜天青塵狀顆粒」。
單核球 vs metamyelocyte：metamyelocyte 細胞質為粉紅色帶次級顆粒、染色質較粗；單核球則灰藍、染色質細緻花邊狀。
細胞化學：單核球 MPO 弱陽性或陰性、NSE 陽性（NaF 抑制）；double esterase 染色可同時區分單核球與顆粒球系。
單核球離開血液進入組織後分化為巨噬細胞；骨髓中單核球系增生伴成熟障礙需考慮 AML with monocytic differentiation。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 metamyelocyte；兩者都有腎形核，但 metamyelocyte 細胞質為粉紅顆粒性、染色質較粗塊，單核球為灰藍毛玻璃樣、染色質細緻。

quiz.q: 這顆豆形核、灰藍細胞質的細胞與 metamyelocyte 最主要的細胞質差異為何？
quiz.a: 單核球細胞質灰藍毛玻璃樣帶極細嗜天青顆粒；metamyelocyte 細胞質粉紅色含次級顆粒。

3662.recognize_zh: 兩顆帶狀核／分葉不全的嗜中性球，細胞質布滿粗大深紫色顆粒（毒性顆粒），並可見淡藍灰色細胞質區塊；在無感染的病史下，這種明顯毒性顆粒與左移為 G-CSF 使用後的典型變化。
features: Two band-stage neutrophils with U-shaped, non-segmented nuclei
Dense, coarse dark purple (toxic-type) cytoplasmic granules throughout
Focal pale blue-gray cytoplasmic areas suggestive of Döhle-body-like change
Mature, clumped chromatin appropriate for band neutrophils
Background red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis
3662.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows two band neutrophils with non-segmented, horseshoe-shaped nuclei. Both cells contain abundant coarse, dark purple cytoplasmic granules with focal pale blue-gray cytoplasmic areas. Red cells are unremarkable, and no blasts or dysplastic features are seen in this field. In a patient receiving growth factor, these findings are consistent with G-CSF effect (toxic granulation, Döhle-body-like change, and left shift).

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; the discriminator is clinical history of infection versus recent G-CSF administration.
Coarse granules are present in all leukocyte lineages including lymphocytes and are constitutive rather than transient.
Shows a full spectrum of myeloid precursors with basophilia and BCR::ABL1 rather than isolated toxic bands.
Dysplastic neutrophils are typically hypogranular with bilobed pince-nez nuclei, not hypergranular bands.

3534.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有黏聚成團的小至中型圓形細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、有小核仁，細胞質淡藍且邊界不清，周圍有許多細小透明空泡（富含肝醣/脂質），與造血細胞不同，符合 Ewing 肉瘤等小圓藍細胞腫瘤侵犯骨髓。
features: Cohesive clusters of fairly uniform small to medium round cells
Round nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli; occasional binucleated cells
Scant to moderate pale-blue cytoplasm with indistinct borders forming a syncytial-appearing sheet
Numerous small clear vacuoles in and around the cells
Cells distinct from the scattered hematopoietic elements; background red cells and a few isolated tumor cells
3534.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows cohesive clusters of fairly uniform small to medium round cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and scant to moderate pale-blue cytoplasm with indistinct borders. Numerous small clear cytoplasmic and background vacuoles are present, and isolated similar cells lie outside the clusters. The cells are distinct from normal hematopoietic elements. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a small round cell tumor, compatible with Ewing sarcoma in the appropriate clinical setting; confirmation with CD99/NKX2.2 immunostains and EWSR1 rearrangement studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma shows Homer Wright rosettes with fibrillary neuropil, occurs in younger children, and is PHOX2B-positive and CD99-negative.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells are more pleomorphic with vacuolated blue cytoplasm and express myogenin and desmin.
Lymphoblasts are discohesive with scant cytoplasm and express TdT and CD45, while Ewing sarcoma forms cohesive clusters and is CD45-negative.

3278.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓抹片中可見數團緊密黏聚、細胞重疊、核深染的細胞團塊，與散在的單顆造血細胞明顯不同，提示轉移性腫瘤細胞群；本倍率無法判定原發部位。
features: Multiple tightly cohesive, three-dimensional clusters of overlapping cells
Cluster cells have dark, crowded nuclei with high N:C ratio
Clusters are distinct in size and cohesion from the dispersed single hematopoietic cells
Background of blood with scattered individual marrow cells in the lower field
Magnification too low to assess nucleoli or cytoplasmic detail
3278.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows several cohesive clusters of overlapping cells with dark, crowded nuclei, set in a hemodiluted background. These clusters contrast with the discohesive, individually dispersed hematopoietic cells in the lower part of the field. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of metastatic non-hematopoietic tumor; correlation with the trephine biopsy and immunohistochemistry (e.g., keratin, NKX3.1, PSA) is needed to confirm a prostatic origin.

ddx.vs: Spicules contain fat, stroma and a mixture of hematopoietic cells, and megakaryocytes are large single cells with granular cytoplasm, rather than cohesive sheets of uniform epithelial-type cells.
Osteoblasts form loose groups of cells with eccentric nuclei, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and a pale paranuclear hof, rather than tightly molded overlapping nuclei.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumors (neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Pediatric small round cell tumors form rosettes or syncytial clumps in young patients and are distinguished by IHC such as PHOX2B or myogenin.
Leukemic blasts are discohesive with fine chromatin and diffuse distribution, and are CD45+ rather than keratin+.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic carcinoma in marrow aspirate (clinically prostate) — cohesive clusters of non-hematopoietic cells
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍下要能指出「黏聚成團、核重疊」的細胞群與分散的造血細胞不同，答 metastatic tumor；原發部位靠 IHC 而非形態。
IHC：keratin（AE1/AE3）確認上皮來源；前列腺來源用 NKX3.1、PSA、PSAP，CD45 陰性排除造血來源。
前列腺癌骨轉移多為 osteoblastic，ALP 上升；骨髓侵犯可造成 leukoerythroblastic 血液像與 teardrop cell（myelophthisis）。
本題分類為 paraneoplastic pure red cell aplasia：貧血伴 reticulocyte 極低、骨髓紅血球前驅細胞缺乏時要想到 PRCA，並找潛在腫瘤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為骨髓 spicule 或 megakaryocyte 團；spicule 含脂肪與混合造血細胞，轉移癌是單一形態、緊密黏聚且核擠壓重疊。

quiz.q: 骨髓抹片中這些緊密黏聚、核重疊的細胞團代表什麼？確認上皮來源的第一線 IHC 是？
quiz.a: 轉移性癌（metastatic carcinoma）；cytokeratin（如 AE1/AE3）

3214.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指為中性球分葉核上以細絲相連、約 1.5 µm 的圓形緻密染色質小突起，形似鼓槌（drumstick），即女性 X 染色體失活形成的 Barr body。
features: Mature segmented neutrophil with four nuclear lobes
Small, round, dense chromatin appendage attached to one lobe by a fine strand (drumstick, arrow)
Appendage has a well-defined solid head and uniform dark staining
Neutrophil cytoplasm with fine pink granules
Background red cells normocytic with central pallor; occasional platelets
3214.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil bearing a small, round, dense chromatin appendage attached to a nuclear lobe by a thin filament. The appendage has a solid, sharply defined head, consistent with a drumstick. The background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings represent a Barr body (inactivated X chromosome) in a neutrophil, a normal finding in females that is not of pathologic significance.

ddx.dx: Sessile nodule or small accessory lobe
ddx.vs: Sessile nodules are attached without a thin stalk and small lobes are larger and irregular, whereas a drumstick has a solid round head on a fine filament.
Racquet forms have a hollow (ring-like) head and small tags lack a discrete round head, and neither represents an inactive X chromosome.
These are detached basophilic cytoplasmic inclusions without a connecting strand to the nucleus, seen with immunosuppressive drugs or HIV.
A platelet lies separate from the nucleus with granular pale-purple texture instead of dense nuclear-chromatin staining connected by a filament.

2958.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片免疫染色（抗原未標示）中，棕色陽性細胞呈線狀與小群散布於細胞密度中高的骨髓內，陰性細胞仍佔多數；需對照抗體種類判讀。
features: Moderately to highly cellular marrow between trabeculae
Brown-positive cells scattered singly, in small clusters and in linear streaks
Majority of cells negative with hematoxylin counterstain
Scattered fat spaces preserved
Specific antigen not indicated in the image
2958.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow core biopsy (antigen not specified) shows a cellular marrow with brown-positive cells scattered singly, in small clusters and in linear streaks among a predominantly negative population. Fat spaces are partly preserved and trabeculae are unremarkable. Interpretation depends on the antibody applied; in severe congenital neutropenia, such stains are used to demonstrate the distribution of myeloid precursors and the relative lack of mature neutrophils.

ddx.vs: Normal marrow shows the expected proportion of mature myeloid cells on H&E and aspirate differential.
Neoplastic infiltrates form cohesive aggregates or sheets of positive or negative cells rather than a dispersed pattern.

2894.recognize_zh: 低倍視野的血液抹片經 LAP 細胞化學染色，紅血球呈米黃色，散在的小點狀有核細胞染成紫紅或藍色；此倍率只能用來找白血球分布，無法評分。
features: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear with tan-unstained red cells
Scattered nucleated cells with red-counterstained nuclei, some with blue cytoplasmic reaction product
Individual granule intensity cannot be graded at this magnification
2894.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear stained for leukocyte alkaline phosphatase (LAP) with a nuclear red counterstain. Leukocytes are evenly distributed across a monolayer of unstained red cells, and several show blue cytoplasmic reaction product. At this magnification the staining intensity of individual neutrophils cannot be graded; scoring requires oil-immersion assessment of 100 consecutive segmented and band neutrophils, each rated 0 to 4+.

ddx.vs: Most neutrophils would lack blue granules at high power, yielding a low total score.

ddx.dx: High LAP score (leukemoid reaction, polycythemia vera, pregnancy, infection)
ddx.vs: Most neutrophils would show 2+ to 4+ granular positivity at high power.

2702.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片滿是含粗大顆粒的嗜酸系細胞，可見雙葉核成熟嗜酸性球、嗜酸性骨髓球，中央還有一顆破裂細胞的顆粒散在背景；嗜酸系在各成熟階段都增加，是嗜酸性球增多的骨髓表現。
features: Numerous eosinophil-lineage cells from myelocyte to mature bilobed forms
Coarse cytoplasmic granules, with some immature purple-staining granules
Disrupted eosinophil with granules dispersed into the background
Admixed neutrophilic band, plasmacytoid lymphoid cells and erythroid precursors
No obvious blast excess in this field
2702.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous eosinophil lineage cells at all stages of maturation, including eosinophilic myelocytes and mature bilobed eosinophils with coarse granules. A ruptured eosinophil releases free granules into the background. Neutrophilic bands, occasional lymphoid cells and erythroid precursors are present, and blasts are not conspicuously increased. Findings show eosinophilic hyperplasia with orderly maturation, compatible with hypereosinophilic syndrome after exclusion of secondary and clonal causes.

ddx.vs: Parasitic infection, drug reaction, allergy and lymphocyte-variant HES produce identical marrow morphology and are excluded clinically and by T-cell phenotyping/clonality.
Requires molecular testing for the fusion; morphologic clues include increased atypical spindled mast cells and elevated serum tryptase.
Requires clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormality or increased blasts with dysplastic eosinophils.

2638.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆約為紅血球1.5–2倍大的圓形細胞，核質比極高，只見一圈薄薄的藍色細胞質，核染色質均勻細點狀、核仁不明顯，沒有顆粒，符合淋巴母細胞（lymphoblast）。
features: Single round cell roughly 1.5-2 times the diameter of a red cell
Very high N:C ratio with only a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Round nucleus with homogeneous, finely stippled chromatin that is more condensed than a myeloblast
Nucleoli inconspicuous
Agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods
Background normocytic red cells and small platelet clumps
2638.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single circulating blast approximately one and a half to two times the size of a red cell. The cell has a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio with a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm, a round nucleus, and homogeneous finely stippled chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods are present. Red cells appear normocytic, and small platelet clumps are seen. Morphology is suggestive of a lymphoblast; confirmation requires flow cytometric immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are usually larger with more cytoplasm, very fine open chromatin, distinct nucleoli, and may show granules or Auer rods, whereas this cell has scant cytoplasm and more condensed chromatin.
Mature lymphocytes are smaller with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin and no nucleoli rather than the fine, even chromatin of a blast.
Hematogones have very homogeneous smudged chromatin and scant cytoplasm and can be indistinguishable morphologically, requiring flow cytometry to show normal maturation patterns.

exam.answer_en: Lymphoblast — small blast with very high N:C ratio, fine homogeneous chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, agranular
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這顆細胞問 lymphoblast、myeloblast 或成熟淋巴球；重點在染色質「細而均勻」且無顆粒。
確認需 flow cytometry：TdT、CD34 表示不成熟；B 系看 CD19/cCD79a/CD10，T 系看 cytoplasmic CD3。
細胞化學：lymphoblast MPO 與 Sudan black B 陰性；PAS 可呈粗塊狀（block）陽性，但已大多被 flow 取代。
骨髓中需與 hematogones 區分：flow 顯示 hematogones 有連續正常成熟模式、無異常抗原表現。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為成熟小淋巴球：成熟淋巴球染色質粗糙團塊狀、較小；lymphoblast 染色質細緻均勻，細胞約為紅血球 1.5–2 倍大。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞 MPO 陰性、TdT 陽性，最可能是哪種細胞？
quiz.a: Lymphoblast（提示 ALL/LBL，需 flow 確認 B 或 T 系）

2574.recognize_zh: 高倍抹片中一顆只比紅血球稍大的細胞，細胞質豐富且布滿紫紅色細顆粒、邊緣帶藍色，只有一個小而緻密的圓形偏位核，符合微小巨核細胞（micromegakaryocyte），是MDS的巨核細胞發育異常線索。
features: Small cell only slightly larger than adjacent red cells
Single small, round, dense, eccentric non-lobated nucleus
Abundant cytoplasm filled with fine pink-purple granules (platelet-type granularity) with a bluish peripheral rim
Low N:C ratio despite small overall cell size
Adjacent mononuclear cell with round nucleus and pale gray cytoplasm; normocytic red cells in background
2574.describe_en: Smear shows a small megakaryocytic cell, only slightly larger than neighboring red cells, with a single small, round, dense, eccentric nucleus and abundant cytoplasm containing fine pink-purple platelet-type granules with a bluish peripheral rim. These features are consistent with a micromegakaryocyte (dwarf megakaryocyte). An adjacent mononuclear cell with a round nucleus and pale cytoplasm is also present. Micromegakaryocytes are a reliable marker of dysmegakaryopoiesis and in the stated context support myelodysplastic neoplasm; overall cellularity and the extent of multilineage dysplasia must be assessed on the full aspirate and core biopsy, supplemented by CD61 or CD42b immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Mast cells have densely packed dark purple metachromatic granules that often obscure an oval central nucleus and are tryptase and CD117 positive, rather than fine pink platelet-type granules.
Basophils have a segmented nucleus overlaid by coarse, dark blue-black granules, not a single small round nucleus with fine granular cytoplasm.
Megakaryoblasts have a high N:C ratio with fine chromatin, nucleoli and agranular blebbed cytoplasm, while this cell has condensed nuclear chromatin and granular mature cytoplasm.
Plasma cells have deep blue agranular cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin.

exam.answer_en: Micromegakaryocyte (dwarf megakaryocyte) — small cell with single round dense nucleus and granular platelet-type cytoplasm, marker of MDS
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這顆比紅血球稍大、單核、胞質有粉紅細顆粒的細胞，問名稱；答 micromegakaryocyte 並說明代表 dysmegakaryopoiesis。
Micromegakaryocyte 是最可靠的巨核細胞發育異常指標；形態不確定時可用 CD61 或 CD42b IHC 在切片中找出。
WHO 5th 將 hypocellular MDS（MDS-h）列為獨立類型，需與 aplastic anemia 鑑別；切片細胞量與 CD34 評估很重要。
Dysplasia 判定需該系細胞 ≥ 10% 異常；小型低分葉巨核細胞亦為 MDS with isolated del(5q) 的特徵。
CML 常見 dwarf megakaryocytes（小型低分葉），但不是典型單核 micromegakaryocyte，需搭配 BCR::ABL1。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 mast cell 或 basophil：mast cell 顆粒深紫濃密、tryptase/CD117 陽性；basophil 核分葉、顆粒粗黑遮核；本細胞為粉紅細顆粒血小板型胞質。

quiz.q: 圖中這顆小細胞稱為什麼？可用哪種免疫染色在切片中確認其系別？
quiz.a: Micromegakaryocyte；CD61（或 CD42b）

2446.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩個原始淋巴球，比紅血球大、核質比高、胞質只有薄薄一圈淡藍色，染色質細緻，較大者可見小核仁，無顆粒；形態符合原始淋巴球，T 細胞系需流式確認。
features: Two circulating blasts, one small and one medium-sized
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round nuclei with slight indentation in the larger cell
Finely dispersed chromatin; small nucleolus in the larger cell
Background red cells normochromic; no Auer rods
2446.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, a thin rim of agranular pale blue cytoplasm and finely dispersed chromatin; the larger cell has a slightly indented nucleus and a small nucleolus. No Auer rods or granules are seen, and the red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with circulating lymphoblasts; T-lymphoblastic leukemia requires flow cytometric confirmation of TdT and cytoplasmic CD3.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; B-lineage antigens rather than cytoplasmic CD3 establish the lineage.
Myeloblasts have more cytoplasm, more prominent nucleoli and may show granules or Auer rods with MPO positivity.
Reactive lymphocytes have condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm, sometimes with azurophilic granules.

2318.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一團約七顆互相擠壓成多角形的大型母細胞，核染色質細緻、細胞質少且呈淡藍色，左下另有一顆單獨母細胞，背景有標靶紅血球，符合 CML 急性轉化。
features: Aggregate of about seven large blasts molded into polygonal shapes
High N:C ratio with finely granular, open chromatin and faint nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm without visible granules or Auer rods
Isolated additional blast at lower left
Background red cells with occasional target cells
2318.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an aggregate of large blasts molded against one another, with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin, faint nucleoli and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm. An additional isolated blast is present, and background red cells include occasional target cells. No Auer rods are identified. In the setting of CML, BCR-ABL1-positive, findings are consistent with blast phase; lineage cannot be determined morphologically.

ddx.vs: Agranular blasts with scant cytoplasm raise lymphoid lineage, which requires flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, TdT) to confirm.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor in blood
ddx.vs: Tumor cells in blood are rare and form cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and lack CD45, whereas leukemic blasts are CD45 positive.
Morphology overlaps, and history of chronic phase and BCR-ABL1 testing are needed.

2062.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下可見兩群濾泡中心細胞混合：小至中型、核不規則有裂痕且深染的中心細胞（centrocyte），以及較大、核圓而染色質空泡狀、核仁貼近核膜的中心母細胞（centroblast），並有分裂像；中心母細胞偏多，需評估分級。
features: Mixture of small to medium cleaved cells (centrocytes) with angulated, irregular hyperchromatic nuclei
Numerous large non-cleaved cells (centroblasts) with round vesicular nuclei and one to three peripheral nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Mitotic figure present
No normal polarization or tingible-body macrophages evident in this field
2062.describe_en: High-power section of a neoplastic follicle shows a mixture of centrocytes with angulated, cleaved nuclei and numerous large centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and peripheral nucleoli. A mitotic figure is present, and tingible-body macrophages or polarization are not evident. The centroblasts appear relatively numerous in this field, so counting across multiple follicles is needed for grading. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma; correlation with architecture and BCL2/CD10 immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive centers show polarization into dark and light zones, abundant tingible-body macrophages, high Ki-67 and BCL2-negative germinal center cells.
DLBCL consists of diffuse sheets of large cells without a follicular architecture or CD21-positive FDC meshworks.
MCL is monotonous without centroblasts, and is CD5 and cyclin D1 positive.

1998.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指是一顆漿細胞，細胞質內塞滿多顆大小不一、淡藍灰色的圓形透亮小球（Russell bodies），整體像一串葡萄，這就是 Mott cell（grape cell）；背景還有其他漿細胞與骨髓造血細胞，符合骨髓瘤浸潤。
features: Arrowed plasma cell with eccentric nucleus and cytoplasm distended by multiple round pale blue-gray globules (Mott cell)
Globules vary in size and represent Russell bodies of accumulated immunoglobulin
Adjacent plasma cell with a small intranuclear/cytoplasmic clear inclusion
Background marrow with plasma cells, myeloid precursors and a band neutrophil
Large clear fat spaces and thick smear areas with overstaining
1998.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle-adjacent area with plasma cells and myeloid precursors. The arrow highlights a plasma cell whose cytoplasm is distended by numerous round, pale blue-gray globules of varying size, consistent with Russell bodies forming a Mott (grape) cell; an adjacent plasma cell contains a single small clear inclusion. Fat spaces and overstained thick areas are present. The Mott cell reflects accumulation of immunoglobulin and is not itself specific for malignancy, but in this context it is consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm (multiple myeloma).

ddx.vs: Mott cells also occur in chronic inflammation and autoimmune disease, so neoplasia rests on plasma cell percentage, atypia and light chain restriction rather than the inclusions.
Dutcher bodies are single PAS-positive immunoglobulin pseudoinclusions overlying the nucleus, whereas Russell bodies are multiple cytoplasmic globules.

ddx.dx: Vacuolated cells (e.g., Burkitt cells or blasts with lipid vacuoles)
ddx.vs: Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with small punched-out empty lipid vacuoles and no plasmacytoid features, whereas Russell bodies are pale gray-blue proteinaceous globules in a plasma cell.

exam.answer_en: Mott (grape) cell with multiple Russell bodies in marrow involved by plasma cell neoplasm (multiple myeloma)
pearls_zh: 考法：指著箭頭細胞問「這是什麼細胞？圓球是什麼？」答：Mott cell（grape cell）；Russell bodies，為堆積在擴張粗面內質網中的免疫球蛋白。
包涵體名詞對照：Russell body（細胞質內球）、Dutcher body（疊在核上的核內假包涵體，PAS 陽性）、Mott cell（多個 Russell bodies）、flame cell（IgA 型常見紅色細胞質邊緣）。
Mott cells 不具惡性特異性，慢性發炎也可見；診斷骨髓瘤仍需漿細胞比例、kappa/lambda 限制與 CRAB/SLiM 事件。
Dutcher bodies 常見於 lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma 與 MALT lymphoma，考題常把 Dutcher 與 Russell 混在一起考。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 Russell bodies 誤認為 Burkitt 的脂質空泡：Burkitt 空泡為深藍細胞質中打孔狀空洞；Russell bodies 為淡藍灰色蛋白質小球，位於有漿細胞特徵的細胞中。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指細胞內多個圓球稱為什麼？含有此類包涵體的細胞叫什麼？
quiz.a: Russell bodies；Mott cell（grape cell）

1806.recognize_zh: 這是一張正面胸部 X 光，不是型態學影像：兩側肺容積偏小、橫膈抬高，上腹部被大片軟組織密度占據、左側腸氣被推擠至左下外側，提示肝脾腫大或腹腔腫塊；右下肺門旁有模糊浸潤陰影，需與臨床及斷層影像對照判讀。
features: Frontal (AP/PA) chest radiograph with low lung volumes
Elevated hemidiaphragms with a large homogeneous soft-tissue density occupying the upper abdomen
Bowel gas displaced to the left lateral and inferior abdomen, suggesting splenomegaly or a left upper quadrant mass
Ill-defined opacity in the right perihilar/lower zone
Mediastinum not markedly widened; external skin marker/electrode over the right shoulder
1806.describe_en: This is a frontal chest radiograph rather than a morphologic specimen. Lung volumes are low with elevation of the hemidiaphragms, and a large homogeneous soft-tissue density occupies the upper abdomen, displacing bowel gas to the left lateral and lower abdomen, suggestive of marked hepatosplenomegaly or a large abdominal mass. An ill-defined opacity is present in the right perihilar and lower zone, which may represent atelectasis from diaphragmatic elevation, infiltrate or lymphomatous involvement. The mediastinum is not grossly widened. In a patient with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, these findings support bulky abdominal/visceral disease and warrant cross-sectional imaging (CT or PET-CT) for staging.

ddx.dx: Massive splenomegaly from myeloproliferative neoplasm (e.g., primary myelofibrosis, CML)
ddx.vs: Radiographic appearance is similar; distinguished by blood counts with leukoerythroblastosis or BCR::ABL1, and marrow findings.
Produces diffuse ground-glass abdominal density with centrally floating bowel loops rather than lateral displacement of gas by an organ mass.
Mimics diaphragm elevation, but lateral decubitus films or ultrasound show layering fluid and the gastric bubble is separated from the pseudo-diaphragm.
Cross-sectional imaging and biopsy separate lymphoma from metastases, storage disease or congestion.

1614.recognize_zh: 淋巴結副皮質區可見深染小淋巴球與許多核較大、染色質淡、細胞質淡染的細胞（交指狀樹突細胞/組織球）混雜，並有粉紅色高內皮小靜脈穿插，形成斑駁（mottled）外觀，無濾泡結構。
features: Small lymphocytes with round dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Numerous larger cells with pale vesicular, oval to folded nuclei and pale cytoplasm (interdigitating dendritic cells/histiocytes)
Eosinophilic high endothelial venules traversing the field
Mottled pattern produced by the mix of dark lymphocytes and pale cells
No follicles, granulomas, or atypical large cells
1614.describe_en: Section of lymph node at medium-high power shows paracortical tissue composed of small lymphocytes admixed with numerous larger pale cells with vesicular, oval to folded nuclei, consistent with interdigitating dendritic cells and histiocytes, and traversed by high endothelial venules. The mixture imparts a mottled appearance. No follicles, granulomas or atypical large cells are identified. Findings are consistent with normal lymph node paracortex.

ddx.vs: Dermatopathic change forms expanded pale paracortical nodules rich in S100/CD1a-positive Langerhans cells with melanin-laden macrophages.
PTCL shows atypical medium-to-large T cells with irregular nuclei effacing the node, often with loss of pan-T antigens, unlike the bland mixed population here.
cHL contains Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells with macronucleoli in a mixed background, which are not seen in this field.

60302.recognize_zh: 中央小淋巴球的核明顯比多數紅血球大，紅血球偏小且中央淡染區擴大（hypochromia），並夾雜細長的鉛筆狀細胞（pencil cells），符合小球性低色素紅血球（microcytosis）。
features: Red cells are smaller than the nucleus of the adjacent small lymphocyte (microcytosis)
Widened central pallor in many red cells (hypochromia)
Anisopoikilocytosis with elongated pencil cells and occasional teardrop forms
A neutrophil and a small lymphocyte provide size reference
Platelets appear numerous in the background
60302.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells that are predominantly smaller than the nucleus of a small lymphocyte, with increased central pallor. There is moderate anisopoikilocytosis including elongated pencil cells and occasional teardrop forms. Platelets appear increased in number. No basophilic stippling or target cells are prominent. Findings are consistent with microcytic, hypochromic anemia; the pencil cells and apparent thrombocytosis favor iron deficiency, to be confirmed with iron studies.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia trait tends to show target cells and basophilic stippling with a normal RDW and high red cell count, whereas pencil cells and marked anisocytosis favor iron deficiency; iron studies and hemoglobin analysis separate them.
Anemia of chronic disease is usually normocytic or mildly microcytic with less poikilocytosis; ferritin and iron-binding capacity distinguish them.
Sideroblastic anemia often shows a dimorphic population with Pappenheimer bodies and requires ring sideroblasts on marrow iron stain.

exam.answer_en: Microcytic hypochromic anemia, favoring iron deficiency — RBCs smaller than a lymphocyte nucleus with widened pallor and pencil cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官以小淋巴球核（約 7–8 μm）當尺，問紅血球是小球性還是大球性，並指出細長鉛筆狀細胞。
小球性貧血鑑別：iron deficiency、thalassemia trait、anemia of chronic inflammation、sideroblastic anemia；第一步驗 ferritin。
Ferritin 低可確立缺鐵；但 ferritin 為急性期反應物，發炎時可假性正常，需搭配 transferrin saturation 判讀。
缺鐵常伴反應性血小板增多；成人缺鐵性貧血（尤其男性與停經女性）必須找出血來源，如胃腸道。
Mentzer index（MCV/RBC）<13 傾向 thalassemia trait，>13 傾向缺鐵，僅作篩檢參考，確診需 Hb 分析與鐵學檢查。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 thalassemia trait：thalassemia trait 多見 target cells、basophilic stippling、RBC 數偏高且 RDW 常正常；缺鐵則 RDW 升高、pencil cells 明顯。

quiz.q: 以圖中小淋巴球核作比較，紅血球大小如何？合併 pencil cells，第一個應驗的檢查是什麼？
quiz.a: 小於淋巴球核，為小球性低色素；serum ferritin

60046.recognize_zh: 這顆帶狀核（band）嗜中性球的細胞質充滿粗大、深紫藍色的顆粒，比正常嗜中性球的淡粉紅細小顆粒明顯粗且深，是毒性顆粒（toxic granulation）的表現。
features: Band neutrophil with a curved, non-segmented, C/U-shaped nucleus of uniform width
Condensed, clumped chromatin without nucleoli
Cytoplasm packed with coarse, dark purple-blue (azurophilic) granules, much larger and darker than normal neutrophilic granules
Granules evenly distributed throughout the cytoplasm and do not obscure the nucleus
No clear cytoplasmic vacuoles or Döhle bodies identified in this cell
Surrounding red cells are normocytic and normochromic
60046.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, high power, shows a band neutrophil with a horseshoe-shaped nucleus and condensed chromatin. The cytoplasm contains abundant coarse, dark azurophilic granules distributed evenly throughout, consistent with toxic granulation. Cytoplasmic vacuolization and Döhle bodies are not evident in this cell, and the background red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with toxic granulation in a band neutrophil, as seen in infection, inflammation, or G-CSF therapy.

ddx.vs: Alder-Reilly granules are large, dark, and present in all leukocytes including lymphocytes and monocytes, and occur without clinical infection (mucopolysaccharidoses).
Chédiak-Higashi shows few giant, discrete, irregular granules rather than numerous uniform coarse granules.
Basophil granules are larger, blue-black, water-soluble, and typically overlie and obscure the nucleus.
Immature precursors have a round or oval nucleus with finer chromatin and often a paranuclear hof, rather than a mature condensed band nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Toxic granulation — band neutrophil with abundant coarse dark azurophilic cytoplasmic granules
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這顆顆粒粗黑的 band，問「這是 toxic granulation、Alder-Reilly 還是 basophil？」並問臨床意義。
Toxic granulation 是 primary（azurophilic）granules 在加速成熟下仍保留染色性，見於細菌感染、敗血症、燒傷、發炎與 G-CSF 使用。
同時要找 Döhle bodies、細胞質空泡與 left shift；三者合併較支持感染。
Alder-Reilly anomaly 見於 mucopolysaccharidoses，粗大顆粒出現在所有白血球（含淋巴球與單核球）；Chédiak-Higashi（LYST）則為巨大異常顆粒。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Alder-Reilly anomaly 混淆：Alder-Reilly 顆粒也出現在淋巴球與單核球、與感染無關；toxic granulation 只見於嗜中性球系，常伴 Döhle bodies、空泡與 left shift。

quiz.q: 這顆嗜中性球粗大深色的顆粒叫什麼？列出兩個常見原因。
quiz.a: Toxic granulation；細菌感染／敗血症、G-CSF 治療（或燒傷、發炎）

142.recognize_zh: 周邊血液淋巴球增多，除了小型、染色質塊狀的淋巴球外，還有不少較大、核形不規則、細胞質較多的非典型淋巴球；流式呈 CD5+、CD23+、CD200 亮、CD10−、FMC7−、CD79b−、kappa 弱表現的單株B細胞，染色體核型可見三染色體12（trisomy 12），支持具非典型型態的慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）。
features: PB lymphocytosis with a mixture of small lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and larger atypical lymphocytes with irregular nuclear contours and more abundant pale-blue cytoplasm; arrows mark smudge-type cells at low power
BM aspirate dominated by small to medium lymphocytes, some with notched nuclei and moderate cytoplasm
BM biopsy hypercellular with an interstitial-to-diffuse infiltrate of small round lymphocytes; residual megakaryocytes present
IHC: B cells CD20+ and CD5+, cyclin D1 negative; CD3 highlights scattered background T cells
Flow: CD19+ CD5+ CD23+ CD200 bright, CD10-, FMC7-, CD79b-, CD43+, dim CD20, kappa-restricted with dim surface light chain
Karyotype: 47,XY,+12 (trisomy 12, arrow)
142.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an absolute lymphocytosis composed of small lymphocytes with clumped chromatin admixed with a substantial proportion of larger lymphocytes with irregular nuclear contours and more abundant cytoplasm; smudge cells are present. The bone marrow aspirate is replaced by similar small to medium-sized lymphocytes, and the core biopsy is hypercellular with an extensive interstitial to diffuse lymphoid infiltrate. By immunohistochemistry the infiltrate is CD20+ and CD5+ with only scattered CD3+ T cells and is negative for cyclin D1. Flow cytometry identifies a kappa-restricted (dim) B-cell population that is CD5+, CD23+, CD200 bright, CD43+, dim CD20, and negative for CD10, FMC7 and CD79b; karyotype shows trisomy 12. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with atypical morphologic features.

ddx.vs: MCL is also CD5+ but is typically CD23-/dim, CD200-negative, FMC7+/CD79b+ with brighter light chain and is cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, whereas this case is CD23+, CD200 bright and cyclin D1 negative.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes have a medium-sized nucleus with a single prominent central nucleolus and exceed 55% of lymphoid cells, whereas the enlarged cells here show irregular nuclei and more cytoplasm without prominent nucleoli.
Richter shows confluent sheets of large cells with high proliferation on biopsy, while this marrow shows a diffuse infiltrate of small to medium lymphocytes.
SMZL is usually CD5-negative, CD23-negative and CD200 dim with villous cytoplasmic projections, unlike this CD5+/CD23+/CD200-bright clone.

captions: PB smear: lymphocytosis with smudge cells (arrows, low power) and larger atypical lymphocytes with irregular nuclei (high power)
BM aspirate (A) with atypical lymphocytes; BM core biopsy (B, C) with hypercellular interstitial-diffuse lymphoid infiltrate
BM IHC: CD20+ and CD5+ infiltrate, scattered CD3+ T cells, cyclin D1 negative
Flow cytometry: CD5+ CD23+ CD200-bright, CD10- FMC7- CD79b- B cells with dim kappa restriction
Karyotype: 47,XY,+12 with trisomy 12 (arrow)

exam.answer_en: CLL with atypical morphology — mixed small and larger irregular lymphocytes, CD5+/CD23+/CD200 bright, trisomy 12
pearls_zh: 考法：指著較大、核不規則、細胞質多的淋巴球問「還能算 CLL 嗎？」——關鍵是免疫表型（CD5+、CD23+、CD200+、FMC7−、CD79b 弱、輕鏈弱）而非單看型態。
Trisomy 12 與非典型型態（較多大細胞、核凹陷）相關，也常伴 NOTCH1 突變；FISH 預後分層：del(13q) 單獨較佳，del(11q)、del(17p) 較差。
Matutes 積分（CD5、CD23、FMC7、sIg 強度、CD79b/CD22）≥4 支持 CLL；CD200 亮表現有助與 MCL（CD200 陰性）區分。
治療前須檢查 TP53（del(17p)/突變）與 IGHV 突變狀態，決定是否避免化學免疫療法而選 BTK 抑制劑或 venetoclax。
exam.pitfall_zh: 非典型大細胞易誤判為 mantle cell lymphoma 或前淋巴球轉變；靠 cyclin D1/SOX11 陰性、CD23/CD200 陽性排除 MCL。

quiz.q: 此 CLL 的非典型型態最常與哪一種細胞遺傳異常相關？
quiz.a: Trisomy 12（+12）

78.recognize_zh: 脾臟紅髓瀰漫被中型到偏大、帶漿細胞樣（plasmacytoid）特徵的淋巴細胞浸潤，白髓結構不明顯；免疫染色中一個 B 細胞標記幾乎全陰性，而輕鏈原位雜交（ISH）呈單一輕鏈優勢，符合抗 CD20 治療後 CD20 表現喪失的脾邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse red pulp infiltrate with congestion; no well-formed white pulp follicles at low power
Medium to large lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and small but distinct nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with plasmacytoid (eccentric nucleus) features in many cells
Infiltrate clusters around trabeculae and vessels; scattered hemosiderin pigment in the background
One IHC marker essentially negative in the neoplastic cells (consistent with CD20 loss after rituximab), while another marker shows strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining of a dense cellular cluster
Light-chain ISH: many strongly positive cells for one light chain versus only rare cells for the other (light-chain restriction)
78.describe_en: Sections of spleen show congested red pulp diffusely infiltrated by a population of medium to large lymphoid cells, with loss of distinct white pulp architecture and aggregates around trabeculae and vessels. At high power the cells have round to oval nuclei, vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, many with plasmacytoid features; hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present. By immunohistochemistry, one B-cell marker (presumed CD20) is essentially negative in the lesional cells, whereas another marker (unlabeled; likely a CD20-independent B-cell or plasmacytic marker) highlights dense perivascular clusters with strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining. Chromogenic ISH shows numerous cells positive for one immunoglobulin light chain with only rare cells positive for the other, indicating light-chain restriction. In the context of prior rituximab therapy, findings are consistent with splenic marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation and loss of CD20 expression; the proportion of larger cells warrants correlation to exclude large-cell transformation.

ddx.vs: DLBCL forms confluent sheets of large cells (nuclei larger than macrophage nuclei) with high Ki-67, whereas SMZL retains a mixed small-to-medium, marginal-zone/plasmacytoid population.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL shows monotonous small cells diffusely filling cords and sinusoids without a biphasic white pulp pattern or prominent plasmacytic differentiation, and typically lacks the micronodular white pulp involvement of SMZL.
HCL cells have bland bean-shaped nuclei with abundant clear cytoplasm forming red blood cell lakes and are Annexin A1/CD103/BRAF V600E positive, unlike SMZL.
LPL rarely presents with isolated splenomegaly and usually carries MYD88 L265P with an IgM paraprotein, whereas SMZL shows marginal zone/red pulp distribution and generally lacks MYD88 mutation.

78.stain: H&E; IHC (presumed CD20, B-cell marker); ISH: kappa/lambda
captions: Spleen, low power H&E: congested red pulp with diffuse lymphoid infiltrate and trabecular structure.
Medium power H&E: sheet of medium-sized plasmacytoid lymphoid cells adjacent to a vessel.
Medium power H&E: atypical cells around a trabecula/vessel with hemosiderin pigment.
High power H&E: medium to large cells with vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm.
IHC (presumed CD20): lesional cells essentially negative with only faint rare staining, consistent with CD20 loss after rituximab.
IHC low power: clustered positive cells in perivascular/nodular aggregates.
IHC medium power: strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining of a dense cellular aggregate.
IHC high power: strong membranous/cytoplasmic positivity in most medium to large lesional cells.
Light-chain ISH: numerous strongly positive cells in a perivascular cluster (restricted light chain).
Light-chain ISH, opposite light chain: only rare positive cells, supporting light-chain restriction.

14.recognize_zh: 周邊血液可見雙相（dimorphic）紅血球族群、淚滴狀與橢圓形紅血球，並有帶粗大嗜鹼性點彩或 Pappenheimer bodies 的紅血球；骨髓鐵染色（Prussian blue）中大量有核紅血球的藍色鐵顆粒環繞細胞核排列，即環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts），加上骨髓紅血球系增生，符合鐵粒母細胞性貧血。
features: Prussian blue stain: numerous erythroid precursors with coarse blue siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear ring (ring sideroblasts)
Peripheral blood: dimorphic red cell population with hypochromic cells admixed with normochromic cells, marked anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells and elliptocytes
Scattered red cells with coarse basophilic stippling/Pappenheimer bodies (siderocytes)
Aspirate: marked erythroid hyperplasia with erythroid precursors at all stages of maturation, occasional binucleate forms
Biopsy: hypercellular marrow (near 90-100%) with erythroid predominance and preserved megakaryocytes
14.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a dimorphic red cell population with hypochromic cells, marked anisopoikilocytosis including teardrop cells and elliptocytes, and scattered red cells containing coarse basophilic inclusions consistent with basophilic stippling/Pappenheimer bodies. The bone marrow aspirate shows marked erythroid hyperplasia with precursors at all stages of maturation and occasional binucleate erythroblasts; blasts are not increased in the fields shown. Iron stain demonstrates numerous ring sideroblasts, with siderotic granules encircling the nucleus of erythroid precursors. The core biopsy is markedly hypercellular with erythroid predominance. In an 8-year-old, findings are consistent with congenital (hereditary) sideroblastic anemia; correlation with ALAS2/SLC25A38 and other genetic testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Occurs in older adults with dysplasia in other lineages and SF3B1 mutation, whereas congenital sideroblastic anemia presents in childhood with germline ALAS2/SLC25A38 variants.

ddx.dx: Acquired sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, isoniazid, copper deficiency/zinc excess, lead)
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts are similar, but history of toxin/drug exposure, low copper, or elevated lead with prominent basophilic stippling and reversal after removal of the cause separate these.
Also hypochromic microcytic, but marrow iron stores are absent and ring sideroblasts are not seen, while sideroblastic anemia shows increased iron and ring sideroblasts.
Shows microcytosis with target cells and abnormal hemoglobin electrophoresis/globin gene testing, without significant ring sideroblasts.

captions: Peripheral blood: dimorphic red cells, teardrop cells, a lymphocyte, and a red cell with coarse stippling
Peripheral blood: anisopoikilocytosis with a heavily stippled red cell at center
Peripheral blood: hypochromic and dimorphic red cells with Pappenheimer bodies/stippling in two cells
Bone marrow aspirate: marked erythroid hyperplasia with maturing erythroid precursors
Iron stain: numerous ring sideroblasts
Iron stain: ring sideroblasts with perinuclear siderotic granules
Core biopsy, low power: hypercellular marrow
Core biopsy, high power: erythroid predominance with megakaryocytes

exam.answer_en: Congenital sideroblastic anemia — numerous ring sideroblasts on iron stain with erythroid hyperplasia and dimorphic hypochromic RBCs in a child
pearls_zh: 考法：鐵染色指著核周藍色鐵顆粒的紅血球前驅細胞問名稱（ring sideroblast）；周邊血找雙相紅血球與 Pappenheimer bodies（鐵染色陽性的 siderocyte）。
最常見遺傳型為 X-linked ALAS2 突變（heme 合成第一步，以 pyridoxine/B6 為輔因子），部分病人對 pyridoxine 有反應；體染色體隱性以 SLC25A38 較常見。
WHO 定義 ring sideroblast：紅血球前驅細胞內 ≥5 顆鐵顆粒、環繞核周至少 1/3。
無效造血會增加腸道鐵吸收，即使未輸血也可能鐵過載，需追蹤 ferritin 並考慮排鐵。
兒童另需排除 Pearson syndrome（粒線體 DNA 缺失，合併胰臟外分泌不全、骨髓前驅細胞空泡）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 MDS with SF3B1 mutation；兒童發病、家族史、以小球性為主（ALAS2 型）、無其他系列發育不良且無 SF3B1 突變支持先天型。

quiz.q: 鐵染色中核周環狀排列藍色顆粒的紅血球前驅細胞稱為什麼？最常見的 X-linked 致病基因？
quiz.a: Ring sideroblast；ALAS2

64270.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片（trephine）幾乎被瀰漫性、強陽性的免疫染色細胞填滿，脂肪與正常造血分區消失；在純紅血球白血病（pure erythroid leukemia）的脈絡下，應理解為紅血球系前驅細胞呈片狀取代骨髓。圖上未標示抗體名稱。
features: Bone marrow trephine core, low power, markedly hypercellular (near 100%) with loss of normal fat
Diffuse sheet-like immunoreactivity (brown chromogen) in the vast majority of marrow cells
Effacement of normal trilineage topography; no preserved paratrabecular or interstitial compartments
Small negative vascular/sinusoidal spaces and trabecular fragments stand out as unstained islands
Antibody not labeled; individual cell cytology not assessable at this magnification
64270.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow trephine biopsy stained by immunohistochemistry (antibody not specified in the image) shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near-total replacement of fat and normal hematopoietic architecture. The vast majority of cells show diffuse positive staining in a sheet-like distribution, with only vascular spaces and small bony fragments remaining unstained. Cytologic detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification. In the context of the clinical diagnosis, the pattern is consistent with diffuse marrow replacement by an erythroid-lineage neoplasm, as seen in pure erythroid leukemia; confirmation requires an erythroid marker panel (e.g., E-cadherin, CD71, glycophorin/hemoglobin) and blast enumeration.

ddx.dx: Megaloblastic anemia with marked erythroid hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Erythroid hyperplasia retains maturation with abundant late normoblasts and normal p53 staining, whereas pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of immature proerythroblasts (≥80% erythroid, ≥30% proerythroblasts) often with strong p53 overexpression.

ddx.dx: AML with erythroid predominance / MDS with increased blasts
ddx.vs: These show a separate myeloblast population (CD34/CD117 positive) rather than a pure immature erythroid sheet.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor or lymphoma
ddx.vs: Tumor cells are negative for erythroid markers (E-cadherin, CD71, glycophorin) and express lineage-appropriate markers such as keratin, CD99, or CD20/CD3.
